data.name: Query2_EmployeeSalarySheetForBandhi_ReportData
data.value:
--DECLARE @Month varchar(10) = 'December', -- @Year INT = 2024, -- @CompanyID INT = 1, -- @PeriodID INT = 1
Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.FatherName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,Round(FinalTab.Amount,0) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking, FinalTab.DaysWorkings2, --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName from ( {1},SectionID,SectionName ,(Select SUM(HRMS_Overtime.OverTimeHours) from HRMS_Overtime where HRMS_Overtime.PersonID = FinalTab.PersonID And HRMS_Overtime.CompanyID = FinalTab.CompanyID And HRMS_OverTime.PeriodID = FinalTab.PeriodID and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Year and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Year And HRMS_Overtime.Status = 1 ) as OTHours from ( select case when TAB.DeductionType = 'Basic Salary' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then 1 when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (100 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) then (1001 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (4000 +TAB.PayrollTypeId)
--when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) --when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2 ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
{2} JOIN ( select CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode , MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS negativeAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
where DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
GROUP BY HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode HAVING MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) < 0 ) NegativeTable ON NegativeTable.EmployeeCode = HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName
union all
select 2000 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,FK_SectionID,SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount),0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
{2} JOIN ( select CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode , MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS negativeAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
where DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
GROUP BY HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode HAVING MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) < 0 ) NegativeTable ON NegativeTable.EmployeeCode = HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode
WHERE
DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID
union all select 3000 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount ,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking, tab.DaysWorkings2 ,FK_SectionID,SectionName --, DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (

Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1

Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1

Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
where DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1

WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.fatherNAme,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID

data.name: Query2_EmployeeSalarySheet_ReportData
data.value:
select case when TAB.DeductionType = 'Basic Salary' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then 1 when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (100 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) then (1001 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (4000 +TAB.PayrollTypeId)
--when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) --when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) end as SortCategory,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,SUM(tab.Amount) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking ,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1

INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode --AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) and HRMS_PayrollType.Isvisiable = 1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID, HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID, HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID

data.name: Query_DocumentTypeDirectInvoice
data.value: SELECT distinct [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID, DocumentType FROM [SET_DocumentType] inner join UsersInDocumentType on UsersInDocumentType.Documenttypeid = [SET_DocumentType] .DocumentTypeID and UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = [SET_DocumentType] .CompanyID where [DocumentType] like '%DI-Invoice (HR)%' and [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID]=@CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID]=@PeriodID and [MenuID] = (SELECT [MenuID] FROM [ApplicationMenu] where [MenuPath]='/AR/Transaction/Invoice_Transaction_frm.aspx' and [IsEnabled]=1) and UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @CurrentUserID order by [DocumentType]

data.name: Query_EmployeeEarningcard_Report
data.value:
select * from ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType ='Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking, tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID from ( select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,HRMS_SD.Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1

WHERE --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1

union all

select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD

select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType, case when MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount)%10 = 9 then MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount) else MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount) end as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD

INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
--inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on --HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and --HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode -- and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) -- and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID)
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND --HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 2
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID --AND Set_Designation.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID --and Set_Grade.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Provident%' {0} group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary ,HRMS_SET_Employee.CNICNumber,HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalary_ReportData
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @Date datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000' --Declare @Month varchar(20) = 'september' --Declare @PersonID int = 520 --Declare @PersonTypeCode int = null --Declare @StatusID int = null --Declare @Months varchar(20) = '09' --Declare @Year varchar(20) = '2021' --Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 1
Declare @IsActive int = 1; select case when tabtest.Allowances='Supply Days' then 0 when tabtest.impact = 1 then tabtest.PayrollAmount else 0 end as PayRoll ,* from ( SELECT TABSb.GrossValue, TABSb.YTDGrossValue, TABSb.JoiningDate, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.EmpAccountNo, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName,
case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount, TABSb.IBanNo, TABSb.BasicSalary, case when TABSb.GrossAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.GrossAmount,-1) else TABSb.GrossAmount end as GrossAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, case when TABSb.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.NetAmount,-1) else TABSb.NetAmount end as NetAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal,
TABSb.PayrollTypeCode, (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Allowances , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Description when '0' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Deductions , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Amount else null end)as AllowancesAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as CMDeductionsAmount ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount when '0' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount else null end) as PMDiscountAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then Isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) when '0' then isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) else null end) as TMDiscountAmount ,
TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay ,TABSb.YTD ,TABSb.NTNNo ,TABSb.CNICNumber ,TABSb.CompanyName ,TABSb.Email ,('PAY SLIP FOR THE MONTH OF '+ @Month+' YEAR '+ @Year) as ParameterReport
,(Select SUM(HRMS_Overtime.OverTimeHours) from HRMS_Overtime where HRMS_Overtime.PersonID = TABSb.PersonID And HRMS_Overtime.CompanyID = TABSb.CompanyID and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Year and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Year And HRMS_Overtime.Status = 1 ) as OTHours
from
(
select max(GrossValue) as GrossValue,max(JoiningDate) as JoiningDate, max(PersonID) as PersonID,CompanyID, PersonTypeCode ,EmployeeCode ,FullName, max(SalaryDate)as SalaryDate, BasicSalary ,sum(Standard)as Standard ,max(JobDesignationName) as JobDesignationName ,max(DepartmentName) as DepartmentName, max(AccountHolderName) as AccountHolderName, max(BankAccountNumber) as BankAccountNumber, max(EmpAccountNo) as EmpAccountNo, max(BankBranchName) as BankBranchName,max(BankName) as BankName ,max(IBanNo) as IBanNo, sum(ManualAmount)as ManualAmount ,sum(CalculatedAmount)as CalculatedAmount ,max(GrossAmount)as GrossAmount ,sum(DeductionAmount)as DeductionAmount,sum(NetAmount)as NetAmount, max(DaysWorking)as DaysWorking, sum(DaysAbsent) as DaysAbsent, sum(DaysLWP) as DaysLWP ,sum(DaysLate)as DaysLate, sum(DaysEarly)as DaysEarly ,max(DaysTotal)as DaysTotal, PayrollTypeCode ,Description ,max(Amount) as Amount,sum(PMDiscountAmount)as PMDiscountAmount ,max(Impact) as Impact, sum(LeaveWithouPay)as LeaveWithouPay, max(YTD)as YTD ,sum(YTDGrossValue)as YTDGrossValue ,NTNNo ,CNICNumber, max(CompanyName)as CompanyName, Email from (

DECLARE @FromDate date; DECLARE @ToDate date; DECLARE @Days varchar(2); DECLARE @PayrollTypeCode int =4; DECLARE @Years varchar(4) =@Year; SET @FromDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/01/' + @Years, 101) ); SET @Days=(Select DAY(DATEADD(DD,-1,DATEADD(MM,DATEDIFF(MM,-1,@FromDate),0))) ); SET @ToDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/' + @Days + '/' + @Years, 101) );
Select TAB.Description, SE.FirstName, SE.EmployeeCode, SUM(TAB.Quantity) AS QUANTITY, TAB.leaveDays, TAB.leaveDays - SUM(TAB.Quantity) as BalanceLeaves, SE.CompanyID, TAB.PersonID, TAB.PayrollTypeID, TAB.PayrollTypeCode, TAB.LeavelID as PayrollTypeID, TAB.Impact, Tab.Factor
from ( SELECT HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, isnull(sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity),0) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
FROM HRMS_EmployeeAttendance
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.[Status] = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID WHERE (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear between @FromDate AND @ToDate) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status = 1 AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Casual%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Sick%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Annual%' GROUP BY HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union all

from HRMS_LeaveRequest

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalary_ReportDataTwo
data.value:
Declare @IsActive int = 1; select case when tabtest.Allowances='Supply Days' then 0 when tabtest.impact = 1 then tabtest.PayrollAmount else 0 end as PayRoll ,* from ( SELECT TABSb.GrossValue, TABSb.JoiningDate, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName,
case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount,
TABSb.BasicSalary, case when TABSb.GrossAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.GrossAmount,-1) else TABSb.GrossAmount end as GrossAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, case when TABSb.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.NetAmount,-1) else TABSb.NetAmount end as NetAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal,
TABSb.PayrollTypeCode, (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Allowances , (case TABSb.PayrollTypeCode when '2' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Deductions , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Amount else null end)as AllowancesAmount , (case TABSb.PayrollTypeCode when '2' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Standard else null end) as DeductionsStandardAmount , (case TABSb.PayrollTypeCode when '5' then TABSb.Description else null end) as Loan, (case TABSb.PayrollTypeCode when '5' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as LoanAmount, (case TABSb.PayrollTypeCode when '4' then TABSb.Description else null end) as Leaves, TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay
from
( SELECT ( select sum(isnull(CalculatedAmount,0)+isnull(ManualAmount,0)) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll left join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year where PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
) as GrossValue, HRMS_SET_Employee.JoiningDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName,
HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,
(HRMS_SalaryHeader.daystotal - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent) - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP as DaysWorking , HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable=1
WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ([HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 {0} ) TABSb )tabtest
-- Leaves Calculation --
DECLARE @FromDate date; DECLARE @ToDate date; DECLARE @Days varchar(2); DECLARE @PayrollTypeCode int =4; DECLARE @Years varchar(4) =@Year; SET @FromDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/01/' + @Years, 101) ); SET @Days=(Select DAY(DATEADD(DD,-1,DATEADD(MM,DATEDIFF(MM,-1,@FromDate),0))) ); SET @ToDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/' + @Days + '/' + @Years, 101) );
Select TAB.Description, SE.FirstName, SE.EmployeeCode, SUM(TAB.Quantity) AS QUANTITY, TAB.leaveDays, TAB.leaveDays - SUM(TAB.Quantity) as BalanceLeaves, SE.CompanyID, TAB.PersonID, TAB.PayrollTypeID, TAB.PayrollTypeCode, TAB.LeavelID as PayrollTypeID, TAB.Impact, Tab.Factor
from ( SELECT HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, isnull(sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity),0) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
FROM HRMS_EmployeeAttendance
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.[Status] = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
WHERE (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear between @FromDate AND @ToDate) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status = 1
GROUP BY HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union all
--CASE 0 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
where( HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate >= @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate <= @ToDate) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union
--CASE 1 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
where (HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate between @FromDate and @ToDate)) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union
--CASE 2 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,@ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
where (HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate > @ToDate and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between @FromDate and @ToDate)) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor

--CASE 3 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,@ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor

where
( HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >@ToDate) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive

Select EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,Gender,CNICNumber,DateOfBirth,EOBINo,JoiningDate,EOBIJoinDate,GrossAmount,NetAmount,sum(AmountofEOBI)EmployerAmount, sum(AmountofEOBI + 520) as AmountofEOBI, DaysWorking,Years,Department from (
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount as EmployerAmount ,(Round(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount ,0)) as AmountofEOBI,--0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI Company%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,ManualAmount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
union All
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount as EmployerAmount ,(Round(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0)) as AmountofEOBI, --0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,ManualAmount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
) as tab
group by tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.Gender,tab.CNICNumber,tab.DateOfBirth,tab.EOBINo,tab.JoiningDate,tab.EOBIJoinDate,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysWorking,tab.Years,tab.Department ,tab.EmployerAmount

data.value: select AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID, hrms_set_employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.Fullname, HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.JoiningDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, dateName(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) + ' - ' + dateName(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as SalaryMonthYear from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join hrms_set_employee on hrms_set_employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and hrms_set_employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = hrms_set_employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 where postId is not null and PaymentID is null and IsApproved = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive=1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and datepart(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month and datepart(year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year and hrms_set_employee.FK_BankAccountID = @BankID and hrms_set_employee.FK_BankBranchID = @BankBranchID

data.name: Query_PayRollVarienceReportData
data.value:
Select tempEmpCount.NoOfEmployeesCurrent,tempEmpCountPrvs.NoOfEmployeesPrvs,* From (
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, DepartmentName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount, tab.Category
from (
select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as GrossAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as DeductionAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as NetAmount,'Current Month' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2}) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID )tab
GROUP BY tab.DepartmentID, tab.DepartmentName,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount, tab.Category
union all
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, --count(*) over(order by DepartmentName) AS 'NoofEmployees', tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, DepartmentName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
from (
select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as GrossAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as DeductionAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as NetAmount,'Previous Month' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL)AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID )tab
GROUP BY tab.DepartmentID, tab.DepartmentName,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
--union all
--select --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, ----count(*) over(order by DepartmentName) AS 'NoofEmployees', --tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, --tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, --tab.DepartmentID, --DepartmentName, --tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, --tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
-- from (
--select distinct --HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, --HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, --HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, --HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, --SET_Department.DepartmentID, --SET_Department.DepartmentName, --HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, --SET_Location.LocationID, --SET_Location.LocationName, --isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) --- --(select ISNULL(SUM(sh.GrossAmount),0) from HRMS_SalaryHeader sh --where DATENAME(month, sh.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND --DATEPART(Year, sh.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND --sh.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --sh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --sh.Status = 1 --and sh.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID --)
--as GrossAmount, --isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) --- --(select ISNULL(SUM(sh.DeductionAmount),0) from HRMS_SalaryHeader sh --where DATENAME(month, sh.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND --DATEPART(Year, sh.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND --sh.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --sh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --sh.Status = 1 --and sh.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID --) --as DeductionAmount, --isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) --- --(select ISNULL(SUM(sh.NetAmount),0) from HRMS_SalaryHeader sh --where DATENAME(month, sh.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND --DATEPART(Year, sh.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND --sh.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --sh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --sh.Status = 1 --and sh.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID --)
-- as NetAmount,'Variance' as Category -- from HRMS_SalaryHeader
--INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on --HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
--Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID --AND SET_Department.Status=1
--Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID --AND SET_Location.Status=1
--WHERE --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND --DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL)AND --(SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND --(HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID -- in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and StatusID = @StatusID or @StatusID is NULL )) AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 --{0} --group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, -- HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, -- HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID,SET_Department.DepartmentID, -- SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, -- SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID -- )tab
-- GROUP BY -- tab.DepartmentID, -- tab.DepartmentName,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, --tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, --tab.DepartmentID, --tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, --tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
union all
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, --count(*) over(order by DepartmentName) AS 'NoofEmployees', tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, DepartmentName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,
--(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthGrossAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthGrossAmount,0)) GrossAmount, --(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthDeductionAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthDeductionAmount,0)) DeductionAmount, --(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthNetAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthNetAmount,0)) NetAmount,'Variance' as Category sum(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthGrossAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthGrossAmount,0)) GrossAmount, sum(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthDeductionAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthDeductionAmount,0)) DeductionAmount, sum(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthNetAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthNetAmount,0)) NetAmount,'Variance' as Category
from ( select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as CurrentMonthGrossAmount,0 as PreviousMonthGrossAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as CurrentMonthDeductionAmount,0 as PreviousMonthDeductionAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as CurrentMonthNetAmount,0 as PreviousMonthNetAmount, '' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
union all
select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, 0 as CurrentMonthGrossAmount,isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as PreviousMonthGrossAmount, 0 as CurrentDeductionAmount,isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as PreviousDeductionAmount, 0 as CurrentNetAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as PreviousNetAmount,'' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL)AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
)tab
GROUP BY tab.DepartmentID, tab.DepartmentName,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName, --tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount, tab.Category )FintabFinal
-------Current Month No Of Employees---------- Left Join (Select DepartmentID,Count(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) as NoOfEmployeesCurrent from HRMS_SET_Employee Inner Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status=1 Inner JOin HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID=HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 AND HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive=1 AND DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = @CompanyID Group By DepartmentID)tempEmpCount on tempEmpCount.DepartmentID=FintabFinal.DepartmentID
-------Preivous Month No Of Employees---------- Left Join (Select DepartmentID,Count(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) as NoOfEmployeesPrvs from HRMS_SET_Employee Inner Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status=1 Inner JOin HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID=HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 AND HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive=1 AND DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = @CompanyID Group By DepartmentID)tempEmpCountPrvs on tempEmpCountPrvs.DepartmentID=FintabFinal.DepartmentID {1}

data.name: Query_Section_Wise_Salary_Sheet_Report
data.value:
select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (250 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_SS.SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName, HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,HRMS_SD.Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
Left Join SET_Section HRMS_SS ON HRMS_SS.DepartmentID=HRMS_DP.DepartmentID AND HRMS_SS.Status=1
Inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT ON HRMS_PT.CompanyID=HRMS_EP.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PT.Status=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SS.SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName
union all
select 200 SortCategory,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SS.SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName as SectionName, HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Gross Amount' as DeductionType,MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID, 0 as GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1

Inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT ON HRMS_PT.CompanyID=HRMS_EP.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PT.Status=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SS.SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount
union all
select 250 as SortCategory,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SS.SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName as SectionName, HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
Left Join SET_Section HRMS_SS ON HRMS_SS.DepartmentID=HRMS_DP.DepartmentID AND HRMS_SS.Status=1
Inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT ON HRMS_PT.CompanyID=HRMS_EP.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PT.Status=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SS.SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName union all
select 400 as SortCategory,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SS.SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName as SectionName,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Amount' as DeductionType,MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
