Inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT ON HRMS_PT.CompanyID=HRMS_EP.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PT.Status=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SS.SectionID,HRMS_SS.SectionName, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName

data.name: QUery_EmployeeSalarySheet_AlAbbas
data.value:
select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,HRMS_SD.Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_SD.CompanyID = HRMS_PT.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID
union all
select 350 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_SD.CompanyID = HRMS_PT.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0}
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary
union all select 400 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType, (sum(grOSSaMOUNT) - sUM(DEDUCTIONamOUNT)) AS aMOUNT,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_SD.CompanyID = HRMS_PT.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary

Select FullName,FatherName,EmployeeCode,leaveDays,LeaveID,PersonID,PayrollTypeID,PayrollTypeCode,Description ,Sum(Quantity) as Quantity,PeriodYear,DepartmentName,JobDesignationName,JoiningDate,ConfirmationDate,Salary from (
Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeaveID, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1),0) as Quantity ,datepart(yyyy, MAX(Set_Period.EndDate))as PeriodYear ,Set_Department.DepartmentName ,JobDesignationName,HRMS_Set_Employee.JoiningDate ,HRMS_Set_Employee.PermanentDate as ConfirmationDate ,(
Select Round((MAX(Amount) / 66.6)*100,2) as GrossSalary from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID inner join Set_Period on Set_Period.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status =1 and SalaryDate >= StartDate and SalaryDate <= EndDate and PayrolltypeID = 2 and PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID )as Salary from HRMS_LeaveRequest inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 left join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.personID=HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID
left join Set_Department on Set_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID left join Set_JobDesignation on Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.Fk_JobDesignationID
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%annual%'
inner join Set_Period on Set_Period.PeriodID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.PeriodID
where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = 4 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, DepartmentName,JobDesignationName, JoiningDate,PermanentDate,datepart(yyyy, HRMS_LeaveRequest.RequestDate)
union all
select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeaveID , HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description ,isnull(sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity),0) as Quantity ,datepart(yyyy, MAX(Set_Period.EndDate))as PeriodYear ,Set_Department.DepartmentName ,JobDesignationName,HRMS_Set_Employee.JoiningDate ,HRMS_Set_Employee.PermanentDate as ConfirmationDate ,(
Select Round((MAX(Amount) / 66.6)*100,2) as GrossSalary from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID inner join Set_Period on Set_Period.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status =1 and SalaryDate >= StartDate and SalaryDate <= EndDate and PayrolltypeID = 2 and PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID )as Salary
from HRMS_EmployeePayroll left join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.personID=HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID inner join Set_Period on Set_Period.PeriodID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID left join HRMS_EmployeeAttendance on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
left join Set_Department on Set_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID left join Set_JobDesignation on Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.Fk_JobDesignationID
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID= HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%annual%'
WHERE HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 4 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID = @PeriodID
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID , HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description ,DepartmentName,JobDesignationName, JoiningDate,PermanentDate
) as tab
group by
FullName,FatherName,EmployeeCode,leaveDays,LeaveID,PersonID,PayrollTypeID,PayrollTypeCode,Description ,PeriodYear,DepartmentName,JobDesignationName,JoiningDate,ConfirmationDate,Salary

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalarySheet_DepartmentWiseReportData
data.value:
SELECT count(distinct TABSc.PersonID) as PersonCount, TABSc.SectionName, TABSc.SectionID, TABSc.DepartmentID, TABSc.SalaryDate, TABSc.DepartmentName, sum(TABSc.PayrollAmount) as PayrollAmount, sum(TABSc.BasicSalary)as BasicSalary, sum(TABSc.GrossAmount)as GrossAmount, sum(TABSc.DeductionAmount)as DeductionAmount, sum(TABSc.NetAmount)as NetAmount, sum(TABSc.DeductionsAmount) as DeductionsAmount, TABSc.Deductions from (
SELECT TABSb.SectionName, TABSb.SectionID, TABSb.DepartmentID, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName, case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount, TABSb.BasicSalary, TABSb.GrossAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, TABSb.NetAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal, TABSb.PayrollTypeCode,
(case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Description when '2' then TABSb.Description when '0' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Deductions ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Amount when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Standard else null end) as DeductionsStandardAmount , TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay
from
( SELECT SET_Section.SectionName, SET_Section.SectionID, SET_Department.DepartmentID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal, HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay
FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.departmentID = SET_Department.departmentID and SET_Section.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID)
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} ) TABSb ) TABSc group by TABSc.DepartmentID,TABSc.SectionID,TABSc.SalaryDate,TABSc.DepartmentName,TABSc.SectionName,TABSc.Deductions

data.name: Query_GetBalncesofLoan
data.value:
Select SUM(GrossAmount) as Balance from (select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID --,ISNULL(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount - sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as GrossAmount, ,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount - isnull(( select sum(LoanDisburstAmount) from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail where HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID ),0) as GrossAmount,
'Balance' AS TopHeading,100 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID
where --(cast(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanPaidOn as date) Between @fromDate and @ToDate) AND --comment by Ali jaseem no need to filter dates HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID=@PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=@PayrollTypeID --Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode --,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode --,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount --,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ) as fintab

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalarySheet_ReportSectionWiseData
data.value:
SELECT case when TABSb.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TABSb.PayrollTypeId) when TABSb.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TABSb.PayrollTypeId) when TABSb.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TABSb.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (250 + PayrollTypeId) when TABSb.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) end as SortOrder, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, case TABSb.PersonTypeCode when 1 then 'Permanant' when 2 then 'Contract' when 3 then 'Daily Wages' when 4 then 'Seasonal Contract' when 5 then 'Seasonal Daily Wages' end as EmployeeType, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.DepartmentID, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName, TABSb.SectionName, case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal, TABSb.PayrollTypeID, TABSb.PayrollTypeCode,
(case when TABSb.Impact = 1 then TABSb.Description when TABSb.Impact = 2 then TABSb.Description when TABSb.Impact = 0 then TABSb.Description
else null end) as Deductions ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Amount when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Standard else null end) as DeductionsStandardAmount , TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay
from
( SELECT
HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_Department.DepartmentID, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, SET_Section.SectionName, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay
FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_SectionID and SET_Section.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID)
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 and HRMS_PayrollType.Isvisiable = 1
WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 {0} ) TABSb
union all
SELECT 200 as SortOrder, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, case TABSb.PersonTypeCode when 1 then 'Permanant' when 2 then 'Contract' when 3 then 'Daily Wages' when 4 then 'Seasonal Contract' when 5 then 'Seasonal Daily Wages' end as EmployeeType, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.DepartmentID, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName, TABSb.SectionName, case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount,
TABSb.DeductionAmount,
TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal, TABSb.PayrollTypeID, '90' as PayrollTypeCode,
(case when (TABSb.GrossAmount <> 0) then 'Gross Amount' end) as Deductions ,
(case when TABSb.GrossAmount <> 0 then TABSb.GrossAmount else TABSb.GrossAmount end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Standard else null end) as DeductionsStandardAmount , TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay
from
( SELECT
HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_Department.DepartmentID, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, SET_Section.SectionName, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay
FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_SectionID and SET_Section.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID)
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 and HRMS_PayrollType.Isvisiable = 1 WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 {0} ) TABSb
union all
SELECT 400 as SortOrder, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, case TABSb.PersonTypeCode when 1 then 'Permanant' when 2 then 'Contract' when 3 then 'Daily Wages' when 4 then 'Seasonal Contract' when 5 then 'Seasonal Daily Wages' end as EmployeeType, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.DepartmentID, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName, TABSb.SectionName, case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount,
TABSb.DeductionAmount,
TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal, TABSb.PayrollTypeID, '200' as PayrollTypeCode,
(case when (TABSb.NetAmount <> 0) then 'Net Amount' end) as Deductions ,
(case when TABSb.NetAmount <> 0 then TABSb.NetAmount else TABSb.NetAmount end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Standard else null end) as DeductionsStandardAmount , TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay
from
( SELECT
HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_Department.DepartmentID, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, SET_Section.SectionName, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay
FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_SectionID and SET_Section.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID)
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 and HRMS_PayrollType.Isvisiable = 1
WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 {0} ) TABSb
union all
SELECT 280 as SortOrder, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, case TABSb.PersonTypeCode when 1 then 'Permanant' when 2 then 'Contract' when 3 then 'Daily Wages' when 4 then 'Seasonal Contract' when 5 then 'Seasonal Daily Wages' end as EmployeeType, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.DepartmentID, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName, TABSb.SectionName, case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount,
TABSb.DeductionAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal, TABSb.PayrollTypeID, '280' as PayrollTypeCode,
(case when (TABSb.DeductionAmount <> 0.9) then 'Deduction Amount' end) as Deductions ,
(case when TABSb.DeductionAmount <> 0 then TABSb.DeductionAmount else TABSb.DeductionAmount end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Standard else null end) as DeductionsStandardAmount , TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay
from
( SELECT
HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_Department.DepartmentID, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, SET_Section.SectionName, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay
FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
--left join SET_Section on SET_Section.DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_SectionID and SET_Section.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID)
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 and HRMS_PayrollType.Isvisiable = 1 WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 {0}
) TABSb

data.name: Query2_EmployeeArrears_ReportData
data.value:
Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,Round(FinalTab.Amount,0) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking,FinalTab.TotalAmount as Arrears,Format(FinalTab.StartingMonth,'MMMM-yyyy') as Month,FinalTab.StartingMonth, DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo from ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.TotalAmount,tab.StartingMonth --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.ArrearsDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SD.TotalAmount,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount from HRMS_ArrearsDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_ArrearsHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.ArrearsHeaderID=HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_SD.CompanyID = HRMS_PT.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE -- DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND DATEpart(m, HRMS_SH.paymentDate) = @FromMonth AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.paymentDate) = @FromYear AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by ArrearsDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SD.TotalAmount,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.TotalAmount,tab.StartingMonth,tab.MasterSalary,tab.ArrearsDetailID
union all
select 350 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.TotalAmount,tab.StartingMonth --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as ArrearsDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount),0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SD.TotalAmount,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_ArrearsDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_ArrearsHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.ArrearsHeaderID=HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_SD.CompanyID = HRMS_PT.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE -- DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND --DATEpart(m, HRMS_SD.StartingMonth) between @FromMonth AND @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth) between @FromYear AND @ToYear AND DATEpart(m, HRMS_SH.paymentDate) = @FromMonth AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.paymentDate) = @FromYear AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0}
group by ArrearsDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SD.TotalAmount,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.TotalAmount,tab.StartingMonth
union all select 400 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount ,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.TotalAmount,tab.StartingMonth --, DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as ArrearsDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType ,MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS aMOUNT --,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount),0) AS aMOUNT ,HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SD.TotalAmount,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_ArrearsDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_ArrearsHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.ArrearsHeaderID=HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.CompanyID=HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_SD.CompanyID = HRMS_PT.CompanyID AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE -- DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND --DATEpart(m, HRMS_SD.StartingMonth) between @FromMonth AND @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth) between @FromYear AND @ToYear AND DATEpart(m, HRMS_SH.paymentDate) = @FromMonth AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.paymentDate) = @FromYear AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by ArrearsDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SD.TotalAmount,HRMS_SD.StartingMonth )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.TotalAmount,tab.StartingMonth,tab.MasterSalary
--union all
--select --210 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, --tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, -- tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking -- from (
--select --DISTINCT HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary, HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as ArrearsDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, --HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, --'Gross Payable' as DeductionType,(case when MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount)%10 = 9 then MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) else MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) end) as -- Amount,HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, --0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount --from HRMS_ArrearsDetail HRMS_SD
--Inner join HRMS_ArrearsHeader HRMS_SH -- on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID -- AND HRMS_SD.ArrearsHeaderID=HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID
--Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE -- ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID -- AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID -- AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1

--Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP -- ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID -- AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
--left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP -- ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode -- AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID -- AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID -- AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
--INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on --HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND --HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode --AND HRMS_SD.CompanyID = HRMS_PT.CompanyID AND --HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 --WHERE -- DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND --HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --HRMS_SH.Status = 1
--group by HRMS_EP.PersonID,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, --ArrearsDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount, --HRMS_SH.ArrearsHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, --HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking --)TAB --GROUP BY -- TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, --tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking

data.name: Query_DataHeaderDetailForPost2
data.value:
--declare @SalaryDate datetime --set @SalaryDate = '2021-11-30'
--declare @CompanyID int --set @CompanyID = 1 --declare @EmpStatusID int --set @EmpStatusID = 1
Select (Case When VoucherEntryType='S' then (GLAccountCodeOG + '_'+ Convert(varchar(25),PayrollTypeID)) else GLAccountCodeOG end ) as GLAccountCode ,* --,(select Description from [HRMS_PayrollType] where [HRMS_PayrollType].PayrollTypeID = TabFinal.PayrollTypeID) as PayrollTypeName --,(select Abbreviation from [HRMS_PayrollType] where [HRMS_PayrollType].PayrollTypeID = TabFinal.PayrollTypeID) as PayrollTypeAbr from (
SELECT *
FROM ( SELECT SH.CompanyID ,SH.PeriodID ,SH.SalaryHeaderID ,SD.SalaryDetailID , SH.SalaryDate ,SH.SalaryType ,EMP.PersonID ,PT.PayrollTypeCode , PT.PayrollTypeID ,PT.IsEmployeePart ,PT.ChartOfAccountID AS GLAccountID , ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLEmpAccountCode ,PT.GLCodeCombinationID AS GLAccountCodeOG , PT.GLImpact , --Round(SD.Amount ,0) AS GLAmount ,
(Round(SD.Amount ,0) + case When PT.Abbreviation = 'PFC' Then (isnull((select (Amount) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner inner join hrms_payrolltype on hrms_payrolltype.payrolltypeid = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.payrolltypeid and hrms_payrolltype.payrolltypecode = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.payrolltypecode where hrms_payrolltype.Abbreviation = 'PF' --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.PayRollTypeID = 34 and month(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.FromDate) = MONTH(@SalaryDate) and Year(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.FromDate) = Year(@SalaryDate) and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.ToPersonID) = EMP.PersonID and (HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.Status) = 1),0)) else 0 end) AS GLAmount ,
