JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] PT ON PT.PayrollTypeID = SD.PayrollTypeID AND PT.PayrollTypeCode = SD.PayrollTypeCode WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate and SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ( EMP.StatusID = @EmpStatusID OR @EmpStatusID IS NULL ) AND SD.Amount <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT SH.CompanyID ,SH.PeriodID ,SH.SalaryHeaderID ,SD.SalaryDetailID ,SH.SalaryDate ,SH.SalaryType , EMP.PersonID ,PT.PayrollTypeCode ,PT.PayrollTypeID ,PT.IsEmployeePart ,PT.ChartOfAccountID AS GLAccountID , ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLEmpAccountCode ,HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.GLcodecombination AS GLCodeTwo , PT.GLImpactTwo ,case when pt.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then Round(SD.Amount ,0) * (-1) else --Round(SD.Amount ,0) (Round(SD.Amount ,0) + case When PT.Abbreviation = 'PFC' Then (isnull((select (Amount) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner inner join hrms_payrolltype on hrms_payrolltype.payrolltypeid = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.payrolltypeid and hrms_payrolltype.payrolltypecode = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.payrolltypecode where hrms_payrolltype.Abbreviation = 'PF' --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.PayRollTypeID = 34 and month(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.FromDate) = MONTH(@SalaryDate) and Year(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.FromDate) = Year(@SalaryDate) and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.ToPersonID) = EMP.PersonID and (HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.Status) = 1),0)) else 0 end)
end AS GLAmount ,ARC.CustomerName ,EMP.CostCenterID ,EMP.FK_DepartmentID, case when pt.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then 'M' ELSE '' END AS VoucherEntryType ,SH.CreatedBy ,SH.CreatedByValue FROM [HRMS_SalaryHeader] SH INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EMP ON EMP.PersonID = SH.PersonID and EMP.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ARC ON ARC.CustomerID = EMP.FK_CustomerID INNER JOIN [HRMS_SalaryDetail] SD ON SD.SalaryHeaderID = SH.SalaryHeaderID and SD.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID and SD.PeriodID = SH.PeriodID INNER JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] PT ON PT.PayrollTypeID = SD.PayrollTypeID AND PT.PayrollTypeCode = SD.PayrollTypeCode INNER JOIN HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail ON HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.PayrollTypeID = PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.EmployeeStatusCode = EMP.StatusID AND HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.ExpenseTypeID = EMP.ExpenseTypeID AND HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.Status = 1 WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate and SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ( EMP.StatusID = @EmpStatusID OR @EmpStatusID IS NULL ) AND SD.Amount <> 0 UNION ALL
SELECT SH.CompanyID ,SH.PeriodID ,SH.SalaryHeaderID ,SD.SalaryDetailID ,SH.SalaryDate ,SH.SalaryType , EMP.PersonID ,PT.PayrollTypeCode ,PT.PayrollTypeID ,PT.IsEmployeePart ,PT.ChartOfAccountID AS GLAccountID , ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLEmpAccountCode ,ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLAccountCodeOG , 'Debit' AS GLImpact , --Round(SD.Amount ,0) AS GLAmount , (Round(SD.Amount ,0) + case When PT.Abbreviation = 'PFC' Then (isnull((select (Amount) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner inner join hrms_payrolltype on hrms_payrolltype.payrolltypeid = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.payrolltypeid and hrms_payrolltype.payrolltypecode = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.payrolltypecode where hrms_payrolltype.Abbreviation = 'PF' --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.PayRollTypeID = 34 and month(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.FromDate) = MONTH(@SalaryDate) and Year(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.FromDate) = Year(@SalaryDate) and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.ToPersonID) = EMP.PersonID and (HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeductioninner.Status) = 1),0)) else 0 end) AS GLAmount , ARC.CustomerName ,EMP.CostCenterID ,EMP.FK_DepartmentID, 'M' AS VoucherEntryType ,SH.CreatedBy ,SH.CreatedByValue FROM [HRMS_SalaryHeader] SH INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EMP ON EMP.PersonID = SH.PersonID and EMP.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ARC ON ARC.CustomerID = EMP.FK_CustomerID INNER JOIN [HRMS_SalaryDetail] SD ON SD.SalaryHeaderID = SH.SalaryHeaderID and SD.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID and SD.PeriodID = SH.PeriodID INNER JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] PT ON PT.PayrollTypeID = SD.PayrollTypeID AND PT.PayrollTypeCode = 5 WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate and SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SD.Amount <> 0 AND ( EMP.StatusID = @EmpStatusID OR @EmpStatusID IS NULL ) ) TAB WHERE VoucherEntryType <> 'M' UNION ALL SELECT TAB.CompanyID ,TAB.PeriodID ,TAB.SalaryHeaderID ,MIN(TAB.SalaryDetailID) AS SalaryDetailID , TAB.SalaryDate ,TAB.SalaryType ,TAB.PersonID ,MIN(TAB.PayrollTypeCode) AS PayrollTypeCode ,MIN(TAB.PayrollTypeID) AS PayrollTypeID , TAB.IsEmployeePart ,TAB.GLAccountID ,TAB.GLEmpAccountCode ,TAB.GLAccountCodeOG as GLAccountCodeOG , 'Credit' AS GLImpact ,SUM(Round(TAB.GLAmount ,0)) AS GLAmount ,TAB.CustomerName ,TAB.CostCenterID ,FK_DepartmentID,TAB.VoucherEntryType ,TAB.CreatedBy ,TAB.CreatedByValue FROM ( SELECT SH.CompanyID ,SH.PeriodID ,SH.SalaryHeaderID ,SD.SalaryDetailID ,SH.SalaryDate ,SH.SalaryType ,EMP.PersonID , PT.PayrollTypeCode ,PT.PayrollTypeID ,PT.IsEmployeePart ,PT.ChartOfAccountID AS GLAccountID , ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLEmpAccountCode ,PT.GLCodeCombinationID AS GLAccountCodeOG , PT.GLImpact ,Round(SD.Amount ,0) AS GLAmount ,ARC.CustomerName , EMP.CostCenterID ,EMP.FK_DepartmentID, CASE WHEN PT.Description LIKE '%EOBI%' THEN 'S' When PT.Description like '%PF%' Then 'S' WHEN PT.Description LIKE '%BASIC%' THEN 'M' ELSE '' END AS VoucherEntryType ,SH.CreatedBy ,SH.CreatedByValue FROM [HRMS_SalaryHeader] SH INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EMP ON EMP.PersonID = SH.PersonID and EMP.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ARC ON ARC.CustomerID = EMP.FK_CustomerID INNER JOIN [HRMS_SalaryDetail] SD ON SD.SalaryHeaderID = SH.SalaryHeaderID and SD.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID and SD.PeriodID = SH.PeriodID INNER JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] PT ON PT.PayrollTypeID = SD.PayrollTypeID AND PT.PayrollTypeCode = SD.PayrollTypeCode WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate and SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ( EMP.StatusID = @EmpStatusID OR @EmpStatusID IS NULL ) AND SD.Amount <> 0 UNION ALL
SELECT SH.CompanyID ,SH.PeriodID ,SH.SalaryHeaderID ,SD.SalaryDetailID ,SH.SalaryDate ,SH.SalaryType ,EMP.PersonID , PT.PayrollTypeCode ,PT.PayrollTypeID ,PT.IsEmployeePart ,PT.ChartOfAccountID AS GLAccountID , ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLEmpAccountCode ,HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.GLcodecombination AS GLCodeTwo , PT.GLImpactTwo ,case when pt.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then Round(SD.Amount ,0) * (-1) else Round(SD.Amount ,0) end AS GLAmount ,ARC.CustomerName ,EMP.CostCenterID ,EMP.FK_DepartmentID,case when pt.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then 'M' ELSE '' END AS VoucherEntryType ,SH.CreatedBy ,SH.CreatedByValue
FROM [HRMS_SalaryHeader] SH INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EMP ON EMP.PersonID = SH.PersonID and EMP.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ARC ON ARC.CustomerID = EMP.FK_CustomerID INNER JOIN [HRMS_SalaryDetail] SD ON SD.SalaryHeaderID = SH.SalaryHeaderID and SD.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID and SD.PeriodID = SH.PeriodID INNER JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] PT ON PT.PayrollTypeID = SD.PayrollTypeID AND PT.PayrollTypeCode = SD.PayrollTypeCode INNER JOIN HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail ON HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.PayrollTypeID = PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.EmployeeStatusCode = EMP.StatusID AND HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.ExpenseTypeID = EMP.ExpenseTypeID AND HRMS_PayRollTypeDetail.Status = 1 WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate and SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ( EMP.StatusID = @EmpStatusID OR @EmpStatusID IS NULL ) AND SD.Amount <> 0 UNION ALL
SELECT SH.CompanyID ,SH.PeriodID ,SH.SalaryHeaderID ,SD.SalaryDetailID ,SH.SalaryDate ,SH.SalaryType ,EMP.PersonID , PT.PayrollTypeCode ,PT.PayrollTypeID ,PT.IsEmployeePart ,PT.ChartOfAccountID AS GLAccountID , ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLEmpAccountCode ,ARC.CustomerAccountCCID AS GLAccountCodeOG ,'Debit' AS GLImpact , Round(SD.Amount * ( -1 ) ,0) AS GLAmount ,ARC.CustomerName ,EMP.CostCenterID ,EMP.FK_DepartmentID,'M' AS VoucherEntryType ,SH.CreatedBy ,SH.CreatedByValue FROM [HRMS_SalaryHeader] SH INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EMP ON EMP.PersonID = SH.PersonID and EMP.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ARC ON ARC.CustomerID = EMP.FK_CustomerID INNER JOIN [HRMS_SalaryDetail] SD ON SD.SalaryHeaderID = SH.SalaryHeaderID and SD.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID and SD.PeriodID = SH.PeriodID INNER JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] PT ON PT.PayrollTypeID = SD.PayrollTypeID AND PT.PayrollTypeCode = 5 WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate and SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SD.Amount <> 0 AND ( EMP.StatusID = @EmpStatusID OR @EmpStatusID IS NULL ) ) TAB
WHERE VoucherEntryType = 'M' GROUP BY TAB.CompanyID ,TAB.PeriodID ,TAB.SalaryHeaderID ,TAB.SalaryDate ,TAB.SalaryType ,TAB.PersonID ,TAB.IsEmployeePart , TAB.GLAccountID ,TAB.GLEmpAccountCode ,TAB.GLAccountCodeOG ,TAB.CustomerName ,TAB.CostCenterID ,FK_DepartmentID,TAB.VoucherEntryType ,TAB.CreatedBy ,TAB.CreatedByValue ) TabFinal

data.name: Query_BonusBankAdvice
data.value:
select DISTINCT convert( varchar(20), HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID )+'-'+ convert( varchar(20), HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode )as PaySlipNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName --,case when HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,-1) else HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount end as NetAmount ,HRMS_BonusDetail.NetBonusAmount as NetAmount ,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo , AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName ,HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate ,HRMS_Set_Employee.IBanNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.CNICNumber --,HRMS_EmployeePayment.ChequeNo ,( select top 1 ChequeNo from HRMS_EmployeePayment where HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentPersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentType = 2 and HRMS_EmployeePayment.paymentheaderID in (select top 1 paymentheaderID from HRMS_EmployeePayment ep where ep.PaymentPersonID= HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentPersonID and ep.PaymentType = 2 order by createDate desc) ) as ChequeNo ,HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate ,HRMS_BonusHeader.CreatedByValue as UserName FROM HRMS_BonusHeader Inner Join HRMS_BonusDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = EmployeeID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_EmployeeType ON SET_EmployeeType.TypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonTypeCode AND SET_EmployeeType.Status = 1
--left JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayment ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentPersonID -- AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID -- AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentType = 2 -- AND convert(date, HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate) between '2023-10-01' and '2024-01-02' -- and HRMS_EmployeePayment.paymentheaderID in (select max(paymentheaderID) from HRMS_EmployeePayment ep where ep.PaymentPersonID= HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentPersonID and ep.PaymentType = 2 and convert(date, ep.PaymentDate) between '2023-10-01' and '2024-01-02')
where HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate = @FromDate And HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate = @ToDate --HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_Set_Employee.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo is not null and len(trim(HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo)) > 1 and HRMS_BonusHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID {0}

data.name: Query_BonusCashAdvice
data.value:
select convert( varchar(20), HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID )+'-'+ convert( varchar(20), HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode )as PaySlipNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName --,case when HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,-1) else HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount end as NetAmount ,HRMS_BonusDetail.NetBonusAmount as NetAmount ,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo , AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName ,HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate ,HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate ,HRMS_Set_Employee.IBanNo ,HRMS_BonusHeader.CreatedByValue as UserName FROM HRMS_BonusHeader Inner Join HRMS_BonusDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = EmployeeID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_EmployeeType ON SET_EmployeeType.TypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonTypeCode AND SET_EmployeeType.Status = 1
where HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate = @FromDate And HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate = @ToDate and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_Set_Employee.IsActive = 1 AND AR_SET_Bank.BankName like '%CASH%' {0}

data.name: query_EmpSalary
data.value:
Select Distinct Description,PayrollTypeCode,PersonID , CMDed ,ISNULL ((Select SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate between DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) and @fullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID is null and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND tab.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND tab.Description=HRMS_PayrollType.Description AND tab.PersonID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance, HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID ),0) as CMManualDed , PMDed+ISNULL ((Select SUM(LPD.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail LPD INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail LSD ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionDetailID=LPD.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader LSH ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.CompanyID=LSH.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HPT ON LSD.PayrollTypeID=HPT.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = LSH.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = LSH.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HPT.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HPT.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HPT.IsVisiable = 1 and LPD.LoanPaymentDate <= @fullDate And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND LPD.SalaryHeaderID is null and LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID = LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID and LPD.Status = 1 AND LSD.PayrollTypeCode=tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HPT.Description=tab.Description AND LSH.PersonID=tab.PersonID
group by HPT.Description,HPT.PayrollTypeCode ,LPD.Currentbalance,LPD.PreviousBalance, LSH.PersonID ),0) as PMDed,LoanAmount ,(Select sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as YTDDed from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3,5)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = year(@fullDate) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID=tab.PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description=tab.Description
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) as YTDDed
from (
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , SUM(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID
AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
)
,0) LoanAmount --,SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) as LoanDisburstAmount ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance --,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
--and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance != 0
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance
union all
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID
AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate )
,0) LoanAmount
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
) as tab

data.name: Query_DocumentTypeDirectInvoiceBonusposting
data.value: SELECT DocumentTypeID, DocumentType FROM [SET_DocumentType] where [DocumentType] like 'DI-Invoice (HR_Bonus)' and [CompanyID]=@CompanyID and [PeriodID]=@PeriodID and [MenuID] = (SELECT [MenuID] FROM [ApplicationMenu] where [MenuPath]='/HRMS/Payroll/Transaction/EmployeeBonusPosting_frm.aspx' and [IsEnabled]=1) order by [DocumentType]

data.name: Query_SalaryWagesTaxableLimit
data.value:
select Heading as Particulars,sum(Amount) as Amount from ( select 'Taxable' as Heading, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount
from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
inner join EMP_ExpenseType on EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.ExpenseTypeID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @fromDate and @todate And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=2 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax'
group by HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,EMP_ExpenseType .ExpenseType
union all
select 'Below Taxable' as Heading, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount
from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
inner join EMP_ExpenseType on EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.ExpenseTypeID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @fromDate and @todate and HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID not in ( select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=2 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax'
) group by HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,EMP_ExpenseType .ExpenseType
) as tab group by Heading

data.name: Query_DetailOfTaxReport
data.value:
select Heading as Particulars,SalaryMonth,sum(Amount) as Amount from (
select 'Taxable' as Heading, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount ,datename(month,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as SalaryMonth ,month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as MonthNo from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
inner join EMP_ExpenseType on EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.ExpenseTypeID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @fromDate and @todate And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=2 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax'
group by HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,EMP_ExpenseType .ExpenseType,datename(month,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) ,month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate)
union all
select 'Below Taxable' as Heading, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount ,datename(month,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as SalaryMonth ,month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as MonthNo from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
inner join EMP_ExpenseType on EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.ExpenseTypeID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @fromDate and @todate and HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID not in ( select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=2 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax'
) group by HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,EMP_ExpenseType .ExpenseType,EMP_ExpenseType .ExpenseType,datename(month,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) ,month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate)
) as tab group by Heading,SalaryMonth,MonthNo
order by MonthNo

data.name: Query_SummarySalaryWagesTaxableLimit

select 'Salaries / Bonuses' as Particulars , sum(Round(HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusAmount,0)) as Amount ,sum(HRMS_BonusDetail.InComeTax) as TaxDeducted,'' as Remarks from HRMS_Set_Employee
inner join HRMS_BonusDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID
inner join EMP_ExpenseType on EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.ExpenseTypeID where HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_BonusHeader.CreateDate between @FromDate and @Todate

data.name: Query_ReportOnTaxableExemptSalaryPayment
data.value:
select DISTINCT HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_EmployeePayment.ChequeNo,HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,sum(Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0)) as IncomeTaxAmount,sum(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount ,0 as ExemptAmount,0 as AveRate,sum(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) as TaxChargeable,sum(Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0)) as TaxDeducted ,sum(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) + sum(Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0)) as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 and HRMS_PT.Description like '%Income Tax%'
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayment on HRMS_EmployeePayment.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID = HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayment.PeriodID = HRMS_SH.PeriodID and HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1
WHERE HRMS_SH.CompanyID =1 AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate between @fromDate and @todate and HRMS_SH.Status = 1
group by HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_EmployeePayment.ChequeNo,HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate

data.name: Query_SalariesWagesBelowTaxableLimit
data.value:
select RowNumber,Heading,sum(Amount) as Amount,ExpenseType as Particulars from ( select 1 as RowNumber, 'Taxable' as Heading, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount ,EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseType from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
inner join EMP_ExpenseType on EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.ExpenseTypeID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and Year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = 2018 And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=2 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax'
group by HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,EMP_ExpenseType .ExpenseType
union all
select 1 as RowNumber,'Below Taxable' as Heading, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount ,EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseType from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
inner join EMP_ExpenseType on EMP_ExpenseType.ExpenseTypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.ExpenseTypeID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID not in ( select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=2 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax'
) group by HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,EMP_ExpenseType .ExpenseType
union all
select 2 as RowNumber,'Taxable' as Heading, sum(Round(HRMS_OverTimePostingDetail.OverTimeAmount,0)) as Amount ,'Overtime' as ExpenseType from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_OverTimePostingDetail on HRMS_OverTimePostingDetail.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_OverTimePostingDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID inner join HRMS_OverTimePostingHeader on HRMS_OverTimePostingHeader.OTPHeaderID = HRMS_OverTimePostingDetail.OTPHeaderID and HRMS_OverTimePostingHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_OverTimePostingDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_OverTimePostingHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_OverTimePostingDetail.PeriodID
where HRMS_OverTimePostingHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_OverTimePostingHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
) as tab group by RowNumber,Heading,ExpenseType
order by RowNumber
