Expenses%' inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%MEPCO & Misc Expenses%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName
union all
select 7 as Sorting,'Duty With MD' as Description, FullName as Name , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as Designation , 0 as OpeningBalance , sum(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount) as AdvanceDisursed , 0 as Adjustment , sum(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount) as ClosingBalance, '' as Remarks from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.LocationName like '%Site%' inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Duty With MD%' inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Duty With MD%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName )tab
group by tab.Sorting,tab.Description,tab.Name,tab.Designation , tab.Remarks

data.name: Query_BTLSalaryPayment
data.value:
select DISTINCT HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_EmployeePayment.ChequeNo,HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType ,sum(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) + sum(Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0)) as PaymentAmount, '' as ThumbImpressionSignature , '' as StampAffixed from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 and HRMS_PT.Description like '%Income Tax%'
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayment on HRMS_EmployeePayment.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID = HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayment.PeriodID = HRMS_SH.PeriodID and HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1
WHERE HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate group by HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_EmployeePayment.ChequeNo,HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate

data.name: Query_PODetailLocal
data.value:
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,INV_Item.Description,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PoNo,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as PoDate ,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.TaxAmount,(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice * AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity) as Gross,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount , isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
),0) as PaymentAmount
, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
),0) as Balance
from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobCode is not null
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%import%'
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
inner join INV_Item on inv_item.Itemid = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Itemid
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID= AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate

data.name: Query_PODetailImported
data.value:
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,INV_Item.Description,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PoNo,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as PoDate ,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.TaxAmount,(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice * AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity) as Gross,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount , isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
),0) as PaymentAmount
, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
),0) as Balance ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.LOCID as LCNo ,SET_Currency .CurrencyName from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobCode is not null
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%import%'
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
inner join INV_Item on inv_item.Itemid = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Itemid
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID= AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
inner join SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CurrencyID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate

data.name: Query_SalaryBreakUp
query_EmpSalaryHSM
data.value:
--declare @Month varchar(50) = 'October', --@Year varchar(50) = '2020', --@CompanyID int = 1, --@PeriodID int = 1, --@Months varchar(50) = '10', --@CurrentFiscalID int = 13, --@fullDate datetime = '2020-10-31 00:00:00:000', --@PersonID int = 552, --@PersonTypeCode int = null, --@StatusID int = null
Select Distinct Description,PayrollTypeCode,PersonID , CMDed ,ISNULL ((Select SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate between DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) and @fullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID is null and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} AND tab.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND tab.Description=HRMS_PayrollType.Description AND tab.PersonID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance, HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID ),0) as CMManualDed , PMDed+ISNULL ((Select SUM(LPD.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail LPD INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail LSD ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionDetailID=LPD.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader LSH ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.CompanyID=LSH.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HPT ON LSD.PayrollTypeID=HPT.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = LSH.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = LSH.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HPT.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HPT.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HPT.IsVisiable = 1 and LPD.LoanPaymentDate <= @fullDate -- And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} AND LPD.SalaryHeaderID is null and LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID = LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID and LPD.Status = 1 AND LSD.PayrollTypeCode=tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HPT.Description=tab.Description AND LSH.PersonID=tab.PersonID
group by HPT.Description,HPT.PayrollTypeCode ,LPD.Currentbalance,LPD.PreviousBalance, LSH.PersonID ),0) as PMDed --,LoanAmount ,(case when LoanAmount != 0 then LoanAmount else AdavanceAmount end) as LoanAmount ,(Select sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as YTDDed from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3,5)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = year(@fullDate) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID=tab.PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description=tab.Description
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) as YTDDed
from (
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , -- SUM(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate = @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and SH.status = 1 AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode --and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)CMDed, ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and SH.status = 1 AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode --and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
-- and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 -- And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
-- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID
--and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' )
,0) AdavanceAmount
--,SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) as LoanDisburstAmount ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance --,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
--and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance != 0
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID
union all
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID
AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate -- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' )
,0) AdvanceAmount
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like 'EOBI Company'
) as tab --where tab.PersonID = 552

data.name: Query_BonusEmployee
data.value:
Select Days, PersonID, CompanyID,-1 as BonusHeaderID,-1 as BonusDetailID, CEILING(BasicSalary) BasicSalary --,Case when Days >= @totaldays then CEILING(BasicSalary) else CAst(Round((CEILING(BasicSalary)/@totaldays) * Days,0) AS NUmeric(36,0)) end Bonus ,0 as Bonus , EmployeeName, EmployeeCode, JoiningDate, Eligibility, GrossSalary, EmployeeID, DesignationID, DesignationName, BonusAbsent, Action, StatusID, EmployeeStatusName, IncomeTax --, NetBonusAmount --, Case when Days >= @totaldays then CEILING(BasicSalary) + ArrearOfBonus - DeductionOfBonus - AdvanceSalary -IncomeTax --else Cast(Round((CEILING(BasicSalary)/@totaldays) * Days,0) + ArrearOfBonus - DeductionOfBonus - AdvanceSalary -IncomeTax AS NUmeric(36,0) ) --end NetBonusAmount ,0 as NetBonusAmount , ArrearOfBonus, DeductionOfBonus, AdvanceSalary, IsChecked, DepartmentID , Formula1 ,Formula2 ,Formula3 ,DeductionOfBonus as LoanAmount, 0 as Balance, DeductionOfBonus as LoanDeduction , LoanType, LoanTypeCode, IsEligibleForBonus from (
Select Distinct 0 as Days, HRMS_Emp.PersonID ,HRMS_Emp.CompanyID, case when HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount > 0 then HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount else HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount end as BasicSalary,
0.00 as Bonus, HRMS_Emp.FullName as EmployeeName, HRMS_Emp.EmployeeCode, HRMS_Emp.JoiningDate, 'True' as Eligibility, HRMS_Emp.basicSalary as GrossSalary ,HRMS_Emp.PersonID as EmployeeID ,HRMS_Emp.FK_JobDesignationID as DesignationID, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName As DesignationName ,0 as BonusAbsent, 'Add' as Action , HRMS_Emp.StatusID , HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployeeStatusName ,0 as IncomeTax,
0.00 as NetBonusAmount ,0 as ArrearOfBonus ,isnull((select SUM(DeductionAmount) from ( select PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LoanDescription, case when (sum(InstallmentAmount) * @NoofBonus) > sum(Balance) then sum(Balance) else (sum(InstallmentAmount) * @NoofBonus) end as DeductionAmount,LoanSanctionHeaderID,LoanDate ,sum(Balance) as ActualLoanBalance from ( select HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID,convert(date,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.loanStartDate) as LoanDate, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanDescription, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.InstallmentAmount, (HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount) -
( (isnull((select sum(isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanDisburstAmount,0)) from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.Status = 1 where HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID ),0)) + isnull( ( select sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction) from HRMS_BonusLoanDetail inner join HRMS_BonusDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail .BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail .BonusDetailID and HRMS_BonusDetail.status = 1 where HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID ),0)
) as Balance ,HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader
inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status =1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status =1
where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Emp.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Emp.CompanyID AND [HRMS_PayrollType].[PayrollTypeCode] = 5 and isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DeductionfromBonus,0) = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status =1 ) as tab where Balance > 0 group by PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LoanDescription,LoanSanctionHeaderID,LoanDate )AS Fintab),0) as DeductionOfBonus ,0 as AdvanceSalary, 0 as LoanAmount, 0 as Balance, 0 as LoanDeduction, '' as LoanType,'' as LoanTypeCode ,'false' as IsChecked ,HRMS_Emp.FK_DepartmentID as DepartmentID ,(case when @Formula = 'Bonus1' and isnull(HRMS_Emp.IsBonus1Assigned,0) = 1 then (select Formula from HRMS_PayrollType where PayrollTypeID = 26 and PayrollTypeCode = 1) else null end) as Formula1 ,(case when @Formula = 'Bonus2' and isnull(HRMS_Emp.IsBonus2Assigned,0) = 1 then (select Formula2 from HRMS_PayrollType where PayrollTypeID = 26 and PayrollTypeCode = 1) else null end) as Formula2 ,(case when @Formula = 'Bonus3' and isnull(HRMS_Emp.IsBonus3Assigned,0) = 1 then (select Formula3 from HRMS_PayrollType where PayrollTypeID = 26 and PayrollTypeCode = 1) else null end) as Formula3 ,AppointedOn ,HRMS_Emp.IsEligibleForBonus
from [HRMS_Set_Employee] HRMS_Emp
left Join HRMS_EmployeeAttendance On HRMS_Emp.PersonID= HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_Emp.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID And HRMS_Emp.Status=1 left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID= HRMS_Emp.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_Emp.CompanyID And (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID=2 --or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID=14 ) And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status=1 left join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Emp.FK_JobDesignationID And SET_JobDesignation.Status=1 Left Join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID =HRMS_Emp.StatusID And HRMS_Employement_Status.Status=1 Left JOIN [SET_JobCategory] ON [SET_JobCategory].JobCategoryID=HRMS_Emp.FK_JobCategoryID AND [SET_JobCategory].Status=1 left join SET_EmployeeType on SET_EmployeeType.TypeID = HRMS_Emp.PersonTypeCode and SET_EmployeeType.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID=HRMS_Emp.FK_DepartmentID And SET_Department.Status=1 Where HRMS_Emp.Status=1 and HRMS_Emp.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_Emp.jobendingdate is null And (HRMS_Emp.StatusID = @StatusID or @StatusID is null) And HRMS_Emp.IsBonusAllow = 1 {0} {1} {2} --and (HRMS_Emp.Formula1 = @Formula OR HRMS_Emp.Formula2 = @Formula OR HRMS_Emp.Formula3 = @Formula) )FinalFintab Where CompanyID = @CompanyID --and FinalFintab.Days >= @PresentDays and (Formula1 is not null OR Formula2 is not null OR Formula3 is not null) --and DATEDIFF(month, AppointedOn , @CurrentDate) >= 12 and IsEligibleForBonus = 1
order by EmployeeCode

data.name: Query_EmployeeBonus
data.value: select distinct 'Bonus1' as Formula , 1 as FormulaID from HRMS_PayrollType where Status =1 union select distinct 'Bonus2' as Formula , 2 as FormulaID from HRMS_PayrollType where Status =1 union select distinct 'Bonus3' as Formula , 3 as FormulaID from HRMS_PayrollType where Status =1

data.name: Query_GetPayrollByPersonIDForHabib
data.value:
Select (case when isnull(([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CalculatedAmount),0) > 0 then Round([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CalculatedAmount,2) else Round([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].ManualAmount,2) end) as Amount from [HRMS_EmployeePayroll]
JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] on [HRMS_PayrollType].PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID] Where [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[Status] = 1 AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsActive] = @IsActive OR @IsActive is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null) AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PersonID] = @PersonID AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].IsOneTime is null AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].Formula =@Formula

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalary_ReportData_AR
data.value:
Declare @IsActive int = 1; select case when tabtest.Allowances='Supply Days' then 0 when tabtest.impact = 1 then tabtest.PayrollAmount else 0 end as PayRoll ,* from ( SELECT TABSb.GrossValue, TABSb.JoiningDate, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.EmpAccountNo, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName,
case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount, TABSb.IBanNo, TABSb.BasicSalary, case when TABSb.GrossAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.GrossAmount,-1) else TABSb.GrossAmount end as GrossAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, case when TABSb.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.NetAmount,-1) else TABSb.NetAmount end as NetAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal,
TABSb.PayrollTypeCode, (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Allowances , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Description when '0' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Deductions , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Amount else null end)as AllowancesAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as CMDeductionsAmount ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount when '0' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount else null end) as PMDiscountAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then Isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) when '0' then isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) else null end) as TMDiscountAmount ,
TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay ,TABSb.YTD ,TABSb.NTNNo ,TABSb.CNICNumber ,TABSb.CompanyName ,TABSb.Email ,('PAY SLIP FOR THE MONTH OF '+ @Month+' YEAR '+ @Year) as ParameterReport from
( SELECT ( --select sum(isnull(CalculatedAmount,0)+isnull(ManualAmount,0)) select Round(sum(isnull(tab.CalculatedAmount,0) + ISNULL(tab.ManualAmount,0)),0) from ( select distinct HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Payrolltypeid, CalculatedAmount,ManualAmount from HRMS_EmployeePayroll left join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year where PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 )tab
) as GrossValue, HRMS_SET_Employee.JoiningDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmpAccountNo, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, HRMS_SET_Employee.IBanNo, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, (HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount) as NetAmount,
--(HRMS_SalaryHeader.daystotal - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent) - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP as DaysWorking , HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking as DaysWorking , HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,
ISnull(( select isnull(tab.Amount,0) from ( select distinct PMH.PersonID,PT.Description, Sum(PMS.Amount) as Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail PMS INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader PMH ON PMS.SalaryheaderID=PMH.SalaryHeaderID AND PMS.CompanyID=PMH.CompanyID and PMH.SalaryDate < @Date
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType PT on PMS.PayrollTypeID = PT.PayrollTypeID AND PMS.PayrollTypeCode = PT.PayrollTypeCode AND PT.Status = 1 and PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND PT.IsVisiable=1
where PMH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = PMH.CompanyID AND PT.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID
GROUP By PMH.PersonID,PT.Description )tab ),0) as PMDiscountAmount,
HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay
,( select sum(Amount ) as Amount from ( select distinct SDR.PersonID, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount ,PayType.Description,PayType.Impact FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader SDR
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on SDR.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and SDR.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on SDR.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND SDR.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [SDR].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType PayType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = PayType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = PayType.PayrollTypeCode AND PayType.Status = 1 and PayType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND PayType.IsVisiable=1
WHERE DATEPART(Year, [SDR].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND[SDR].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [SDR].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND [SDR].PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and [SDR].Status = 1 and PayType.Impact = 1 and PayType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode and PayType.Description = HRMS_PayrollType.Description )as tab )as YTD ,HRMS_Set_Employee.NTNNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.CNICNumber ,(SET_Business.BusinessName +'-'+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as CompanyName ,HRMS_SET_Employee.Email FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable=1
inner Join Set_operatingUnit on Set_operatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID
inner Join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = Set_operatingUnit.BusinessId
WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ([HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) ) TABSb )tabtest
-- Leaves Calculation --

-- inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and -- (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 -- AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) -- and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID -- WHERE -- (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear between @FromDate AND @ToDate) AND -- HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND -- (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) AND -- HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status = 1 -- AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Causal%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Sick%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Annual%' -- GROUP BY -- HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Description, -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
-- union all

-- Leaves Calculation --
DECLARE @FromDate date; DECLARE @ToDate date; DECLARE @Days varchar(2); DECLARE @PayrollTypeCode int =4; DECLARE @Years varchar(4) =@Year; SET @FromDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/01/' + @Years, 101) ); SET @Days=(Select DAY(DATEADD(DD,-1,DATEADD(MM,DATEDIFF(MM,-1,@FromDate),0))) ); SET @ToDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/' + @Days + '/' + @Years, 101) );
Select TAB.Description, SE.FirstName, SE.EmployeeCode, SUM(TAB.Quantity) AS QUANTITY, TAB.leaveDays, TAB.leaveDays - SUM(TAB.Quantity) as BalanceLeaves, SE.CompanyID, TAB.PersonID, TAB.PayrollTypeID, TAB.PayrollTypeCode, TAB.LeavelID as PayrollTypeID, TAB.Impact, Tab.Factor
from ( SELECT HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, isnull(sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity),0) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
FROM HRMS_EmployeeAttendance
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on -- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.[Status] = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) WHERE (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear between @FromDate AND @ToDate) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status = 1
GROUP BY HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor

group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor

--declare @Month varchar(50) = 'October', --@Year varchar(50) = '2020', --@CompanyID int = 1, --@PeriodID int = 1, --@Months varchar(50) = '10', --@CurrentFiscalID int = 13, --@fullDate datetime = '2020-10-31 00:00:00:000', --@PersonID int = 552, --@PersonTypeCode int = null, --@StatusID int = null
Select Distinct Description,PayrollTypeCode,PersonID , CMDed ,ISNULL ((Select SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate between DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) and @fullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID is null and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND tab.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND tab.Description=HRMS_PayrollType.Description AND tab.PersonID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance, HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID ),0) as CMManualDed , PMDed+ISNULL ((Select SUM(LPD.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail LPD INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail LSD ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionDetailID=LPD.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader LSH ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.CompanyID=LSH.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HPT ON LSD.PayrollTypeID=HPT.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = LSH.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = LSH.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HPT.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HPT.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HPT.IsVisiable = 1 and LPD.LoanPaymentDate <= @fullDate And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND LPD.SalaryHeaderID is null and LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID = LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID and LPD.Status = 1 AND LSD.PayrollTypeCode=tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HPT.Description=tab.Description AND LSH.PersonID=tab.PersonID
group by HPT.Description,HPT.PayrollTypeCode, --,LPD.Currentbalance,LPD.PreviousBalance, LSH.PersonID ),0) as PMDed --,LoanAmount ,(case when LoanAmount != 0 then LoanAmount else AdavanceAmount end) as LoanAmount ,(Select sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as YTDDed from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3,5)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = year(@fullDate) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID=tab.PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description=tab.Description
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) as YTDDed
from (
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , SUM(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID
AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
-- and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 -- And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
-- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' )
,0) AdavanceAmount
--,SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) as LoanDisburstAmount ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance --,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
--and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance != 0
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID
union all
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID
AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate -- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' )
,0) AdvanceAmount
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like 'EOBI Company'
) as tab --where tab.PersonID = 552

Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.FatherName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,Round(FinalTab.Amount,0) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.OTAmount,isnull(FinalTab.DedAmount,0) as DedAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking, --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName from ( DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY cast(EmployeeCode as varchar)) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName ,Leaves,TotalHours,OTHours,RatePerDay,DeductionHours,isnull(Advance,0) as Advance,isnull(Loan,0) as Loan,isnull(ManualAllowances,0) as ManualAllowances,isnull(ManualDeductions,0) as ManualDeductions , 0 as NetPayable from ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.OTAmount,tab.DedAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName,tab.Leaves , tab.TotalHours, tab.OTHours , tab.RatePerDay,tab.DeductionHours,tab.Advance,tab.Loan,tab.ManualAllowances,tab.ManualDeductions --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName,HRMS_SH.Leaves ,HRMS_SH.TotalHours,HRMS_SH.OTHours,HRMS_SH.RatePerDay, HRMS_SH.DeductionHours,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName --,(select Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinner --inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner on HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.SalaryHeaderID --and HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.Status = 1 --where HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID --and PayrollTypeCode = 5 and PayrollTypeID = 30 --) Advance , ,(select Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinner inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner on HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeCode where HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID --and PayrollTypeCode = 5 and PayrollTypeID = 30 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%advance%' and HRMS_PayrollType.Status =1 ) Advance ,
(select Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinner inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner on HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeCode where HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID --and PayrollTypeCode = 5 and PayrollTypeID = 30 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Loan%' and HRMS_PayrollType.Status =1 ) Loan ,
--(select sum(isnull(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinner --inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner on HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.SalaryHeaderID --and HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.Status = 1 --inner join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeCode --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayRollTypeCode = 1 --where HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SH.PersonID --) ManualAllowances , (select sum(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction where DATEName(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SH.PersonID ) ManualAllowances ,
--(select sum(isnull(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinner --inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner on HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.SalaryHeaderID --and HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.Status = 1 --inner join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeCode --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayRollTypeCode = 2 --where HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID --and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SH.PersonID --) ManualDeductions , (select sum(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction where DATEName(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayRollTypeCode = 2 and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SH.PersonID ) ManualDeductions , HRMS_SH.OTAmount,HRMS_SH.DedAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 and HRMS_PT.Description like '%Gross%Salary%'
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SH.Leaves,HRMS_SH.TotalHours, HRMS_SH.OTHours,HRMS_SH.RatePerDay,HRMS_SH.DeductionHours, HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName,HRMS_SH.OTAmount,HRMS_SH.DedAmount )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName,Leaves,TotalHours,OTHours,RatePerDay,DeductionHours,Advance,Loan,ManualAllowances,ManualDeductions,tab.OTAmount,tab.DedAmount
