--Declare @SalaryDate datetime = '2021-03-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int= 1
select tab.Sorting,tab.Description,tab.Name,tab.Designation,sum(tab.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, sum(AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursed , sum(Adjustment) as Adjustment , sum(tab.ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance , tab.Remarks from (
select t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation, SUM(t.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursed, t.Adjustment , (SUM(t.OpeningBalance) - SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed)) as ClosingBalance ,t.Remarks from ( select 1 as Sorting,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as Description, FullName as Name , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as Designation , isnull(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount,0) as OpeningBalance , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AdvanceDisursed , 0 as Adjustment , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as ClosingBalance, '' as Remarks from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.LocationName like '%head%' inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Executives%' inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Executives%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount )t group by t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation,t.Adjustment,t.Remarks
union all
select t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation, SUM(t.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursed, t.Adjustment, (SUM(t.OpeningBalance) - SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed)) as ClosingBalance ,t.Remarks from ( select 2 as Sorting,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as Description, FullName as Name , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as Designation , isnull(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount,0) as OpeningBalance , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AdvanceDisursed , 0 as Adjustment , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as ClosingBalance, '' as Remarks
from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.LocationName like '%head%' inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%House Construction%' inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%House Construction%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount )t group by t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation,t.Adjustment,t.Remarks
union all
select t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation, SUM(t.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursed, t.Adjustment, (SUM(t.OpeningBalance) - SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed)) as ClosingBalance ,t.Remarks from ( select 5 as Sorting,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as Description, FullName as Name , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as Designation , isnull(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount,0) as OpeningBalance , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AdvanceDisursed , 0 as Adjustment , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as ClosingBalance, '' as Remarks from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.LocationName like '%head%' inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and ( HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Mobile Bill Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%House Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Bike Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Car Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%PF Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Staff Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Bike Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Mobile Loan%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%INSURANCE DEDUCTION LOAN%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%CAR LOAN%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%CAR REGISTRATION DED LOAN%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%PF Loan.%' OR HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Staff Loan%' ) and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount )t group by t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation,t.Adjustment,t.Remarks
union all
select t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation, SUM(t.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursed, t.Adjustment, (SUM(t.OpeningBalance) - SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed)) as ClosingBalance ,t.Remarks from ( select 6 as Sorting,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as Description, FullName as Name , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as Designation , isnull(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount,0) as OpeningBalance , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AdvanceDisursed , 0 as Adjustment , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as ClosingBalance, '' as Remarks
from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.LocationName like '%head%' inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Others%' inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Others%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount )t group by t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation,t.Adjustment,t.Remarks
union all

left join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount )t group by t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation,t.Adjustment,t.Remarks

from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.LocationName like '%head%' inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Credit Card Advance%' inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Credit Card Advance%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1

data.name: Query_SummaryStaffAdvances
data.value:
--Declare @SalaryDate datetime = '2021-03-01 00:00:00:000' ----Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int= 1
Select final.Description , SUM(final.OpeningBalanceHO) as OpeningBalanceHO , SUM(final.OpeningBalanceSite) as OpeningBalanceSite
, SUM(final.AdvanceDisursedHO) as AdvanceDisursedHO , SUM(final.AdvanceDisursedSite) as AdvanceDisursedSite
, SUM(final.ClosingBalanceHO) as ClosingBalanceHO , SUM(final.ClosingBalanceSite) as ClosingBalanceSite ,(SUM(final.OpeningBalanceHO) + SUM(final.OpeningBalanceSite)) as GrandTotal from (
select --tab.Sorting, tab.Description --,tab.Name,tab.Designation ,sum(tab.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalanceHO , 0 as OpeningBalanceSite ,sum(AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursedHO , 0 as AdvanceDisursedSite --, sum(Adjustment) as Adjustment , 0 as ClosingBalanceSite , sum(tab.ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalanceHO --, tab.Remarks
from (
select t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation, SUM(t.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursed, t.Adjustment , (SUM(t.OpeningBalance) - SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed)) as ClosingBalance ,t.Remarks from ( select null as Sorting, 'Advance Against Expenses' as Description, null as Name , null as Designation , (case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end) as OpeningBalance , (case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end) as AdvanceDisursed , 0 as Adjustment , 0 as ClosingBalance, '' as Remarks
from GL_TransactionDetail
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and lower(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType) like '%ho%' and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%ADVANCES TO EMPLOYEES AGAINST EXPENSES%' and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @SalaryDate
)t group by t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation,t.Adjustment,t.Remarks
Union ALL
select t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation, SUM(t.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed) as AdvanceDisursed, t.Adjustment , (SUM(t.OpeningBalance) - SUM(t.AdvanceDisursed)) as ClosingBalance ,t.Remarks from ( select 1 as Sorting,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as Description, FullName as Name , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as Designation , isnull(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount,0) as OpeningBalance , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AdvanceDisursed , 0 as Adjustment , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as ClosingBalance, '' as Remarks from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.LocationName like '%head%' inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Executives%' inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Executives%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @SalaryDate group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName , SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount )t group by t.Sorting, t.Description, t.Name, t.Designation,t.Adjustment,t.Remarks

data.name: Query_PaySlipReportForAsadRice
data.value:
Declare @IsActive int = 1; select case when tabtest.Allowances='Supply Days' then 0 when tabtest.impact = 1 then tabtest.PayrollAmount else 0 end as PayRoll ,* from ( SELECT TABSb.GrossValue, TABSb.JoiningDate, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.CreatedByValue, TABSb.TotalShiftHours, TABSb.TotalHours, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.EmpAccountNo, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName,
case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount, TABSb.IBanNo, TABSb.BasicSalary, case when TABSb.GrossAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.GrossAmount,-1) else TABSb.GrossAmount end as GrossAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, case when TABSb.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.NetAmount,-1) else TABSb.NetAmount end as NetAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal,
TABSb.PayrollTypeCode, TABSb.Description as Allowances, --(case TABSb.Impact -- when '1' then TABSb.Description -- else null end)as Allowances , --(case TABSb.Impact -- when '1' then (case when TABSb.Description like '%allowa%' then 'Manual Allowance' else TABSb.Description end ) -- else null end)as Allowances , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Description when '0' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Deductions , --(case TABSb.Impact -- when '1' then TABSb.Amount -- else null end)as AllowancesAmount , --(case when TABSb.Description like '%allowa%' then (case TABSb.Impact -- when '1' then TABSb.ManualAllowances --else null end) else --TABSb.AmountGross end) as AllowancesAmount, (case when description not like 'Gross Salary' then ManualAllowances else BasicSalary end) as AllowancesAmount, (case when description not like 'Gross Salary' then TotalManualAllowances else 0 end) as TotalManualAllowances, (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as CMDeductionsAmount ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount when '0' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount else null end) as PMDiscountAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then Isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) when '0' then isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) else null end) as TMDiscountAmount ,
TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay ,TABSb.YTD ,TABSb.NTNNo ,TABSb.CNICNumber ,TABSb.CompanyName ,TABSb.Email ,('PAY SLIP FOR THE MONTH OF '+ @Month+' YEAR '+ @Year) as ParameterReport ,isnull(ManualDeductions,0) as ManualDeductions,isnull(ManualAllowances,0) as ManualAllowances,isnull(Advance,0) as Advance ,TABSb.OTAmount, TABSb.DedAmount, TABSb.LocationName as LoactionName, TABSb.LogoImage as LogoImage ,TABSb.EmployeeStatus as EmployeeStatus , 0 as OverTimeAmount from
( SELECT ( --select sum(isnull(CalculatedAmount,0)+isnull(ManualAmount,0)) select Round(sum(isnull(tab.CalculatedAmount,0) + ISNULL(tab.ManualAmount,0)),0) from ( select distinct HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Payrolltypeid, CalculatedAmount,ManualAmount from HRMS_EmployeePayroll left join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year where PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 )tab
) as GrossValue, HRMS_SET_Employee.JoiningDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.CreatedByValue, HRMS_SalaryHeader.TotalShiftHours, HRMS_SalaryHeader.TotalHours, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmpAccountNo, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, HRMS_SET_Employee.IBanNo, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, (HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount) as NetAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.OTAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DedAmount
,(select sum(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction where DATEName(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayRollTypeCode = 2 and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ) ManualDeductions,
(select sum(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction where DATEName(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ) TotalManualAllowances , HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount as ManualAllowances, (select Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinner inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner on HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetailinner.PayrollTypeCode where HRMS_SalaryHeaderinner.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID --and PayrollTypeCode = 5 and PayrollTypeID = 30 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%advance%' ) Advance ,
--(HRMS_SalaryHeader.daystotal - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent) - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP as DaysWorking , HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking as DaysWorking , HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.MasterSalary as AmountGross,
ISnull(( select isnull(tab.Amount,0) from ( select distinct PMH.PersonID,PT.Description, Sum(PMS.Amount) as Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail PMS INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader PMH ON PMS.SalaryheaderID=PMH.SalaryHeaderID AND PMS.CompanyID=PMH.CompanyID and PMH.SalaryDate < @Date

FROM HRMS_EmployeeAttendance

inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) WHERE (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear between @FromDate AND @ToDate) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status = 1
GROUP BY HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union all

from HRMS_LeaveRequest

group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union All
--CASE 1 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor, 0 as TotalWorkingHours, 0 as TotalShiftHours ,0 as PreviousLeaveBalance
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) inner join HRMS_PayrollType on -- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where (HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate between @FromDate and @ToDate)) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union All
--CASE 2 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,@ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor, 0 as TotalWorkingHours, 0 as TotalShiftHours ,0 as PreviousLeaveBalance
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) inner join HRMS_PayrollType on -- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where (HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate > @ToDate and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between @FromDate and @ToDate)) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union All
--CASE 3 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,@ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor, 0 as TotalWorkingHours, 0 as TotalShiftHours ,0 as PreviousLeaveBalance
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) inner join HRMS_PayrollType on -- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where
( HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >@ToDate) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union All
--CASE 6
-- Select -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID as PersonID, -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Description, -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, -- 0 as Quantity, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
-- from HRMS_EmployeePayroll
-- inner join HRMS_PayrollType on ---- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID and -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and -- HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 --AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) -- where -- (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) -- and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode
-- group by -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, -- HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Description, -- HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, -- HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
Select HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, --0 as Quantity, HRMS_SalaryHeader.Leaves as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.TotalHours as TotalWorkingHours ,0 as TotalShiftHours ,0 as PreviousLeaveBalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader
Inner Join HRMS_SalaryDetail On HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll On HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
left join HRMS_PayrollType on -- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null)
where (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.Leaves ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.TotalHours
union All
Select HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID as PersonID, 0 as LeavelID, 0 as PayrollTypeID, 0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Annual Leave' as Description, 0 as leaveDays, 0 as Quantity, 0 as Impact, 0 as Factor, 0 as TotalWorkingHours, 0 as TotalShiftHours ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.Leaves as PreviousLeaveBalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader
Inner Join HRMS_SalaryDetail On HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll On HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
left join HRMS_PayrollType on -- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null)
where (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate < @FromDate and DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year group by HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.Leaves ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.TotalHours ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID
union All
Select HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID as PersonID, 0 as LeavelID, 0 as PayrollTypeID, 0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Annual Leave' as Description, 0 as leaveDays, 0 as Quantity, 0 as Impact, 0 as Factor, 0 as TotalWorkingHours, 0 as TotalShiftHours ,0 as PreviousLeaveBalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader
Inner Join HRMS_SalaryDetail On HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll On HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
left join HRMS_PayrollType on -- HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null)
where (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) --and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 4 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.Leaves ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.TotalHours
)TAB
Inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee SE on SE.PersonID = TAB.PersonID and SE.CompanyID=@CompanyID {1} Group By TAB.PersonID, SE.EmployeeCode, --TAB.LeavelID, --TAB.PayrollTypeID, --TAB.PayrollTypeCode, TAB.[Description], --TAB.leaveDays, --Tab.Impact, --Tab.Factor, SE.FirstName, SE.CompanyID

data.name: query_EmpDeductionForAsadRice
data.value:
--declare @Month varchar(50) = 'October', --@Year varchar(50) = '2020', --@CompanyID int = 1, --@PeriodID int = 1, --@Months varchar(50) = '10', --@CurrentFiscalID int = 13, --@fullDate datetime = '2020-10-31 00:00:00:000', --@PersonID int = 552, --@PersonTypeCode int = null, --@StatusID int = null
select t.Description,t.PayrollTypeCode,t.PersonID ,(Case when (t.Description = 'Deduction Amount' and t.CMDed = 0 and t.PMDed != 0) then t.PMDed else t.CMDed end) as CMDed ,t.CMManualDed,t.PMDed,t.LoanAmount,t.YTDDed from (
Select Distinct Description,PayrollTypeCode,PersonID , CMDed ,ISNULL ((Select SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate between DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) and @fullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID is null and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND tab.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND tab.Description=HRMS_PayrollType.Description AND tab.PersonID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance, HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID ),0) as CMManualDed , PMDed+ISNULL ((Select SUM(LPD.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail LPD INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail LSD ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionDetailID=LPD.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader LSH ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.CompanyID=LSH.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HPT ON LSD.PayrollTypeID=HPT.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = LSH.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = LSH.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HPT.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HPT.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HPT.IsVisiable = 1 and LPD.LoanPaymentDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) --@fullDate And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) --AND LPD.SalaryHeaderID is null and LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID = LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID and LPD.Status = 1 AND LSD.PayrollTypeCode=tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HPT.Description=tab.Description AND LSH.PersonID=tab.PersonID AND HPT.Description not like 'Advance Salary'
group by HPT.Description,HPT.PayrollTypeCode --,LPD.Currentbalance,LPD.PreviousBalance , LSH.PersonID ),0) as PMDed --,LoanAmount ,(case when LoanAmount != 0 then LoanAmount else AdavanceAmount end) as LoanAmount ,(Select sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as YTDDed from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3,5)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = year(@fullDate) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID=tab.PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description=tab.Description and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) as YTDDed
from (
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , --SUM(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) CMDed , HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount as CMDed, ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate = @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID
AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
-- and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 -- And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
-- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select top 1 HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.loanamount from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate --DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0)
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' )
,0) AdavanceAmount
--,SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) as LoanDisburstAmount ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance --,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
--and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance != 0
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID
union all
select Description , PayrollTypeCode , PersonID , sum(CMDed) as CMDed , sum(PMDed) as PMDed , sum(TMDed) as TMDed , 0 as LoanAmount , 0 as AdvanceAmount from ( Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID
AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate -- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' )
,0) AdvanceAmount
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like 'EOBI Company' ) inittab group by Description,PayrollTypeCode,PersonID ) as tab --where tab.PersonID = 552
union all
select 'Deduction Amount' as Decription ,5 as PayrollTypeCode , HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , 0 as CMDed , 0 as CMManualDed, DedAmount as PMDed , 0 as LoanAmount , 0 as YTDDed from HRMS_SalaryHeader
--inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID --and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID --and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID --and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status =1 -- and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID )t

data.name: Query_SalaryBreakUp_AlNoor
data.value:
Declare @IsActive int = 1;
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SrNo, case when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+fintab.PayrollTypeId) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when fintab.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when fintab.DeductionType = 'Gross Payable' and fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (203) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ fintab.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory, fintab.PersonID, fintab.FullName ,fintab.FatherName ,fintab.EmployeeCode ,fintab.EmployGrade, fintab.DepartmentName ,fintab.JobDesignationName ,fintab.PayrollTypeID ,fintab.PayrollTypeCode , fintab.GrossSalary ,fintab.DeductionType ,sum(fintab.Amount) as Amount ,sum(GrossPayable) as GrossPayable from
( Select DISTINCT TAB.PersonID,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName ,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary as GrossSalary ,SET_Grade.GradeName as EmployGrade ,EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeID as PayrollTypeID ,EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode ,PType.Description as DeductionType ,Case when ISNULL(EmpPayroll.CalculatedAmount,0) > 0 then isnull(EmpPayroll.CalculatedAmount,0) else EmpPayroll.ManualAmount end as Amount ,0 as GrossPayable ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName from (
SELECT
[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[CompanyID], [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PeriodID] ,[EmployeePayrollID] ,[PersonID] , [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeCode] ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[Formula],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsPaid],[LeaveDays] ,IsNull(CalculatedAmount,0) CalculatedAmount ,IsNull(ManualAmount,0) ManualAmount ,Case Impact When 1 Then 'Positive' When 2 Then 'Negative' When 3 Then 'No Impact' END 'Impact' ,'False' IsIncomeTax ,HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable ,HRMS_PayrollType.IsPayable , IsNull([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CalculatedAmount,0) + IsNull([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].ManualAmount,0) as SBAmount FROM [HRMS_EmployeePayroll] JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 WHERE [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[Status] = 1 AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsActive] = @IsActive OR @IsActive is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime] is null or [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime] = '1')
) TAB
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.[PersonID] = TAB.[PersonID] AND HRMS_Set_Employee.[Status] = 1 AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.[IsActive] = @IsActive OR @IsActive is null) AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null)
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status =1 left join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID =HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll EmpPayroll on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID=EmpPayroll.PersonID and EmpPayroll.CompanyID =HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
inner join HRMS_PayrollType PType on PType.PayrollTypeID = EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeID and PType.PayrollTypeCode=EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeCode and PType.PayrollTypeCode <>4 where TAB.[PayrollTypeCode]=1 ---- HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName like '%IRFAN AHMED%' --SH -- HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName like '%Muhammad Adnan Shahid%' --and HRMS_Set_Employee.fathername='Abdul Aziz' --AKTS --HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName like '%Mr. Shameer Usman%' --HABIB {0}
union all
Select DISTINCT TAB.PersonID,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName ,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary as GrossSalary ,SET_Grade.GradeName as EmployGrade ,0 as PayrollTypeID ,EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode ,'Gross Payable' as DeductionType ,isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_EmployeePayrollinenr.CalculatedAmount,0)) + sum(isnull(HRMS_EmployeePayrollinenr.ManualAmount,0)) ) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EmployeePayrollinenr where HRMS_EmployeePayrollinenr.personid = EmpPayroll.personid and HRMS_EmployeePayrollinenr.PayrollTypeCode = 1),0) as Amount ,0 as GrossPayable ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName from (
SELECT
[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[CompanyID], [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PeriodID] ,[EmployeePayrollID] ,[PersonID] , [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeCode] ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[Formula],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsPaid],[LeaveDays] ,IsNull(CalculatedAmount,0) CalculatedAmount ,IsNull(ManualAmount,0) ManualAmount ,Case Impact When 1 Then 'Positive' When 2 Then 'Negative' When 3 Then 'No Impact' END 'Impact' ,'False' IsIncomeTax ,HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable ,HRMS_PayrollType.IsPayable , IsNull([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CalculatedAmount,0) + IsNull([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].ManualAmount,0) as SBAmount FROM [HRMS_EmployeePayroll] JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 WHERE [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[Status] = 1 AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsActive] = @IsActive OR @IsActive is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime] is null or [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime] = '1') and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.payrolltypecode = 1
) TAB
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.[PersonID] = TAB.[PersonID] AND HRMS_Set_Employee.[Status] = 1 AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.[IsActive] = @IsActive OR @IsActive is null) AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null)
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status =1 left join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID =HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll EmpPayroll on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID=EmpPayroll.PersonID and EmpPayroll.CompanyID =HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType PType on PType.PayrollTypeID = EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeID and PType.PayrollTypeCode=EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeCode and PType.PayrollTypeCode <>4 where TAB.[PayrollTypeCode]=1 {0}
) fintab
group by fintab.PersonID, fintab.FullName ,fintab.FatherName ,fintab.EmployeeCode , fintab.GrossSalary,fintab.DepartmentName ,fintab.JobDesignationName ,fintab.EmployGrade ,fintab.PayrollTypeID ,fintab.PayrollTypeCode ,fintab.DeductionType ,fintab.Amount order by fintab.PersonID

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalary_ReportData_AlNoor
data.value:
--declare --@CompanyID int = 1, --@PeriodID int = 1, --@UserID varchar(50) = 'a452fd2f-e6b4-4d5f-bee9-df5f23b99a59', --@Date date = '2021-12-31', --@Month varchar(50) = 'December', --@Year varchar(50) = '2021', --@IsActive int = 1, --@PersonID int= 158, --@PersonTypeCode int = null, --@Months varchar = '12', --@CurrentFiscalID int = 1;
declare @CompanyID int = @CompanyID_, @PeriodID int = @PeriodID_, @Date date = @Date_, @Month varchar(50) = @Month_, @Year varchar(50) = @Year_, @PersonID int= @PersonID_, @PersonTypeCode int = @PersonTypeCode_, @Months varchar = @Months_, @CurrentFiscalID int = @CurrentFiscalID_;
WITH CTE As ( select CompanyID, PeriodID, SalaryHeaderID, SUM(Amount) as Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail WHERE Status = 1 AND CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID AND PayrollTypeCode = 1 GROUP BY CompanyID, PeriodID, SalaryHeaderID ),
PAYROLLTYPEDED AS ( select PMH.CompanyID, PMH.PersonID, PT.PayrollTypeID, Sum(PMS.Amount) as Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail PMS
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader PMH ON PMS.SalaryheaderID=PMH.SalaryHeaderID AND PMS.CompanyID=PMH.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType PT on PMS.PayrollTypeID = PT.PayrollTypeID AND PMS.PayrollTypeCode = PT.PayrollTypeCode AND PT.Status = 1
WHERE PMH.Status = 1 AND PMS.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PMS.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND PMH.SalaryDate < @Date
GROUP BY PMH.CompanyID, PMH.PersonID, PT.PayrollTypeID )
Select PayRoll, GrossValue, JoiningDate, PersonID, PersonTypeCode, EmployeeCode, FullName, SalaryDate, JobDesignationName, DepartmentName, AccountHolderName, BankAccountNumber, EmpAccountNo, BankBranchName, BankName, PayrollAmount, IBanNo, BasicSalary, GrossAmount, DeductionAmount, NetAmount, DaysWorking, OverTimeHours, ArrearsDay, DaysAbsent, DaysLWP, DaysLate, DaysEarly, DaysTotal, PayrollTypeCode, Allowances, Deductions, sum(AllowancesAmount) as AllowancesAmount , AllowancesAmount_Arrears, DeductionAmount, AllowancesStandardAmount, CMDeductionsAmount, PMDiscountAmount, TMDiscountAmount, Impact, LeaveWithouPay, YTD, NTNNo, CNICNumber, CompanyName, Email, ParameterReport, sortingOrder
from (
select case when tabtest.Allowances='Supply Days' then 0 when tabtest.impact = 1 then tabtest.PayrollAmount else 0 end as PayRoll ,* from ( SELECT TABSb.GrossValue, TABSb.JoiningDate, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.EmpAccountNo, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName,
case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount, TABSb.IBanNo, TABSb.BasicSalary, case when TABSb.GrossAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.GrossAmount,-1) else TABSb.GrossAmount end as GrossAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, case when TABSb.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.NetAmount,-1) else TABSb.NetAmount end as NetAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.OverTimeHours, TABSb.ArrearsDay, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal,
TABSb.PayrollTypeCode, (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Allowances , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Description when '0' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Deductions ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '1' then --TABSb.Amount case when ((isnull(TABSb.ManualAmount ,0) = 0 and isnull(TABSb.CalculatedAmount ,0) = 0) or isnull(TABSb.IsProportionate,0) = 0) then TABSb.Amount else --((case when TABSb.ManualAmount > 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount else TABSb.CalculatedAmount end) / DAY(EOMONTH(SalaryDate)) ) * DaysWorking Amount end
else null end)as AllowancesAmount ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '1' then
case when isnull(TABSb.ManualAmount ,0) = 0 and isnull(TABSb.CalculatedAmount ,0) = 0 then 0 else
case when TABSb.Description like '%Basic Salary%' then ( case when abs(TABSb.ArrearsDay) > 0 then abs(ActualBasicSalary - TABSb.CalculatedAmount) else 0 end ) else
--(((case when TABSb.ManualAmount > 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount else TABSb.CalculatedAmount end) / DAY(EOMONTH(SalaryDate)) ) * DaysWorking --/ DAY(EOMONTH( (DATEADD(MM,1,SalaryDate)) ))) --* --TABSb.ArrearsDay
case when TABSb.CalculatedAmount > 0 then ( case when abs(TABSb.ArrearsDay) > 0 then abs(ActualBasicSalary - TABSb.CalculatedAmount) else 0 end ) else ( case when abs(TABSb.ArrearsDay) > 0 then abs(ActualBasicSalary - TABSb.ManualAmount) else 0 end ) end
end
end
else null end)as AllowancesAmount_Arrears ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as CMDeductionsAmount ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount when '0' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount else null end) as PMDiscountAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then Isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) when '0' then isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) else null end) as TMDiscountAmount ,
TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay ,TABSb.YTD ,TABSb.NTNNo ,TABSb.CNICNumber ,TABSb.CompanyName ,TABSb.Email ,('PAY SLIP FOR THE MONTH OF '+ @Month+' YEAR '+ @Year) as ParameterReport ,isnull(sortingOrder,999) as sortingOrder from
( SELECT ( select Round(sum(isnull(tab.CalculatedAmount,0) + ISNULL(tab.ManualAmount,0)),0) from ( select distinct HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Payrolltypeid, CalculatedAmount,ManualAmount from HRMS_EmployeePayroll
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode And HRMS_PayrollType.Status=1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year where PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 )tab
) as GrossValue, HRMS_SET_Employee.JoiningDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmpAccountNo, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, HRMS_SET_Employee.IBanNo, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,HRMS_PayrollType.IsProportionate,
ISnull(GROSS.Amount,0) as GrossAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount,
(ISnull(GROSS.Amount,0) - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount) as NetAmount,
(HRMS_SalaryHeader.daystotal - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent) - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP as DaysWorking , isnull((select sum(HRMS_OverTime.OverTimeHours) from HRMS_OverTime where PersonID=HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_OverTime.Status = 1 and @Month between DATENAME(month, HRMS_OverTime.FromDate) and DATENAME(month, HRMS_OverTime.ToDate) and @Year between DATENAME(YEAR, HRMS_OverTime.FromDate) and DATENAME(YEAR, HRMS_OverTime.ToDate)),0) as OverTimeHours,
isnull(( select sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity) from HRMS_EmployeeAttendance inner join HRMS_PayrollType arrearPay on arrearPay.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID where HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and arrearPay.Code = 4 -- Arrears and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear) = @Month and DATENAME(YEAR, HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear) = @Year ),0) - isnull(( select sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity) from HRMS_EmployeeAttendance inner join HRMS_PayrollType arrearPay on arrearPay.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID where HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and arrearPay.Code = 5 -- Deduct and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear) = @Month and DATENAME(YEAR, HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear) = @Year ),0) as ArrearsDay,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal,

Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.FatherName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,(FinalTab.Amount) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking,
(case when PayrollTypeCode = 1 then 1 when DeductionType = 'Gross Payable' then 2 when PayrollTypeCode = 2 then 3 when PayrollTypeCode = 5 then 4 when DeductionType = 'Deduction Amount' then 5 when PayrollTypeCode = 3 then 6 when DeductionType = 'Net Payable' then 7 when DeductionType = 'Employee Sign' then 8 end) as MainSortCategory,
--DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName from ( {1},SectionID,SectionName from ( select case when TAB.DeductionType = 'Basic Salary' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then 1 when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (100 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) then (1001 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (4000 +TAB.PayrollTypeId)
--when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) --when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) end as SortCategory,(tab.GrossSalary) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,(tab.Amount) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Cast(HRMS_SD.Amount as decimal(18,0)) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
LEFT JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON HRMS_SE.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New AND HRMS_SD.Status = 1 {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName
