EmployerPart, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryType, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EmployeeCode, [HRMS_Set_Employee].FullName, [HRMS_Set_Employee].FatherName, [HRMS_Set_Employee].NICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, [SET_Designation].DesignationName, [SET_Department].DepartmentName From [HRMS_SalaryHeader] INNER JOIN [HRMS_SalaryDetail] on [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID and [HRMS_SalaryDetail].Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 left join [SET_Designation] on [HRMS_Set_Employee].FK_JobDesignationID = [SET_Designation].DesignationID and [SET_Designation].Status=1 left join [SET_Department] on [HRMS_Set_Employee].FK_DepartmentID = [SET_Department].DepartmentID and [SET_Department].Status=1 JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_SalaryDetail].PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = [HRMS_SalaryDetail].PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 AND HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate >= @FromDate AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @ToDate AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3) AND HRMS_PayrollType.Abbreviation like '%PF%' AND (HRMS_PayrollType.Description Not like '%Contribution%') AND ([HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 {0} group by [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate, DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate) , [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryType, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EmployeeCode, [HRMS_Set_Employee].FullName, [HRMS_Set_Employee].FatherName, [HRMS_Set_Employee].NICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, Year([HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate),Month([HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate),DesignationName,DepartmentName, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate

[HRMS_Set_Employee].FK_DepartmentID = [SET_Department].DepartmentID and [SET_Department].Status=1 JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_SalaryDetail].PayrollTypeID AND Year([HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate),Month([HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate),DesignationName,DepartmentName, --[HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate

[HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EmployeeCode, [HRMS_Set_Employee].FullName, [HRMS_Set_Employee].FatherName, [HRMS_Set_Employee].NICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID and [HRMS_SalaryDetail].Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 left join [SET_Designation] on [HRMS_Set_Employee].FK_JobDesignationID = [SET_Designation].DesignationID and [SET_Designation].Status=1 left join [SET_Department] on [HRMS_Set_Employee].FK_DepartmentID = [SET_Department].DepartmentID and [SET_Department].Status=1 JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_SalaryDetail].PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = [HRMS_SalaryDetail].PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 AND <= @ToDate AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (1) AND HRMS_PayrollType.Abbreviation like '%PF%' AND ([HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsPFMember,0) = 1 {0} group by [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate, DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryDate) , [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryType, data.value:
Select tempEmpCount.NoOfEmployeesCurrent,tempEmpCountPrvs.NoOfEmployeesPrvs,(tempEmpCount.NoOfEmployeesCurrent - tempEmpCountPrvs.NoOfEmployeesPrvs) as
VarianceEmployee,* From (
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, DepartmentName, tab.CategoryID,tab.CategoryName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount, tab.Category
from (
select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID as CategoryID, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as CategoryName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as GrossAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as DeductionAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as NetAmount,'Current Month' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
​ inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2}) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID,HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID , HRMS_Employement_Status.Description )tab
GROUP BY tab.DepartmentID, tab.DepartmentName,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID,tab.CategoryID,tab.CategoryName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount, tab.Category
union all
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, --count(*) over(order by DepartmentName) AS 'NoofEmployees', tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, DepartmentName, tab.CategoryID,tab.CategoryName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
from (
select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID as CategoryID, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as CategoryName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as GrossAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as DeductionAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as NetAmount,'Previous Month' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL)AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID,HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description )tab
GROUP BY tab.DepartmentID, tab.DepartmentName,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID,tab.CategoryID,tab.CategoryName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
--union all
--select --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, ----count(*) over(order by DepartmentName) AS 'NoofEmployees', --tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, --tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, --tab.DepartmentID, --DepartmentName, --tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, --tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
-- from (
--select distinct --HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, --HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, --HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, --HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, --SET_Department.DepartmentID, --SET_Department.DepartmentName, --HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, --SET_Location.LocationID, --SET_Location.LocationName, --isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) --- --(select ISNULL(SUM(sh.GrossAmount),0) from HRMS_SalaryHeader sh --where DATENAME(month, sh.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND --DATEPART(Year, sh.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND --sh.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --sh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --sh.Status = 1 --and sh.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID --)
--as GrossAmount, --isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) --- --(select ISNULL(SUM(sh.DeductionAmount),0) from HRMS_SalaryHeader sh --where DATENAME(month, sh.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND --DATEPART(Year, sh.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND --sh.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --sh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --sh.Status = 1 --and sh.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID --) --as DeductionAmount, --isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) --- --(select ISNULL(SUM(sh.NetAmount),0) from HRMS_SalaryHeader sh --where DATENAME(month, sh.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND --DATEPART(Year, sh.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND --sh.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --sh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --sh.Status = 1 --and sh.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID --)
-- as NetAmount,'Variance' as Category -- from HRMS_SalaryHeader
--INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on --HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
--Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID --AND SET_Department.Status=1
--Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID --AND SET_Location.Status=1
--WHERE --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND --DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND --(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL)AND --(SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND --(HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID -- in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and StatusID = @StatusID or @StatusID is
--NULL )) AND --HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 --{0} --group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, -- HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, -- HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID,SET_Department.DepartmentID, -- SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, -- SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID -- )tab
-- GROUP BY -- tab.DepartmentID, -- tab.DepartmentName,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, --tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, --tab.DepartmentID, --tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, --tab.LocationName,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.Category
union all
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY DepartmentName) AS SeriaLNo, --count(*) over(order by DepartmentName) AS 'NoofEmployees', tab.FullName,tab.FatherName, tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, DepartmentName, tab.CategoryID,tab.CategoryName, tab.StatusID,tab.LocationID, tab.LocationName,
--(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthGrossAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthGrossAmount,0)) GrossAmount, --(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthDeductionAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthDeductionAmount,0)) DeductionAmount, --(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthNetAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthNetAmount,0)) NetAmount,'Variance' as Category sum(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthGrossAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthGrossAmount,0)) GrossAmount, sum(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthDeductionAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthDeductionAmount,0)) DeductionAmount, sum(isnull(tab.CurrentMonthNetAmount,0) - isnull(tab.PreviousMonthNetAmount,0)) NetAmount,'Variance' as Category
from ( select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID as CategoryID, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as CategoryName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as CurrentMonthGrossAmount,0 as PreviousMonthGrossAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as CurrentMonthDeductionAmount,0 as PreviousMonthDeductionAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as CurrentMonthNetAmount,0 as PreviousMonthNetAmount, '' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month1 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID,HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description
union all
select distinct HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID as CategoryID, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as CategoryName, HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, 0 as CurrentMonthGrossAmount,isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount),0) as PreviousMonthGrossAmount, 0 as CurrentDeductionAmount,isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount),0) as PreviousDeductionAmount, 0 as CurrentNetAmount, isnull(Sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount),0) as PreviousNetAmount,'' as Category from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month2 AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year2 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL)AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID=@DepartmentID or @DepartmentID is null)AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID in (select StatusID from HRMS_EmployeeInEmployement_Status where UserID = @UserID and CompanyID = @CompanyID {2} ) ) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 {0}
group by HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode,SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_Location.LocationID,HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID,HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID , HRMS_Employement_Status.Description
)tab

select * from (
select SET_Department .DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as Category,count(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) as NoofWorkers ,sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as Gross ,DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as SalaryMonth from HRMS_SalaryHeader Inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID=HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.status=1 and PayrollTypeCode = 1
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID LEFT join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1

Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
--left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP -- ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID -- AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID -- AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_SectionID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID Inner Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @CurrentMonth AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.status = 1 {0}
group by SET_Department .DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) union all

LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status = 1

left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_SectionID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID Inner Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and PayrollTypeCode = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @PrvMonth AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.status = 1 {0}
group by SET_Department .DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate)
union all
select DepartmentName,Category,sum(Current_NoofWorkers)- sum(Prv_NoofWorkers) as NoofWorkers ,sum(Current_Gross)- sum(Prv_Gross) as Gross,'Variance' as SalaryMonth from (
select SET_Department .DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as Category,
0 as Prv_NoofWorkers, count(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) as Current_NoofWorkers ,0 as Prv_Gross, sum(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as Current_Gross
,DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as SalaryMonth from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID LEFT join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1

left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_SectionID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID Inner Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @CurrentMonth AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.status = 1 {0}
group by SET_Department .DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate)
union all
select SET_Department .DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as Category,
count(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) as Prv_NoofWorkers, 0 as Current_NoofWorkers ,sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as Prv_Gross, 0 as Current_Gross
,DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as SalaryMonth from HRMS_SalaryHeader Inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID=HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.status=1 and PayrollTypeCode = 1 inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID LEFT join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1

LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
--left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP -- ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID -- AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID -- AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_SectionID
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID Inner Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and PayrollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @PrvMonth AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.status = 1 {0}
group by SET_Department .DepartmentName, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description ,DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) )as tab group by DepartmentName,Category
)as fintab

SELECT
FINTAB3.Heading, FINTAB3.Description, CAST(FINTAB3.Amount as decimal(18,0)) as Amount, FINTAB3.CostCenterName , FINTAB3.CostCenterID
from (
SELECT Heading, Description, MAX(Amount) AS Amount, CostCenterName, CostCenterID
from
(
--Allownces with Cost Center select 'Allowance' as Heading, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as Amount , SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 Inner JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in(1,3) inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1 inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) --and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate and DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month and DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ([HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 --AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null) --And (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
{0}

where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) -- and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate and DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month and DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ([HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 --AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null) --And (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
{0}

) as FINTAB

union

--,SUM(GrossAmountTaxable)-max(GAmount) AS PreviousTaxableGrossAmount, CostCenterName, CostCenterID

(

declare @Month varchar(50) = @Month_, @Year varchar(50) = @Year_, @CompanyID int = @CompanyID_, @PeriodID int = @PeriodID_, @Months varchar(50) = @Months_, @CurrentFiscalID int = @CurrentFiscalID_, @fullDate datetime = @fullDate_, @PersonID int = @PersonID_, @PersonTypeCode int = @PersonTypeCode_;
Select Distinct Description,PayrollTypeCode,PersonID , CMDed ,ISNULL ((Select SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate between DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) and @fullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID is null and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} AND tab.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND tab.Description=HRMS_PayrollType.Description AND tab.PersonID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance, HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID ),0) as CMManualDed , PMDed+ISNULL ((Select SUM(LPD.LoanDisburstAmount) CMDed from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail LPD INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail LSD ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionDetailID=LPD.LoanSanctionDetailID INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader LSH ON LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID=LSH.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND LSD.CompanyID=LSH.CompanyID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HPT ON LSD.PayrollTypeID=HPT.PayrollTypeID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = LSH.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = LSH.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
where HPT.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HPT.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HPT.IsVisiable = 1 and LPD.LoanPaymentDate <= @fullDate -- And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} AND LPD.SalaryHeaderID is null and LSD.LoanSanctionHeaderID = LPD.LoanSanctionHeaderID and LPD.Status = 1 AND LSD.PayrollTypeCode=tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HPT.Description=tab.Description AND LSH.PersonID=tab.PersonID
group by HPT.Description,HPT.PayrollTypeCode --,LPD.Currentbalance,LPD.PreviousBalance, ,LSH.PersonID ),0) as PMDed --,LoanAmount ,(case when LoanAmount != 0 then LoanAmount else AdavanceAmount end) as LoanAmount ,(Select sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as YTDDed from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3,5)
and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = year(@fullDate) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID=tab.PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = tab.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description=tab.Description
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) as YTDDed
from (
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , -- SUM(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader SH ON SH.CompanyID = SD.CompanyID AND SH.PeriodID = SD.PeriodID AND SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID AND SH.Status = 1
where SH.SalaryDate = @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode --and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)CMDed, ISnull(( select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader SH on SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.CompanyID = SD.CompanyID
inner join HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail on HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID = SH.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID = SD.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode = SD.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 where SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and SH.status = 1 AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
-- and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID -- and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 -- And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
-- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID
--and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 )
,0) AdavanceAmount
--,SUM(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount) as LoanDisburstAmount ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance --,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail,HRMS_Set_Employee where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (5) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisibleOnPaySlip = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
--and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance != 0
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Currentbalance,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PreviousBalance ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID
union all
Select distinct HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID , HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount CMDed , ISnull((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader SH ON SH.CompanyID = SD.CompanyID AND SH.PeriodID = SD.PeriodID AND SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID AND SH.Status = 1
where SH.SalaryDate <= @fullDate and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and SD.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryDetailID ),0)PMDed,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount + ISNULL((select sum(SD.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail SD,HRMS_SalaryHeader SH
where SH.SalaryHeaderID = SD.SalaryHeaderID and SH.SalaryDate < @fullDate
and SH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND SD.Status =1 AND SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode
),0) TMDed -- , -- ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from -- HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail -- where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 -- --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 -- and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate -- )
--,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like '%Advance%' )
,0) LoanAmount
, ISNULL(( select sum(loanamount) from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail,HRMS_PayrollType where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount=HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsDeductionCompleted = 0 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate <= @fullDate
and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Advance%' )
,0) AdvanceAmount
from HRMS_SalaryHeader,HRMS_SalaryDetail,HRMS_PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID =HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2,3) and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID
and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 --And (HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null) {0} and HRMS_PayrollType.IsEmployeePart = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisibleOnPaySlip = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = @fullDate and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description not like 'EOBI Company'
) as tab --where tab.PersonID = 552

data.name: Query_LoanAndRecoveryRegisterReportData
data.value:
Select PayrollTypeID, PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID, sum(OpeningBalanc) - sum(Amount) as OpeningBalanc, sum(LoanRecieved) as AmountRecoved , sum(AmountRecoved) as LoanRecieved, sum(ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance, sum(Amount) as Amount from (
Select FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType, FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, (Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc)) as OpeningBalanc, sum(FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved, sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved ,0 as ClosingBalance, sum(FinalTAb.Amount) as Amount --,(Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc + FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) - sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved)) as ClosingBalance
from (
---------------- For Opening Balance ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, sum(tab.OpeningBalanc) as OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved ,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved , 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
union all
select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved, isnull(Sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction),0) as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusHeader ON HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate < @FromDate AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
Union All
--- Amount --
Select tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved , sum(tab.amount) as Amount from (
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,0 as OpeningBalanc, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as Amount, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.AmountRecoved,Tab.Amount
union All
---------------- For Loan Recovered during the Year ------------------
Select -- LoanSanctionHeaderID,PayrollTypeID, PayrollType,EmployeeCode,PayrollTypeCode,FullName,OpeningBalanc,LoanRecieved, AmountRecoved,Amount * from
(
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,0 as Amount
--FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab -- group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.OpeningBalanc,AmountRecoved,Amount
Union All
---------------- For Loan Received during the Year ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, sum(tab.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved , sum(tab.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
union all
select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(Sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusHeader ON HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc,tab.Amount
)FinalTAb
group by FinalTAb.LoanSanctionHeaderID, FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType,FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc, FinalTAb.LoanRecieved , FinalTAb.AmountRecoved,FinalTAb.Amount
) tb
group by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID

data.name: Query_LoanAndRecoveryRegisterDetail_ReportData
data.value:
--declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate = '2021-01-01' --declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate = '2022-06-01' --declare @CompanyID int --set @CompanyID = 1 --declare @PeriodID int --set @PeriodID = 1
Select PayrollTypeID, PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName, sum(OpeningBalanc) - sum(Amount) as OpeningBalanc, sum(LoanRecieved) as AmountRecoved , sum(AmountRecoved) as LoanRecieved, sum(ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance, sum(Amount) as Amount ,(convert(date,'01-' + MonthWise)) as MonthWise from (
Select FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType, FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName, (Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc)) as OpeningBalanc, sum(FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved, sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved ,0 as ClosingBalance, sum(FinalTAb.Amount) as Amount , FinalTAb.MonthWise --,(Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc + FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) - sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved)) as ClosingBalance
from (
---------------- For Opening Balance ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, sum(tab.OpeningBalanc) as OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved ,tab.Amount , tab.MonthWise from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,
HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved , 0 as Amount , format(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate,'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate) --AND DATEPART(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) < @Month1 AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate < @FromDate --AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) <= @Year1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,format
(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate,'MMM-yyyy')
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount, tab.MonthWise
Union All
--- Amount --
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved , sum(tab.amount) as Amount,tab.MonthWise from (
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as
PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,0 as OpeningBalanc, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as Amount, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate) --AND DatePart(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) < @Month1 AND isnull(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) < @FromDate --AND datepart(mm, dateadd(mm,-1,'@@Month1') ) -- AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) < @Year1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0} Group by
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,'MMM-yyyy')
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.AmountRecoved,Tab.Amount,tab.MonthWise
union All
---------------- For Loan Recovered during the Year ------------------
Select -- LoanSanctionHeaderID,PayrollTypeID, PayrollType,EmployeeCode,PayrollTypeCode,FullName,OpeningBalanc,LoanRecieved, AmountRecoved,Amount * from
(
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as
EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,0 as Amount ,FORMAT(isnull(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate),'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,FORMAT(isnull(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate),'MMM-yyyy')
)tab -- group by
--tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.OpeningBalanc,AmountRecoved,Amount
Union All
---------------- For Loan Received during the Year ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount,tab.MonthWise from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as
PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, 0 as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount ,format(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate,'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,format(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate,'MMM-yyyy')
)tab group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount,tab.MonthWise
)FinalTAb
group by FinalTAb.LoanSanctionHeaderID, FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType,FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName, FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc, FinalTAb.LoanRecieved , FinalTAb.AmountRecoved,FinalTAb.Amount,FinalTAb.MonthWise ) tb
group by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName , MonthWise order by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName , MonthWise

data.name: Query_GetLeavesData
data.value:
select case when fintab2.CountAbsent = 1 then 'Absent' when fintab2.CountInLate = 1 then 'Late In ('+Time_IN+')' else '' end as A_LStatus , isnull ( fintab2.TotalLeaves ,0)- isnull( fintab2.AllLeavesAvail , 0 ) as LeavesRemaining ,* from (
SELECT
(select sum ( leavedays ) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll where PersonID = fintab.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status =1 and CompanyID = @companyId and PeriodID = @PeriodId and FiscalID = @FiscalID) as TotalLeaves, (select sum ( Quantity ) from HRMS_EmployeeAttendance where PersonID = fintab.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status =1 and CompanyID = @companyId and PeriodID = @PeriodId and monthyear between @FromDate and @ToDate ) as LeavesAvailforDate, (select sum ( Quantity ) from HRMS_EmployeeAttendance where PersonID = fintab.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status =1 and CompanyID = @companyId and PeriodID = @PeriodId ) as AllLeavesAvail, fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, fintab.UserName,fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,
--STimeIN,STimeOUT, ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,
--case -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < STimeIN then 'Early In' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) = STimeIN then 'On Time' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' -- else '--' --end --+ ' / ' + --case -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) = STimeOUT then 'On Time' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then 'Late Out' -- else '--' --end as AttStatus,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
--case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID)>0 then 'L' --else -- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 'W/O' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end --end as Status,
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status], CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(fintab.TimeInGrace),108) as TimeInGrace ,CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(fintab.TimeOutGrace),108) as TimeOutGrace ,fintab.ShiftID TerminalNo,
--count(LR.LeaveRequestID) as CountLeave, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
--case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, --case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) = STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
--case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) = STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Description,SET_DateTime.Reason , SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.CreatedByValue as UserName, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN, --CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as STimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT,
ETMS1.TerminalNo ,CONVERT(varchar(50),SS.TimeInGrace,108) as TimeInGrace , CONVERT(varchar(50),SS.TimeOutGrace,108) as TimeOutGrace ,SS.ShiftID from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in (@CompanyID)) {1}
and EP.Status=1 and EP.IsActive = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS_Shift on ETMS_Shift.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS_Shift.PersonID = EP.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift SS on ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime >= SS.FromDate AND ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime <= SS.ToDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on --PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1 {2} group by TheDate,fintab.UserName, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName, DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT, ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT, fintab.TimeInGrace ,fintab.TimeOutGrace ,fintab.ShiftID ,STimeIN,STimeOUT,fintab.TerminalNo ,fintab.Description,fintab.Reason ) fintab2 {3} Order by fintab2.TheDate,fintab2.EmployeeCode

data.name: Query_GetDataByPayrollTypeCodeHS
data.value:
Select EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,Gender,CNICNumber,DateOfBirth,EOBINo,JoiningDate,EOBIJoinDate,GrossAmount,NetAmount,sum(EmployerAmount) as EmployerAmount, sum(AmountofEOBI) as AmountofEOBI, DaysWorking,Years,Department from (
