Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount as EmployerAmount ,(Round(0 ,0)) as AmountofEOBI,--0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = 33 -- and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI%'
{0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,ManualAmount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
union All
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, 0 as EmployerAmount ,(Round(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount ,0)) as AmountofEOBI,--0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = 35 -- and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI Employee%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,ManualAmount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
) as tab
group by tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.Gender,tab.CNICNumber,tab.DateOfBirth,tab.EOBINo,tab.JoiningDate,tab.EOBIJoinDate,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysWorking,tab.Years,tab.Department -- ,tab.EmployerAmount

data.name: Query_EmployeeEarningcard_ReportHSM
data.value:
select * from ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType ='Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking, tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID ,MONTH(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Month,Year(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Year from ( select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,HRMS_SD.Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner Join SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
--SET_Location
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID
union all
select 350 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID ,MONTH(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Month,Year(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Year from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_Grade.GradeName ,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDate,tab.GradeName ,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID
union all select 400 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,TAB.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID ,MONTH(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Month,Year(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Year from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType, case when MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount)%10 = 9 then MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount) else MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount) end as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_Grade.GradeName ,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GradeName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDate ,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID
union all
select 210 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID ,MONTH(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Month,Year(tab.SalaryDate) AS _Year from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary, HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Gross Payable' as DeductionType,(case when MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount)%10 = 9 then MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) else MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) end) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE
HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
group by HRMS_EP.PersonID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary, SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode ,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID ) total where total.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} --where total.PersonID between 1 and 10 --and total.LocationID =2
ORDER by total.EmployeeCode,total.SalaryDate asc
---- 2nd Query
Select *, Month(FinTab.SalaryMonth) as _Month, Year(FinTab.SalaryMonth) as _Year From ( select DISTINCT 1 as SortCategory, CONVERT(datetime,(CONVERT(date,DATEADD(day, -DAY(DATEADD(month, 1, HRMS_BonusHeader.CreateDate)), DATEADD(month, 1, HRMS_BonusHeader.CreateDate))))) AS SalaryMonth, HRMS_BonusHeader.CreateDate, HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID,HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID,HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,--HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,
--HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID, isnull((HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusAmount),0) as BonusAmount, isnull((HRMS_BonusDetail.InComeTax),0) as IncomeTexAmount ,
HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_BonusDetail --HRMS_BonusLoanDetail Inner Join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID= HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID= HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID= HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.Status=1
left join HRMS_BonusLoanDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID --and HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID and HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_Set_Employee.status=1 AND HRMS_Set_Employee.IsActive=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner Join SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
--inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID
WHERE HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1 and --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND -- HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate >= @dateFrom and HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate <= @dateTo HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusAmount > 0 --and HRMS_BonusDetail.InComeTax > 0
{1}
)FinTab
Order by FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CurrentManulDate asc

data.name: Query_LoanAndRecoveryRegisterReportData_Detail
data.value:
--declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate = '2021-01-01' --declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate = '2022-06-01' --declare @CompanyID int --set @CompanyID = 1 --declare @PeriodID int --set @PeriodID = 1
Select PayrollTypeID, PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName, sum(OpeningBalanc) - sum(Amount) as OpeningBalanc, sum(LoanRecieved) as AmountRecoved , sum(AmountRecoved) as LoanRecieved, sum(ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance, sum(Amount) as Amount ,(convert(date,'01-' + MonthWise)) as MonthWise from (
Select FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType, FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName, (Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc)) as OpeningBalanc, sum(FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved, sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved ,0 as ClosingBalance, sum(FinalTAb.Amount) as Amount , FinalTAb.MonthWise --,(Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc + FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) - sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved)) as ClosingBalance
from (
---------------- For Opening Balance ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, sum(tab.OpeningBalanc) as OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved ,tab.Amount , null as MonthWise from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,
HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved , 0 as Amount , format(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate,'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate) --AND DATEPART(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) < @Month1 AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate < @FromDate --AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) <= @Year1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,format
(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate,'MMM-yyyy')
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
Union All
--- Amount --
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved , sum(tab.amount) as Amount,null as MonthWise from (
select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as
PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,0 as OpeningBalanc, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as Amount, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID
Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate) --AND DatePart(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) < @Month1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) < @FromDate --AND datepart(mm, dateadd(mm,-1,'@@Month1') ) -- AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) < @Year1 --AND (cast(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as date) < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0} Group by
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,'MMM-yyyy')
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.AmountRecoved,Tab.Amount
union All
---------------- For Loan Recovered during the Year ------------------
Select -- LoanSanctionHeaderID,PayrollTypeID, PayrollType,EmployeeCode,PayrollTypeCode,FullName,OpeningBalanc,LoanRecieved, AmountRecoved,Amount * from
(
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as
EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,0 as Amount ,FORMAT(isnull(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate),'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,FORMAT(isnull(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate),'MMM-yyyy')
)tab -- group by
--tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.OpeningBalanc,AmountRecoved,Amount
Union All
---------------- For Loan Received during the Year ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount,tab.MonthWise from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as
PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, 0 as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount ,format(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate,'MMM-yyyy') as MonthWise
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,format(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate,'MMM-yyyy')
)tab group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount,tab.MonthWise
)FinalTAb
group by FinalTAb.LoanSanctionHeaderID, FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType,FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName, FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc, FinalTAb.LoanRecieved , FinalTAb.AmountRecoved,FinalTAb.Amount,FinalTAb.MonthWise ) tb
group by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName , MonthWise order by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName , MonthWise

data.name: Query_GetEmployeeTaxAndSalaryHistory
data.value:
--Declare @PersonID int --set @PersonID = 112
--Declare @periodID int --set @periodID=1
--Declare @companyID int --set @companyID=1
--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int --set @CurrentFiscalID=4
--Declare @SalaryDate datetime --set @SalaryDate='2019-06-30 00:00:00.000'
Select Final.JoiningDate , Final.BasicSalary , Final.StartDate , Final.EndDate , Final.EmployeeType , (Final.PreviousMonthSalaires + Final.NextMonthsSalaries) + (select ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount),0) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayrollTypeID where --HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Arriars' and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable = 1 and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = Final.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = Final.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PeriodID = @periodID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = @companyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and Month(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = Month(DATEADD(MONTH,1,@SalaryDate)) and Year(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = Year(DATEADD(MONTH,1,@SalaryDate)) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsProportionate = 0 ) - Final.PreviousMonthTaxes as AnnualSalary ,(select ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Amount),0) from HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PayrollTypeID where --HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Arriars' and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable = 1 and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = Final.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = Final.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.PeriodID = @periodID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = @companyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and Month(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = Month(DATEADD(MONTH,1,@SalaryDate)) and Year(HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = Year(DATEADD(MONTH,1,@SalaryDate)) and HRMS_PayrollType.IsProportionate = 1 ) as TaxableAndProportionateAmount ,Final.PreviousMonthTaxes , Final.NextMonths , Final.FullName ,Final.PersonID
from ( select HRMS_Set_Employee.JoiningDate , HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate , SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate ,(case when HRMS_Set_Employee.JoiningDate between SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate and SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate then 'NEW' else 'OLD' end) as EmployeeType
,(select ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.MasterSalary),0) as PreviousTotalGrossSalary from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @companyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @periodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.status= 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate and SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate)
+
(select ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount),0) as PreviousTotalGrossSalary from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @companyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @periodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.status= 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate and SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate and HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable = 1)
as PreviousMonthSalaires
,(select ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.TaxAmount),0) as PreviousTotalTaxAmount from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @companyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @periodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.status= 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate and SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate) as PreviousMonthTaxes
--,DATEDIFF(Month,@SalaryDate,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate) + 1 as NextMonths
--,(DATEDIFF(Month,@SalaryDate,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate) + 1) * HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary as NextMonthsSalaries
,DATEDIFF(Month,@SalaryDate,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate) as NextMonths
,DATEDIFF(Month,@SalaryDate,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate) * HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary as NextMonthsSalaries
,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID from HRMS_Set_Employee inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @periodID and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = @companyID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID = @PersonID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status =1 )Final

Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.FatherName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,Round(FinalTab.Amount,0) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking, FinalTab.DaysWorkings2, --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName from ( {1},SectionID,SectionName,EmployementStatus from ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2 ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName,EmployementStatus --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName ,HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployementStatus from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_SE.StatusID
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName ,HRMS_Employement_Status.Description )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName,EmployementStatus
union all
select 350 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,FK_SectionID,SectionName ,EmployementStatus --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount),0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName ,HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployementStatus from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_SE.StatusID
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE
DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName,HRMS_SE.FatherName,HRMS_Employement_Status.Description )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID,EmployementStatus
union all select 400 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount ,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking, tab.DaysWorkings2 ,FK_SectionID,SectionName,EmployementStatus --, DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType ,MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS aMOUNT --,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount),0) AS aMOUNT ,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName ,HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployementStatus from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_SE.StatusID
