Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.fatherNAme,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName,HRMS_Employement_Status.Description )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID,EmployementStatus

data.name: Query_IncomeTaxDedMonthWise
data.value:
Select * from (
Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName DesignationName--,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType ,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0)) as Amount, --DATENAME(month,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as 'Month' format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, 'MMM-yy') as 'Month' ,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, 'MM') as 'Time' ,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, 'MM') as 'Year' , HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as Datewise ,'Income Tax' as Category, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID --and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode --AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID --AND Set_Designation.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID -- and Set_Grade.GradeName = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=2 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax' AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID= @StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 -- group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, --HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo, HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate
union All
Select Distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount, Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName DesignationName --,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType ,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, sum(Round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount, --DATENAME(month,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as 'Month' format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, 'MMM-yy') as 'Month' ,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, 'MM') as 'Time' ,format(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, 'MM') as 'Year' , HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate as Datewise ,'Gross Salary' as Category, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID --and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode --AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID --AND Set_Designation.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID -- and Set_Grade.GradeName = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode=1 AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID= @StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 --And HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like 'Income%Tax' and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 -- group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, --HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo, HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate
union All
Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_BonusDetail.GrossSalary) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_BonusDetail.NetBonusAmount) as NetAmount, Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName DesignationName--,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType ,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, sum(Round(HRMS_BonusDetail.InComeTax,0)) as Amount, --DATENAME(month,HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate) as 'Month' format(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate, 'MMM-yy') as 'Month' ,format(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate, 'MM') as 'Time' ,format(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate, 'MM') as 'Year' , HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate as DateWise ,'Bonus Tax' as Category, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender From HRMS_BonusDetail inner Join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID= HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID= HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID= HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.Status=1
inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_Set_Employee.status=1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID --AND Set_Designation.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID -- and Set_Grade.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Grade.status =1
Left JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = (Select PayrolltypeID from Hrms_Payrolltype Where Description = 'Income Tax' And Status=1 And PayrollTypeCode=2 ) AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 2 --AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
Where --HRMS_BonusDetail.PostedDate between @FromDate and @ToDate HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate >= @FromDate and HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate <= @ToDate and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID= @StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND (HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) --And HRMS_BonusDetail.Status=1 and HRMS_BonusDetail.InComeTax > 0 group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, --HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo, HRMS_BonusDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate,HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate
union All
Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_BonusDetail.GrossSalary) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_BonusDetail.NetBonusAmount) as NetAmount, Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName DesignationName --,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType ,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, sum(Round(HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusAmount,0)) as Amount, --DATENAME(month,HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate) as 'Month' format(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate, 'MMM-yy') as 'Month' ,format(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate, 'MM') as 'Time' ,format(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate, 'MM') as 'Year' , HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate as DateWise ,'Bonus Gross Amount' as Category, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender From HRMS_BonusDetail inner Join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID= HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID= HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID= HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.Status=1
inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_Set_Employee.status=1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID --AND Set_Designation.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID -- and Set_Grade.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Grade.status =1
Left JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = (Select PayrolltypeID from Hrms_Payrolltype Where Description = 'Income Tax' And Status=1 And PayrollTypeCode=2 ) AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 2 --AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4
Where HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID= @StatusID or @StatusID is null) AND (HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And HRMS_BonusDetail.Status=1 group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, --HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo, HRMS_BonusDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate,HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate
) tab
Order by tab.Datewise

data.name: Query_GetIncomeTaxEmployeesCertificate
data.value:
select CAST(Isnull(( Select SUM(ISNULL(tbl_BonusDetail.InComeTax,0)) from HRMS_BonusDetail as tbl_BonusDetail inner join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = tbl_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID and HRMS_BonusHeader.Status = 1 where tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And tbl_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID And tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @FromDate and @ToDate ),0) as decimal(18,2)) as IncomeTaxAmount ,
CAST(Isnull(( Select SUM(ISNULL(tbl_BonusDetail.BonusAmount,0)) from HRMS_BonusDetail as tbl_BonusDetail inner join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = tbl_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID and HRMS_BonusHeader.Status = 1 where tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And tbl_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID And tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and tbl_BonusDetail.Status = 1 ),0) as decimal(18,2)) as BonusAmount , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HRMS_Set_Employee.fullname asc) AS 'Row' , --HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, --HRMS_Set_Employee.NTNNo as NTNNo, SUBSTRING(NTNNo,1,7)+'-'+SUBSTRING(NTNNo,8,9) as NTNNo, case when len(CNICNumber) = 13 then SUBSTRING(CNICNumber, 1, 5)+'-'+SUBSTRING(CNICNumber, 6, 7)+'-'+SUBSTRING(CNICNumber, 13, 1) else CNICNumber end as CNICNumber ,fullname,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID,SET_City.CityName, HRMS_Set_Employee.AddressLine1, 'Individual' as status --, SUM(isnull(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0)) as MasterSalary,
,isnull(( select sum(SalaryDetail.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryHeader SalaryHeader inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail SalaryDetail on SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and SalaryDetail.CompanyID = SalaryHeader.CompanyID and SalaryDetail.PeriodID = SalaryHeader.PeriodID and SalaryDetail.Status = 1 where SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and SalaryHeader.Status = 1 ),0) + isnull(( select sum(HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Quantity) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll where HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 8 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID ),0)
as MasterSalary,
Sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0)) as Amount ,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine1 CompanyAddress,SET_Business.NTNNumber ,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as Designation ,@FromDate as FromDate ,@ToDate as ToDate ,@Date as Date from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID left join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CityID and SET_City.Status = 1 inner join hrms_payrolltype on hrms_payrolltype.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and hrms_payrolltype.Status =1 left join SET_Business on SET_Business.Status = HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status and SET_Business.Status = 1 inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and hrms_payrolltype.Description like 'Income Tax' and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @companyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID {0} group by fullname,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID,HRMS_Set_Employee.NTNNo,CNICNumber,CityName, HRMS_Set_Employee.AddressLine1,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine1,SET_Business.NTNNumber, HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID , HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName order by HRMS_Set_Employee.fullname asc
--- 2nd Query For MonthWise
select CAST(Isnull(( Select SUM(ISNULL(tbl_BonusDetail.InComeTax,0)) from HRMS_BonusDetail as tbl_BonusDetail inner join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = tbl_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID and HRMS_BonusHeader.Status = 1 where tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And tbl_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID And tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @FromDate and @ToDate ),0) as decimal(18,2)) as IncomeTaxAmount ,
CAST(Isnull(( Select SUM(ISNULL(tbl_BonusDetail.BonusAmount,0)) from HRMS_BonusDetail as tbl_BonusDetail inner join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = tbl_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID and HRMS_BonusHeader.Status = 1 where tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And tbl_BonusDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And tbl_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID And tbl_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID --And HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @FromDate and @ToDate And month(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate ) = month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) And year(HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate ) = year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) and tbl_BonusDetail.Status = 1 ),0) as decimal(18,2)) as BonusAmount , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HRMS_Set_Employee.fullname asc) AS 'Row' , --HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, SET_Business.NTNNumber as NTNNo, case when len(CNICNumber) = 13 then SUBSTRING(CNICNumber, 1, 5)+'-'+SUBSTRING(CNICNumber, 6, 7)+'-'+SUBSTRING(CNICNumber, 11, 1) else CNICNumber end as CNICNumber ,fullname,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, SET_City.CityName, HRMS_Set_Employee.AddressLine1, 'Individual' as status,
isnull(( select sum(SalaryDetail.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryHeader SalaryHeader inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail SalaryDetail on SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and SalaryDetail.CompanyID = SalaryHeader.CompanyID and SalaryDetail.PeriodID = SalaryHeader.PeriodID and SalaryHeader.Status = 1 where SalaryHeader.SalaryDate = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate and SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and SalaryDetail.Status = 1 ),0)as MasterSalary,
isnull(( select Top 1(HRMS_PayrollType.Description) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode where HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 8 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID ),0) as Description,
isnull(( select Top 1(HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Quantity) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll where HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 8 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID ),0) as Quantity,
Sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0)) as Amount ,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine1 CompanyAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber ,Datename(MM,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) as Months ,@FromDate as FromDate ,@ToDate as ToDate ,@Date as Date from HRMS_SalaryHeader inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID left join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CityID and SET_City.Status = 1 inner join hrms_payrolltype on hrms_payrolltype.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and hrms_payrolltype.Status =1 left join SET_Business on SET_Business.Status = HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status and SET_Business.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and hrms_payrolltype.Description like 'Income Tax' AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 8 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} group by fullname,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID,NTNNo,CNICNumber,CityName, HRMS_Set_Employee.AddressLine1,SET_Business.BusinessName,SET_Business.AddressLine1,SET_Business.NTNNumber, HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID , HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID order by HRMS_Set_Employee.fullname asc

data.name: Query2_EmployeeSalarySheetForDKSM
data.value:
Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.FatherName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,Round(FinalTab.Amount,0) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking, FinalTab.DaysWorkings2, --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName from ( {1},SectionID,SectionName from ( select case when TAB.DeductionType = 'Basic Salary' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then 1 when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (100 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) then (1001 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (4000 +TAB.PayrollTypeId)
--when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) --when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2 ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode not in (2, 4 , 5) AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName
union all
select 2000 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,FK_SectionID,SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (

where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount , HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID
) as tab

data.name: Query2_EmployeeSalaryWages_ReportData
data.value:
Select FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName,FinalTab.SalaryMonthYear, sum(FinalTab.Amount) as Amount, {1} from ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,(tab.GrossSalary) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SalaryMonthYear, tab.DeductionType,(tab.Amount) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,FORMAT(SalaryDate, 'MMM-yyyy') as SalaryMonthYear,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,(HRMS_SD.Amount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
LEFT JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON HRMS_SE.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,FORMAT(SalaryDate, 'MMM-yyyy') ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SalaryMonthYear,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName
union all
select 350 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SalaryMonthYear, tab.DeductionType,(tab.Amount) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,FK_SectionID,SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,FORMAT(SalaryDate, 'MMM-yyyy') as SalaryMonthYear,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,(MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount)) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
LEFT JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON HRMS_SE.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE
DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,FORMAT(SalaryDate, 'MMM-yyyy'),HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SalaryMonthYear, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID
union all select 400 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SalaryMonthYear, tab.DeductionType,(tab.Amount) as Amount ,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking ,FK_SectionID,SectionName --, DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,FORMAT(SalaryDate, 'MMM-yyyy') as SalaryMonthYear,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType , --MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS aMOUNT isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Amount,0))) from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr where --HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.PayrollTypeCode = 1),0) - isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Amount,0))) from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr where --HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5)),0) AS aMOUNT --,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount),0) AS aMOUNT ,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
LEFT JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON HRMS_SE.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} --group by --SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, --HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.fatherNAme,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, --HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking --,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SalaryMonthYear, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID

data.name: Query_Get_EmployeeAllowancesReport
data.value:
select EmployeeCode,PersonID,FullName,DepartmentName,LocationName,sum(BasicSalary) as BasicSalary,sum(Allowances) as Allowances, sum(Cola) as Cola , sum(TaxDedcuted) as TaxDedcuted, sum(PF) as PF, sum(Other) as Other , (sum(TaxDedcuted) + sum(PF) + sum(Other)) as NetSalary from ( Select HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, Set_Department.DepartmentName, SET_Location.LocationName, --HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary, isnull((select sum(Round(Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = 2 ),0) as BasicSalary, isnull((select sum(Round(Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID not in (6,7,8,9,10) ),0) as Allowances, isnull((select sum(Round(Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID in (6,7,8,9,10) ),0) as Cola
, isnull((select sum(Round(Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = 25 ),0) as TaxDedcuted
, isnull((select sum(Round(Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID in ( 26, 50) ),0) as PF
, isnull((select sum(Round(Amount,0)) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID != 26 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID != 50 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID != 25 ),0) as Other
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader ON HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID in (select SalaryHeaderID from HRMS_SalaryDetail where Status = 1)
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 1 --and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = 2 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID in (2,90)
left join Set_Department on Set_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and Set_Department.Status = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 {0}
)tab
group by EmployeeCode,PersonID,FullName,DepartmentName,LocationName
Order by cast(EmployeeCode as int) asc

data.name: Query_GrossSalaryMonthWiseReportData
data.value:
select Distinct HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID, Round(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0) as GrossAmount, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployeeStatus, DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) as Months , HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_LocationID, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName as EmployeeName, '-' as DirectorRemuneration, datename(m,[HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate])+' '+cast(datepart(yyyy,[HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) as varchar) as sortDate, Case when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'January' then 'A' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'February' then 'B' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'March' then 'C' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'April' then 'D' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'May' then 'E' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'June' then 'F' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'July' then 'G' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'August' then 'G' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'September' then 'I' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'October' then 'J' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'November' then 'K' when DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = 'December' then 'L' else '' end as Sorting, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(Order BY [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate] asc) AS SNO from HRMS_SalaryHeader Inner Join HRMS_SalaryDetail ON HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID And HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID And HRMS_Employement_Status.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID And HRMS_Employement_Status.Status = 1 and HRMS_Employement_Status.IsActive = 1
Where HRMS_SalaryHeader.[Status] = 1 And HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1 And HRMS_SalaryHeader.[SalaryDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate And HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount <> 0
{0}
Order By HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate asc

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalarySheet_ReportDptWiseData
data.value:
---- Query 1 For Over All Report
--DECLARE @FromDate DATE = '2024-11-01', -- @ToDate DATE = '2024-11-30', -- @CompanyID INT = 1, -- @PeriodID INT = 1
Select tempEmpCount.NoOFEmployees,tempDepEmpCount.DeptWiseNoOFEmployees,* From ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName, tab.DeductionType as Description,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID, SET_Section.SectionName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD

group by HRMS_EP.PersonID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,Tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking )FintabFinal Left Join (Select DepartmentID,Count(Distinct HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) as NoOFEmployees from HRMS_SET_Employee Inner Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status=1 Inner JOin HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID=HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive=1 -- AND DATENAME(month, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @Year And HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate --AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID = @StatusID OR @StatusID is null) {1} AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = @CompanyID Group By DepartmentID)tempEmpCount on tempEmpCount.DepartmentID=FintabFinal.DepartmentID Order by FintabFinal.PersonID
---- Query 2 For Only Total Number Of Employee
Select SUM(EmployeeTab.NoOFEmployees) as TotalNoOFEmployee From ( Select Distinct tempEmpCount.NoOFEmployees,DepartmentName From ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType as Description,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1

Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1

union all

select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount),0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE -- DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) --AND (HRMS_SE.StatusID = @StatusID OR @StatusID is null) {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary

select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType ,MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS aMOUNT --,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount),0) AS aMOUNT ,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE -- DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) --AND (HRMS_SE.StatusID = @StatusID OR @StatusID is null) {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary union all
select 210 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount ,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking, DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SE.BasicSalary as GrossSalary,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Gross Payable' as DeductionType,--Round((case when MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount)%10 = 9 then round(MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount),-1) else MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) end),0) as Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0) Amount ,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1

HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE -- DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SH.CompanyID =
