data.name: Query_LoanAndRecoveryRegisterReportDataEmployeeSalary
data.value:
declare @CompanyID int = @CompanyID_, @PeriodID int = @PeriodID_, @LoanNewDate datetime = @LoanNewDate_, @fullDate datetime = @fullDate_;
-----Query 2 For Loan And Recovery Resister Report Data
Select PayrollTypeID, PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID, sum(OpeningBalanc) - sum(Amount) as OpeningBalanc, sum(LoanRecieved) as AmountRecoved , sum(AmountRecoved) as LoanRecieved, sum(ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance, sum(Amount) as Amount from (
Select FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType, FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, (Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc)) as OpeningBalanc, sum(FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved, sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved ,0 as ClosingBalance, sum(FinalTAb.Amount) as Amount --,(Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc + FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) - sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved)) as ClosingBalance
from (
---------------- For Opening Balance ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, sum(tab.OpeningBalanc) as OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved ,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved , 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
Union All
--- Amount --
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved , sum(tab.amount) as Amount from (
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,0 as OpeningBalanc, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as Amount, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.AmountRecoved
union All
---------------- For Loan Recovered during the Year ------------------
Select -- LoanSanctionHeaderID,PayrollTypeID, PayrollType,EmployeeCode,PayrollTypeCode,FullName,OpeningBalanc,LoanRecieved, AmountRecoved,Amount * from
(
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,0 as Amount
--FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) between DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) and @fullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab -- group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.OpeningBalanc,AmountRecoved,Amount
Union All
---------------- For Loan Received during the Year ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate between DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @fullDate), 0) and @fullDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
)FinalTAb
group by FinalTAb.LoanSanctionHeaderID, FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType,FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc, FinalTAb.LoanRecieved , FinalTAb.AmountRecoved,FinalTAb.Amount
) tb
group by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID

data.name: Query_ForNoOverTimeReportData
data.value:
--Query_ForNoOverTimeReportData Select * from
( SELECT distinct ETMS1.TMSDateTime, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName, DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.FullName as EmployeeName, SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) and EP.Status=1 left join SET_EmployeeType ET on ET.TypeID = EP.PersonTypeCode and ET.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate LEFT JOIN ( Select HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime Time_IN --,MIN(OUTTS.TMSDateTime) Time_OUT ,( case when convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime) = Convert(Date,Min(OUTTS.TMSDateTime)) then (Select max(HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) from HRMS_TMSData as HRMS_TMSData2 Where -- HRMS_TMSData2.StatusCode=2 HRMS_TMSData2.StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckOut') and ((Convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) = convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime)) --OR Convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) = DATEADD(DAY, 1, Convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime)) ) and HRMS_TMSData2.PersonID=HRMS_TMSData.PersonID) else MIN(OUTTS.TMSDateTime) end ) Time_OUT
from HRMS_TMSData
OUTER APPLY (Select EMTS2.PersonID,EMTS2.ShiftHeaderID,EMTS2.StatusCode,TMSDateTime,ManagementCode,TerminalNo,EMTS2.RawData,EMTS2.Reason from HRMS_TMSData EMTS2 Where --StatusCode=2 StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckOut') AND EMTS2.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND (DATEADD(day, 2, @ToDate)) AND EMTS2.TMSDateTime>HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime
) as OUTTS
Where HRMS_TMSData.PersonID=OUTTS.PersonID --AND HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode=1 AND HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckIn') AND HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND (DATEADD(day, 2, @ToDate))
group by HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,OUTTS.Reason
) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = EP.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=24 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
where SET_DateTime.TheDate >= @FromDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= @ToDate and EP.IsActive = 1 and ( (EP.JobEndingDate is not null and SET_DateTime.TheDate between EP.JoiningDate and EP.JobEndingDate) OR (EP.JobEndingDate is null and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate) ) {0} ) finalTab
Where TMSTimeIN is not null and TMSTimeOUT is null order by finalTab.TheDate asc

data.name: Query_DepartmentWiseSalaryMonthWise_ReportData
data.value:
Select tab.CompanyID, tab.PeriodID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, Sum(tab.Amount) as Amount,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.PersonID, tab.MonthName as MonthWise, tab.YearWise, DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY cast(DepartmentID as int)) AS SeriaLNo,Sorting
from (
Select HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode, HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_SD.Amount as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID, format(HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,'MMM-yyyy') as MonthName, format(HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,'yyyy-MM') as YearWise, MONTH(HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) as Sorting
from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1
LEFT JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SH.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
WHERE HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = 1 AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SD.Amount > 0
{0}
group by HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID, HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate
) tab
Group by tab.CompanyID, tab.PeriodID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.DepartmentID, tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.SalaryHeaderID, tab.PersonID, tab.MonthName,tab.Sorting,tab.YearWise
Order by tab.YearWise asc

data.name: Query_LoanMovementandLoanMovementExecutiveBothReportData
data.value:
Select * from (
Select PayrollTypeID, PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID, sum(OpeningBalanc) - sum(Amount) as OpeningBalanc, sum(LoanRecieved) as AmountRecoved , sum(AmountRecoved) as LoanRecieved, sum(ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance, sum(Amount) as Amount from (
Select FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType, FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, (Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc)) as OpeningBalanc, sum(FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved, sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved ,0 as ClosingBalance, sum(FinalTAb.Amount) as Amount --,(Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc + FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) - sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved)) as ClosingBalance
from (
---------------- For Opening Balance ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, sum(tab.OpeningBalanc) as OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved ,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved , 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = 2 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
Union All
--- Amount --
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved , sum(tab.amount) as Amount from (
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,0 as OpeningBalanc, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as Amount, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID
Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = 2 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) < @FromDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.AmountRecoved,Tab.Amount
union All
---------------- For Loan Recovered during the Year ------------------
Select -- LoanSanctionHeaderID,PayrollTypeID, PayrollType,EmployeeCode,PayrollTypeCode,FullName,OpeningBalanc,LoanRecieved, AmountRecoved,Amount * from
(
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,0 as Amount
--FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = 2 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab -- group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.OpeningBalanc,AmountRecoved,Amount
Union All
---------------- For Loan Received during the Year ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = 2 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
)FinalTAb
group by FinalTAb.LoanSanctionHeaderID, FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType,FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc, FinalTAb.LoanRecieved , FinalTAb.AmountRecoved,FinalTAb.Amount
) tb
group by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID
) tb2 where (OpeningBalanc + AmountRecoved + LoanRecieved + ClosingBalance) <> 0

data.name: Query_EmployeeEarningcard_ReportDKSM
data.value:
select * from ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType ='Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking, tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID from ( select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName, SUBSTRING(HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,1,5)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),6,7)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),13,1) as CNICNumber, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,HRMS_SD.Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner Join SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
--SET_Location
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {1} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID
union all
select 350 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, SUBSTRING(HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,1,5)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),6,7)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),13,1) as CNICNumber, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {1}
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_Grade.GradeName ,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDate,tab.GradeName ,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID
union all select 400 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,TAB.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, SUBSTRING(HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,1,5)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),6,7)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),13,1) as CNICNumber, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType, case when MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount)%10 = 9 then MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount) else MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount) end as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {1} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_Grade.GradeName ,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GradeName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDate ,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID
union all
select 210 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary, HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode --CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as int) as EmployeeCode ,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName, SUBSTRING(HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,1,5)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),6,7)+'-'+SUBSTRING((HRMS_SE.CNICNumber),13,1) as CNICNumber, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Gross Payable' as DeductionType,(case when MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount)%10 = 9 then MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) else MAX(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount) end) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status=1
Inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = HRMS_SE.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SE.FK_GradeID and SET_Grade.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE
HRMS_SH.SalaryDate between @dateFrom and @dateTo and --DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) between @Month and @ToMonth AND --DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {1} group by HRMS_EP.PersonID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary, SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.CNICNumber,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName,SET_Grade.GradeName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Location.LocationID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.CNICNumber,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode ,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDate,tab.JobCategoryName,tab.GradeName,tab.LocationName,tab.LocationID ) total where total.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0}
ORDER by total.EmployeeCode,total.SalaryDate asc

data.name: Query_EmployeePFReportDateWise
data.value:
Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,
(select sum(CalculatedAmount + ManualAmount ) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll where HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll .PayrollTypeCode = 1 ) as GrossAmount,
(select sum(Amount) from HRMS_SalaryDetail saldtl where saldtl.SalaryHeaderID =HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and saldtl.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and saldtl.PayrollTypeCode = 1 ) as NetAmount,
SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as DesignationName--,HRMS_PayrollType.Code --,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType ,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo ,--HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate, isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue --,Sum(HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount) as ManualAmount ,sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AmountofPF , HRMS_SET_Employee.CNICNumber from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND --HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
--inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on --HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and --HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode -- and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) -- and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID)
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND --HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 2
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID --AND Set_Designation.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID --and Set_Grade.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Provident%' {0} group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary ,HRMS_SET_Employee.CNICNumber,HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID
order by CAST(isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,0) as int) asc

data.name: Query_EmployeePFReportMOnthWise
data.value:
WITH TB AS (SELECT HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID,DATENAME(MONTH,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate)),3,4) as MonthNames, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, isnull(((ROUND([HRMS_SalaryDetail].Amount,0))*-1),0) as PFNeg From [HRMS_SalaryHeader] INNER JOIN [HRMS_SalaryDetail] on [HRMS_SalaryHeader].SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID and [HRMS_SalaryDetail].Status = 1 JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_SalaryDetail].PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = [HRMS_SalaryDetail].PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 AND HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 where HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate >= @FromDate AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate <= @ToDate AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (1) AND HRMS_PayrollType.Abbreviation like '%PF%' {1} )
SELECT tb.FullName, tb.FatherName, tb.EmployeeCode, tb.PersonID, tb.GradeName, tb.GrossAmount, tb.NetAmount, tb.DesignationName, tb.SocialSecNo ,tb.DefaultValue, tb.MonthNames, tb.SalaryDate, CASE WHEN PFNeg != 0 THEN (AmountofPF + PFNeg) ELSE AmountofPF END AS AmountofPF , tb.AmountofPF_Cont, CNICNumber FROM ( Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName, ( select sum(CalculatedAmount + ManualAmount) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID where HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll .Status = 1 ) as GrossAmount, (select sum(salarydtl.Amount) from HRMS_SalaryHeader hdr inner join HRMS_SalaryDetail salarydtl on salarydtl.SalaryHeaderID = hdr.SalaryHeaderID and salarydtl.CompanyID = hdr.CompanyID and salarydtl.PeriodID = hdr.PeriodID inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = salarydtl.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = salarydtl.PayrollTypeID where hdr .SalaryDate between '2023-01-01' and '2023-04-30' and hdr .PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader .PersonID and hdr .CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader .CompanyID and hdr .status = 1 and salarydtl.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable = 1 ) as NetAmount, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName as DesignationName--,HRMS_PayrollType.Code --,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType ,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo ,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue , DATENAME(MONTH,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate)),3,4) as MonthNames ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate ,sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AmountofPF , sum(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) as AmountofPF_Cont , TB.PFNeg, HRMS_SET_Employee.CNICNumber from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join TB on TB.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and TB.MonthNames = DATENAME(MONTH,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate)),3,4) and TB.SalaryDate = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 2
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status =1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Provident%' {0} group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary ,HRMS_SET_Employee.CNICNumber,HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_SalaryHeader .PersonID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID,TB.PFNeg )tb order by CAST(isnull(tb.EmployeeCode,0) as int) ,tb.SalaryDate asc

Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.FatherName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,Round(FinalTab.Amount,0) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking, FinalTab.DaysWorkings2, --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName from ( {1},SectionID,SectionName ,(Select SUM(HRMS_Overtime.OverTimeHours) from HRMS_Overtime where HRMS_Overtime.PersonID = FinalTab.PersonID And HRMS_Overtime.CompanyID = FinalTab.CompanyID And HRMS_OverTime.PeriodID = FinalTab.PeriodID and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Year and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Year And HRMS_Overtime.Status = 1 ) as OTHours from ( select case when TAB.DeductionType = 'Basic Salary' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then 1 when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (100 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) then (1001 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (4000 +TAB.PayrollTypeId)
--when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) --when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2 ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType, --Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,
CASE when HRMS_PT.Description like '%Loan' then
( Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) + isnull((select top 1 isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,0)
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_SE.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = 35 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5 and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate) = @Year AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SE.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SE.CompanyID AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%PF Loan' and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Comments is not null and IsPosted is null ),0) ) else Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) end as Amount ,
HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName ,HRMS_SE.PersonID, HRMS_SE.CompanyID )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName
union all
select 2000 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,FK_SectionID,SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount),0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE
DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID
union all select 3000 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount ,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking, tab.DaysWorkings2 ,FK_SectionID,SectionName --, DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Net Payable' as DeductionType ,MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS aMOUNT --,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.NetAmount),0) AS aMOUNT ,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1 WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.fatherNAme,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID

data.value:
SELECT
FINTAB3.Heading, FINTAB3.Description, CAST(FINTAB3.Amount as decimal(18,0)) as Amount, FINTAB3.CostCenterName , FINTAB3.CostCenterID
from (
SELECT Heading, Description, MAX(Amount) AS Amount, CostCenterName, CostCenterID
from
(
--Allownces with Cost Center SELECT 'Allowance' as Heading, [HRMS_PayrollType].Description, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID, Sum( (CASE WHEN [HRMS_PayrollType].Description = 'Basic Salary' and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) = 0 THEN HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOFMonth WHEN [HRMS_PayrollType].Description = 'Basic Salary' and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount / @TotalNoOfDays) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) = 0 THEN (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100 * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOFMonth)
WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (((HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100) / @TotalNoOfDays ) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays)
ELSE NULL -- Handle cases where the '*' or '/' characters are not found END)) AS Amount FROM HRMS_EmployeeIncrement Inner join [HRMS_EmployeePayroll] on HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PeriodID
JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] ON [HRMS_PayrollType].PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID] AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeCode IN (1, 3)
Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1 inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
where HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) --and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Year AND DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveMonth and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveYear AND (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsActive] = 1 OR 1 IS NULL) AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].IsOneTime IS NULL --AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null) --And (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
{0}
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID
union all --Deduction with costcenter SELECT 'Deduction' as Heading, [HRMS_PayrollType].Description, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID, Sum( (CASE WHEN [HRMS_PayrollType].Description = 'Basic Salary' and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) = 0 THEN HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOFMonth WHEN [HRMS_PayrollType].Description = 'Basic Salary' and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount / @TotalNoOfDays) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) = 0 THEN (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100 * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOFMonth)
WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (((HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100) / @TotalNoOfDays ) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays)
ELSE NULL -- Handle cases where the '*' or '/' characters are not found END)) AS Amount FROM HRMS_EmployeeIncrement Inner join [HRMS_EmployeePayroll] on HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PeriodID
JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] ON [HRMS_PayrollType].PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID] AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeCode IN (2,5,3)
Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1 inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
where HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) --and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Year AND DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveMonth and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveYear AND (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsActive] = 1 OR 1 IS NULL) AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].IsOneTime IS NULL --AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null) --And (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
{0}
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID

group by FINTAB.Heading, FINTAB.Description , FINTAB.CostCenterName, FINTAB.CostCenterID
union

WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (((HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100) / @TotalNoOfDays ) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays)
