WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (((HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100) / @TotalNoOfDays ) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays)
ELSE NULL -- Handle cases where the '*' or '/' characters are not found END)) * 1 AS Amount FROM HRMS_EmployeeIncrement
Inner join [HRMS_EmployeePayroll] on HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PeriodID
JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] ON [HRMS_PayrollType].PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID] AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeCode IN (1, 3)
Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1 inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
where HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) --and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Year And DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveMonth and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveYear AND (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsActive] = 1 OR 1 IS NULL) AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].IsOneTime IS NULL and HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID is null --AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null) --And (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
{0}
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID --,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,
union all --Deduction without Costcenter SELECT 'Deduction' as Heading, [HRMS_PayrollType].Description, 'Not Defind' as CostCenterName,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID, Sum( (CASE WHEN [HRMS_PayrollType].Description = 'Basic Salary' and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) = 0 THEN HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOFMonth WHEN [HRMS_PayrollType].Description = 'Basic Salary' and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount / @TotalNoOfDays) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) = 0 THEN (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100 * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOFMonth)
WHEN CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) > 0 and isnull(HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays,0) > 0 THEN (((HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.IncrementAmount * SUBSTRING([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula, CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - CHARINDEX('*', [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].formula) - 1) / 100) / @TotalNoOfDays ) * HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.NoOfDays)
ELSE NULL -- Handle cases where the '*' or '/' characters are not found END)) * -1 AS Amount FROM HRMS_EmployeeIncrement
Inner join [HRMS_EmployeePayroll] on HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID And HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PeriodID
JOIN [HRMS_PayrollType] ON [HRMS_PayrollType].PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID] AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeCode IN (2,5,3)
Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PersonID And HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CompanyID
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1 inner join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID = HRMS_Set_Employee.StatusID
where HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (HRMS_DP.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID is null) --and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[IncrementDate]) = @Year And DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveMonth and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.[EffectiveDate]) = @EffectiveYear AND (HRMS_EmployeeIncrement.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsActive] = 1 OR 1 IS NULL) AND [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].IsOneTime IS NULL and HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID is null --AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null) --And (HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID=@StatusID or @StatusID is null)
{0}
group by HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID --,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName
) as FINTAB1
group by FINTAB1.Heading, FINTAB1.Description, FINTAB1.CostCenterName, FINTAB1.CostCenterID
) FINTAB3
GROUP BY FINTAB3.Heading, FINTAB3.Description, FINTAB3.Amount, FINTAB3.CostCenterName ,FINTAB3.CostCenterID

data.name: Query_GetEmployeeBonusReport_HSM
data.value:
Select HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID,HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID,HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID,HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID ,HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID,GrossSalary,HRMS_BonusDetail.BasicSalary,HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusAmount as Bonus,HRMS_BonusHeader.NoOfDays as NoOfDays,HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusAbsent ,HRMS_BonusDetail.CreateDate ,HRMS_BonusDetail.CreatedBy ,HRMS_BonusDetail.UpdateDate ,HRMS_BonusDetail.UpdatedBy ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName as EmployeeName ,HRMS_BonusDetail.JoiningDate ,HRMS_BonusDetail.DesignationID ,SET_Designation.DesignationName , SET_Department.DepartmentID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,HRMS_BonusDetail.Eligibility ,HRMS_BonusDetail.InComeTax, HRMS_BonusDetail.NetBonusAmount, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployeeStatusName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_BonusDetail.NoOfDays as PresentDays ,HRMS_BonusDetail.ArrearOfBonus, HRMS_BonusDetail.DeductionOfBonus ,HRMS_BonusDetail.AdvanceSalary ,SET_Business.BusinessName +'-'+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as CompanyName ,Case When HRMS_BonusHeader.FormulaID = 1 Then 'Bonus 1' When HRMS_BonusHeader.FormulaID = 2 Then 'Bonus 2' When HRMS_BonusHeader.FormulaID = 3 Then 'Bonus 3' Else null End As BonusType ,HRMS_BonusDetail.LoanDeduction as LoansDeduction1 --,HRMS_PayrollType.Description As LoanType ,HRMS_BonusDetail.CreatedByValue as UserName, STUFF(( SELECT ' | ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), PRT.Description) FROM HRMS_PayrollType PRT INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID = PRT.PayrollTypeID INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail BD ON BD.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID AND BD.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID -- AND AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = PBD.FiscalID WHERE BD.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID And BD.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID And HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction > 0 AND PRT.Status = 1 FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 2, '') AS LoanType,
STUFF(( SELECT ' | ' + FORMAT(CAST(ROUND(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,0)), 'N0') FROM HRMS_PayrollType PRT INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID = PRT.PayrollTypeID INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail BD ON BD.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID AND BD.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID -- AND AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = PBD.FiscalID WHERE BD.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID And BD.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID And HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction > 0 AND PRT.Status = 1 FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 2, '') AS LoanDeduction FROM HRMS_BonusDetail Left Join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID LEFT join SET_Designation on SET_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_BonusDetail.DesignationID LEFT join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_DepartmentID Left Join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID =HRMS_BonusHeader.EmployStatusID And HRMS_Employement_Status.Status=1 Inner Join Set_Company on Set_Company.CompanyId=HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID --Inner Join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId= Set_Company.CompanyID left Join SET_Business on SET_Business.IsActive = 1 inner Join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId= Set_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PayrollTypeID And HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 Where HRMS_BonusDetail.Status=1 and HRMS_BonusHeader.MillStartDate = @DateFrom and HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate = @DateTo and HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_BonusHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID {0}

Select PayrollTypeID, PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID, sum(OpeningBalanc) - sum(Amount) as OpeningBalanc, sum(LoanRecieved) as AmountRecoved , sum(AmountRecoved) as LoanRecieved, sum(ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance, sum(Amount) as Amount from (
Select FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType, FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, (Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc)) as OpeningBalanc, sum(FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved, sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved ,0 as ClosingBalance, sum(FinalTAb.Amount) as Amount --,(Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc + FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) - sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved)) as ClosingBalance
from (
---------------- For Opening Balance ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, sum(tab.OpeningBalanc) as OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved ,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved , 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
union all
select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(Sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusHeader ON HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
Union All
--- Amount --
Select tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved , sum(tab.amount) as Amount from (
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,0 as OpeningBalanc, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as Amount, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.AmountRecoved,Tab.Amount
union All
---------------- For Loan Recovered during the Year ------------------
Select -- LoanSanctionHeaderID,PayrollTypeID, PayrollType,EmployeeCode,PayrollTypeCode,FullName,OpeningBalanc,LoanRecieved, AmountRecoved,Amount * from
(
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,0 as Amount
--FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab -- group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.OpeningBalanc,AmountRecoved,Amount

FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
union all
select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(Sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusHeader ON HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc,tab.Amount
)FinalTAb
group by FinalTAb.LoanSanctionHeaderID, FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType,FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc, FinalTAb.LoanRecieved , FinalTAb.AmountRecoved,FinalTAb.Amount
) tb
group by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID

data.name: Query_Get_PayrollTypeSalaryDetailByPersonID
data.value:
--DECLARE @CompanyID INT = 1, --@PeriodID INT = 1, --@SalaryMonth INT = 11, --@SalaryYear INT = 2024, --@PersonID INT = 3, --@PayrollTypeID INT = 2;
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount, CAST(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking AS int) AS DaysWorking, CAST(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal AS INT) AS DaysTotal, CAST((HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking) AS INT) AS AllowedDaysForArrear FROM HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail ON HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
WHERE HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (Month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryMonth AND YEAR(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryYear) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = @PayrollTypeID
UNION ALL
SELECT HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount, (SELECT PayrollTypeID FROM HRMS_PayrollType WHERE Description LIKE 'Gross Salary') as PayrollTypeID, (SELECT PayrollTypeCode FROM HRMS_PayrollType WHERE Description LIKE 'Gross Salary') as PayrollTypeCode, (SELECT Description FROM HRMS_PayrollType WHERE Description LIKE 'Gross Salary') as Description, SUM(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount) AS Amount, CAST(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking AS int) AS DaysWorking, CAST(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal AS INT) AS DaysTotal, CAST((HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking) AS INT) AS AllowedDaysForArrear FROM HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail ON HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
WHERE HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (Month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryMonth AND YEAR(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryYear) AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 1 {filterPayrollType} GROUP BY HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal
)DT WHERE PayrollTypeID = @PayrollTypeID

--DECLARE @CompanyID INT = 1, --@PeriodID INT = 1, --@SalaryMonth INT = 11, --@SalaryYear INT = 2024, --@PersonID INT = 3, --@PayrollTypeID INT = 2;

INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
WHERE HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND (Month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryMonth AND YEAR(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryYear) AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = @PayrollTypeID
UNION ALL
SELECT HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID, 0 AS SalaryHeaderID, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(@SalaryYear, @SalaryMonth, 1)) AS SalaryDate, 0 AS GrossAmount, 0 AS DeductionAmount, 0 AS NetAmount, (SELECT PayrollTypeID FROM HRMS_PayrollType WHERE Description LIKE 'Gross Salary') as PayrollTypeID, (SELECT PayrollTypeCode FROM HRMS_PayrollType WHERE Description LIKE 'Gross Salary') as PayrollTypeCode, (SELECT Description FROM HRMS_PayrollType WHERE Description LIKE 'Gross Salary') as Description, SUM(HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount + HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount) AS Amount, DAY(EOMONTH(CONVERT(DATE, CONCAT(@SalaryYear, '-', @SalaryMonth, '-01')))) AS DaysWorking, DAY(EOMONTH(CONVERT(DATE, CONCAT(@SalaryYear, '-', @SalaryMonth, '-01')))) AS DaysTotal, DAY(EOMONTH(CONVERT(DATE, CONCAT(@SalaryYear, '-', @SalaryMonth, '-01')))) AS AllowedDaysForArrear FROM HRMS_EmployeePayroll
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1
WHERE HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND (Month(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryMonth AND YEAR(HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate) = @SalaryYear) AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = @PersonID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 1 {filterPayrollType} GROUP BY HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PeriodID, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID
)DT WHERE PayrollTypeID = @PayrollTypeID

data.value:
Select Tab.PersonID, Tab.PayrollTypeID, Tab.LoanDescription, Tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID, Tab.LoanDate , sum(Tab.DeductionAmount) as DeductionAmount, sum(Tab.ActualLoanBalance) as ActualLoanBalance From ( select HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID as PersonID, HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanDescription,HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction as DeductionAmount ,HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID,convert(date,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.loanStartDate) as LoanDate ,(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount) - ( (isnull((select sum(isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanDisburstAmount,0)) from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.PeriodID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.Status = 1 where HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID ),0)) + isnull( ( select sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction) from HRMS_BonusLoanDetail inner join HRMS_BonusDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail .BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail .BonusDetailID and HRMS_BonusDetail.status = 1 where HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1 ),0)
) as ActualLoanBalance from HRMS_BonusLoanDetail inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader on HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID
inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID inner join HRMS_BonusDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID and HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID where HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = @BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = @PersonID )Tab Where Tab.ActualLoanBalance > 0 group by Tab.PersonID, Tab.PayrollTypeID, Tab.LoanDescription, Tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID, Tab.LoanDate

data.name: Query2_EmployeeSalarySheet_Sanghar
data.value:
--DECLARE @Month varchar(10) = 'December', -- @Year INT = 2024, -- @CompanyID INT = 1, -- @PeriodID INT = 1
Select FinalTab.SortCategory, FinalTab.GrossSalary, FinalTab.MasterSalary, FinalTab.PeriodID,FinalTab.CompanyID, FinalTab.PersonID, FinalTab.EmployeeCode,FinalTab.PayrollTypeID,FinalTab.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTab.FullName,FinalTab.FatherName,FinalTab.JobDesignationID, FinalTab.JobDesignationName,FinalTab.DepartmentID,FinalTab.DepartmentName, FinalTab.DeductionType,Round(FinalTab.Amount,0) as Amount,FinalTab.GrossAmount,FinalTab.DeductionAmount,FinalTab.NetAmount,FinalTab.DaysTotal, FinalTab.DaysWorking, FinalTab.DaysWorkings2, --DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode,personid,CompanyID,PeriodID) AS SeriaLNo,SectionID,SectionName from ( {1},SectionID,SectionName ,(Select SUM(HRMS_Overtime.OverTimeHours) from HRMS_Overtime where HRMS_Overtime.PersonID = FinalTab.PersonID And HRMS_Overtime.CompanyID = FinalTab.CompanyID And HRMS_OverTime.PeriodID = FinalTab.PeriodID and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Year and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Year And HRMS_Overtime.Status = 1 ) as OTHours from ( select case when TAB.DeductionType = 'Basic Salary' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then 1 when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (100 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5) then (1001 +TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (4000 +TAB.PayrollTypeId)
--when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) --when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2 ,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID,HRMS_SE.FatherName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 ----AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode IN (2,5) AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
{2} JOIN ( select CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode , MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS negativeAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
where DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
GROUP BY HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode HAVING MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) < 0 ) NegativeTable ON NegativeTable.EmployeeCode = HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode
WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 and HRMS_SD.Amount > 0 --New {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_SE.BasicSalary,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName ,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,SET_Section.SectionName ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID ,HRMS_SE.FatherName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.JobDesignationID ,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode ,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary,tab.SalaryDetailID ,SectionID,SectionName
union all
select 2000 as SortCategory,tab.GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.DeductionType,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,FK_SectionID,SectionName --,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,0 as SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName as FullName,HRMS_SE.FatherName as FatherName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID as JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName as JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID as DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName as DepartmentName,0 as PayrollTypeID,0 as PayrollTypeCode, 'Deduction Amount' as DeductionType,Round(MAX(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount),0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking,CAST(cast(cast(HRMS_SH.DaysWorking as DECIMAL(9,6)) as float) as nvarchar(50)) DaysWorkings2, 0 GrossAmount,0 as DeductionAmount,0 as NetAmount,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
LEFT JOIN SET_JobCategory ON SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_SE.FK_JobCategoryID AND SET_JobCategory.Status = 1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1 left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
{2} JOIN ( select CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode , MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) AS negativeAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID and HRMS_SD.PeriodID=HRMS_SH.PeriodID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1
Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
where DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1
{0}
GROUP BY HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode HAVING MAX(Round(HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,0)) < 0 ) NegativeTable ON NegativeTable.EmployeeCode = HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode
WHERE

left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll HRMS_EP ON HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_EP.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_EP.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_EP.Status=1
where DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1

WHERE DATENAME(month, HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year,HRMS_SH.SalaryDate) = @Year AND HRMS_SH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SH.Status = 1 {0} group by SalaryDetailID,HRMS_PT.Description ,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode,Amount,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.MasterSalary, HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SE.FullName,HRMS_SE.fatherNAme,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount,HRMS_SH.DeductionAmount,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID, HRMS_SH.NetAmount,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking ,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID, SectionName )TAB GROUP BY TAB.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName, tab.PayrollTypeID, tab.DeductionType,tab.Amount,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,tab.DaysWorkings2,tab.MasterSalary ,SectionName,FK_SectionID

data.name: Query_SalaryBreakUp_New
data.value:
select DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SrNo, case when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+fintab.PayrollTypeId) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (258+PayrollTypeId) when fintab.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when fintab.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (450+ fintab.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory, fintab.PersonID, fintab.FullName ,fintab.FatherName ,fintab.EmployeeCode ,fintab.EmployGrade, fintab.DepartmentName ,fintab.JobDesignationName ,fintab.PayrollTypeID ,fintab.PayrollTypeCode , fintab.GrossSalary ,fintab.DeductionType ,sum(fintab.Amount) as Amount from
( Select DISTINCT TAB.PersonID,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName ,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary as GrossSalary ,SET_Grade.GradeName as EmployGrade ,EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeID as PayrollTypeID ,EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode ,PType.Description as DeductionType ,Case when ISNULL(EmpPayroll.CalculatedAmount,0) > 0 then isnull(EmpPayroll.CalculatedAmount,0) else EmpPayroll.ManualAmount end as Amount ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName from (
SELECT
[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[CompanyID], [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PeriodID] ,[EmployeePayrollID] ,[PersonID] , [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeID],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PayrollTypeCode] ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[Formula],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime],[HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsPaid],[LeaveDays] ,IsNull(CalculatedAmount,0) CalculatedAmount ,IsNull(ManualAmount,0) ManualAmount ,Case Impact When 1 Then 'Positive' When 2 Then 'Negative' When 3 Then 'No Impact' END 'Impact' ,'False' IsIncomeTax ,HRMS_PayrollType.IsTaxable ,HRMS_PayrollType.IsPayable , IsNull([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].CalculatedAmount,0) + IsNull([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].ManualAmount,0) as SBAmount FROM [HRMS_EmployeePayroll] JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 WHERE [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[Status] = 1 AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null) AND ([HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime] is null or [HRMS_EmployeePayroll].[IsOneTime] = '1')
) TAB
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.[PersonID] = TAB.[PersonID] AND HRMS_Set_Employee.[Status] = 1 {3} AND (HRMS_Set_Employee.[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null)
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status =1 left join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID =HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID and SET_JobDesignation.Status =1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll EmpPayroll on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID=EmpPayroll.PersonID AND EmpPayroll.CompanyID =HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND EmpPayroll.Status = 1 AND EmpPayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType PType on PType.PayrollTypeID = EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeID and PType.PayrollTypeCode=EmpPayroll.PayrollTypeCode and PType.PayrollTypeCode <>4 where TAB.[PayrollTypeCode]=1 {0} {3} {2} {4}
) fintab
group by fintab.PersonID, fintab.FullName ,fintab.FatherName ,fintab.EmployeeCode , fintab.GrossSalary,fintab.DepartmentName ,fintab.JobDesignationName ,fintab.EmployGrade ,fintab.PayrollTypeID ,fintab.PayrollTypeCode ,fintab.DeductionType ,fintab.Amount order by fintab.PersonID

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalary_ReportData_Sanghar
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @Date datetime = '2025-03-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @Month varchar(20) = 'march' --Declare @PersonID int = null --Declare @PersonTypeCode int = 1 --Declare @StatusID int = null --Declare @Months varchar(20) = '03' --Declare @Year varchar(20) = '2025' --Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 5
DECLARE @IsActive INT = 1; select case when tabtest.Allowances='Supply Days' then 0 when tabtest.impact = 1 then tabtest.PayrollAmount else 0 end as PayRoll ,* from ( SELECT TABSb.GrossValue, TABSb.YTDGrossValue, TABSb.JoiningDate, TABSb.PersonID, TABSb.PersonTypeCode, TABSb.EmployeeCode, TABSb.FullName, TABSb.SalaryDate, TABSb.JobDesignationName, TABSb.DepartmentName, TABSb.AccountHolderName, TABSb.BankAccountNumber, TABSb.EmpAccountNo, TABSb.BankBranchName, TABSb.BankName,
case when TABSb.ManualAmount != 0 then TABSb.ManualAmount when TABSb.CalculatedAmount != 0 then TABSb.CalculatedAmount else 0 end as PayrollAmount, TABSb.IBanNo, TABSb.BasicSalary, case when TABSb.GrossAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.GrossAmount,-1) else TABSb.GrossAmount end as GrossAmount, TABSb.DeductionAmount, case when TABSb.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(TABSb.NetAmount,-1) else TABSb.NetAmount end as NetAmount, TABSb.DaysWorking, TABSb.DaysAbsent, TABSb.DaysLWP, TABSb.DaysLate, TABSb.DaysEarly, TABSb.DaysTotal,
TABSb.PayrollTypeCode, (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Allowances , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Description when '0' then TABSb.Description else null end)as Deductions , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Amount else null end)as AllowancesAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as DeductionsAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '1' then TABSb.Standard else null end)as AllowancesStandardAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.Amount when '0' then TABSb.Amount else null end) as CMDeductionsAmount ,
(case TABSb.Impact when '2' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount when '0' then TABSb.PMDiscountAmount else null end) as PMDiscountAmount , (case TABSb.Impact when '2' then Isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) when '0' then isnull(TABSb.PMDiscountAmount + TABSb.Amount,0 ) else null end) as TMDiscountAmount ,
TABSb.Impact, TABSb.LeaveWithouPay ,TABSb.YTD ,TABSb.NTNNo ,TABSb.CNICNumber ,TABSb.CompanyName ,TABSb.Email ,('PAY SLIP FOR THE MONTH OF '+ @Month+' YEAR '+ @Year) as ParameterReport
,(Select SUM(HRMS_Overtime.OverTimeHours) from HRMS_Overtime where HRMS_Overtime.PersonID = TABSb.PersonID And HRMS_Overtime.CompanyID = TABSb.CompanyID and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.FromDate) >= @Year and DATENAME(month, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Month and DATEPART(Year, HRMS_Overtime.ToDate) <= @Year And HRMS_Overtime.Status = 1 ) as OTHours
from
(
select max(GrossValue) as GrossValue,max(JoiningDate) as JoiningDate, max(PersonID) as PersonID,CompanyID, PersonTypeCode ,EmployeeCode ,FullName, max(SalaryDate)as SalaryDate, BasicSalary ,sum(Standard)as Standard ,max(JobDesignationName) as JobDesignationName ,max(DepartmentName) as DepartmentName, max(AccountHolderName) as AccountHolderName, max(BankAccountNumber) as BankAccountNumber, max(EmpAccountNo) as EmpAccountNo, max(BankBranchName) as BankBranchName,max(BankName) as BankName ,max(IBanNo) as IBanNo, sum(ManualAmount)as ManualAmount ,sum(CalculatedAmount)as CalculatedAmount ,max(GrossAmount)as GrossAmount ,sum(DeductionAmount)as DeductionAmount,sum(NetAmount)as NetAmount, max(DaysWorking)as DaysWorking, sum(DaysAbsent) as DaysAbsent, sum(DaysLWP) as DaysLWP ,sum(DaysLate)as DaysLate, sum(DaysEarly)as DaysEarly ,max(DaysTotal)as DaysTotal, PayrollTypeCode ,Description ,max(Amount) as Amount,sum(PMDiscountAmount)as PMDiscountAmount ,max(Impact) as Impact, sum(LeaveWithouPay)as LeaveWithouPay, max(YTD)as YTD ,sum(YTDGrossValue)as YTDGrossValue ,NTNNo ,CNICNumber, max(CompanyName)as CompanyName, Email from (
SELECT ( select Round(sum(isnull(tab.CalculatedAmount,0) + ISNULL(tab.ManualAmount,0)),0) from ( select distinct HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Payrolltypeid, CalculatedAmount,ManualAmount from HRMS_EmployeePayroll left join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = @Year where PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 )tab
) as GrossValue, HRMS_SET_Employee.JoiningDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID, HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName, HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_SET_Employee.BasicSalary, isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as Standard, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_BankAccount.AccountHolderName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, HRMS_SET_Employee.EmpAccountNo, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, HRMS_SET_Employee.IBanNo, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount,
HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount, (HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount) as NetAmount,
(HRMS_SalaryHeader.daystotal - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent) - HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP as DaysWorking , HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysAbsent, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLWP, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysLate, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysEarly, HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysTotal,
HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,
ISnull(( select isnull(tab.Amount,0) from ( select distinct PMH.PersonID,PT.Description, Sum(PMS.Amount) as Amount from HRMS_SalaryDetail PMS INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader PMH ON PMS.SalaryheaderID=PMH.SalaryHeaderID AND PMS.CompanyID=PMH.CompanyID and PMH.SalaryDate < @Date
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType PT on PMS.PayrollTypeID = PT.PayrollTypeID AND PMS.PayrollTypeCode = PT.PayrollTypeCode AND PT.Status = 1 and PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND PT.IsVisiable=1
where PMH.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = PMH.CompanyID AND PT.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID
GROUP By PMH.PersonID,PT.Description )tab ),0) as PMDiscountAmount,
HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, '' as LeaveWithouPay
,0 as YTD
,0 as YTDGrossValue
,HRMS_Set_Employee.NTNNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.CNICNumber ,(SET_Business.BusinessName +'-'+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as CompanyName ,HRMS_SET_Employee.Email FROM
HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID AND SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PayrollType.IsVisiable=1
inner Join Set_operatingUnit on Set_operatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID
inner Join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = Set_operatingUnit.BusinessId
WHERE
DATENAME(month, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Month AND DATEPART(Year, [HRMS_SalaryHeader].[SalaryDate]) = @Year AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ([HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) and [HRMS_SalaryHeader].Status = 1 and [HRMS_SalaryDetail].payrolltypecode = 1 AND (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode=@PersonTypeCode or @PersonTypeCode is null)
{2}
{0}
union all
select * from ( select
(
select Round(sum(isnull(tab.CalculatedAmount,0) + ISNULL(tab.ManualAmount,0)),0) from ( select distinct HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Payrolltypeid, CalculatedAmount,ManualAmount from HRMS_EmployeePayroll left join HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction on HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.FromPersonID = Emp.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ToPersonID = Emp.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.CompanyID = Emp.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.Status = 1 and DATENAME(month, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = 'March' AND DATEPART(Year, HRMS_EmployeeMonthlyDeduction.ForTheMonth) = 2023 where PersonID = Emp.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = Emp.CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayRollTypeCode = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 )tab
) as GrossValue,
Emp.JoiningDate , Emp.PersonID ,Emp.CompanyID ,Emp.PersonTypeCode ,Emp.EmployeeCode ,Emp.FullName ,Sal_hdr.SalaryDate ,Emp.BasicSalary ,1 as Standard ,'' as JobDesignationName ,'' as DepartmentName ,'' as AccountHolderName ,'' as BankAccountNumber ,Emp.EmpAccountNo ,'' as BankBranchName ,'' as BankName ,'' as IBanNo ,0 as ManualAmount ,0 as CalculatedAmount ,Sal_hdr. left JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1

-- Leaves Calculation --
DECLARE @FromDate date; DECLARE @ToDate date; DECLARE @Days varchar(2); DECLARE @PayrollTypeCode int =4; DECLARE @Years varchar(4) =@Year; SET @FromDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/01/' + @Years, 101) ); SET @Days=(Select DAY(DATEADD(DD,-1,DATEADD(MM,DATEDIFF(MM,-1,@FromDate),0))) ); SET @ToDate=(Select convert(datetime, @Months + '/' + @Days + '/' + @Years, 101) );
Select TAB.Description, SE.FirstName, SE.EmployeeCode, SUM(TAB.Quantity) AS QUANTITY, TAB.leaveDays, TAB.leaveDays - SUM(TAB.Quantity) as BalanceLeaves, SE.CompanyID, TAB.PersonID, TAB.PayrollTypeID, TAB.PayrollTypeCode, TAB.LeavelID as PayrollTypeID, TAB.Impact, Tab.Factor
from ( SELECT HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, isnull(sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity),0) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
FROM HRMS_EmployeeAttendance
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.[Status] = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID WHERE (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear between @FromDate AND @ToDate) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) AND HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status = 1 AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Causal%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Sick%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Annual%' GROUP BY HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union all
--CASE 0 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where( HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode --and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate >= @FromDate and --HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate <= @ToDate) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Causal%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Sick%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Annual%' group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union
--CASE 1 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where (HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate between @FromDate and @ToDate)) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Causal%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Sick%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Annual%' group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union
--CASE 2 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,@ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where (HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate > @ToDate and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between @FromDate and @ToDate)) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Causal%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Sick%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Annual%' group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
union
--CASE 3 Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,@ToDate) + 1) as Quantity, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1 INNER join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where
( HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = @PersonID or @PersonID is null) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >@ToDate) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive AND HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Causal%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Sick%' or HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%Annual%' group by HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.Impact, HRMS_PayrollType.Factor

--CASE 6

Select PayrollTypeID, PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID, sum(OpeningBalanc) - sum(Amount) as OpeningBalanc, sum(LoanRecieved) as AmountRecoved , sum(AmountRecoved) as LoanRecieved, sum(ClosingBalance) as ClosingBalance, sum(Amount) as Amount from (
Select FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType, FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, (Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc)) as OpeningBalanc, sum(FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved, sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved ,0 as ClosingBalance, sum(FinalTAb.Amount) as Amount --,(Sum(FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc + FinalTAb.LoanRecieved) - sum(FinalTAb.AmountRecoved)) as ClosingBalance
from (
---------------- For Opening Balance ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, sum(tab.OpeningBalanc) as OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved ,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved , 0 as Amount

INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode

select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(Sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction),0) as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount

INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusHeader ON HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved , tab.AmountRecoved,tab.Amount
Union All
