Select tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.LoanRecieved, tab.AmountRecoved , sum(tab.amount) as Amount from (
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,0 as OpeningBalanc, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as Amount, 0 as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) < @LoanNewDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab
group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.OpeningBalanc, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.AmountRecoved,Tab.Amount
union All
---------------- For Loan Recovered during the Year ------------------
Select -- LoanSanctionHeaderID,PayrollTypeID, PayrollType,EmployeeCode,PayrollTypeCode,FullName,OpeningBalanc,LoanRecieved, AmountRecoved,Amount * from
(
select 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode as EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode as PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved,0 as Amount
--FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID=HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID
Inner Join HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID=HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID And HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_PayrollType ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID Inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.status = 1
left join HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1
where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.IsActive = 1 AND isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanPaymentDate, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate) between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = 5
{0}
Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount
)tab -- group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.PayrollTypeCode,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.LoanRecieved,tab.OpeningBalanc,AmountRecoved,Amount
Union All
---------------- For Loan Received during the Year ------------------
Select distinct tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc, sum(tab.LoanRecieved) as LoanRecieved , sum(tab.AmountRecoved) as AmountRecoved,tab.Amount from ( select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, 0 as LoanRecieved , isnull(Sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0) as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.IsActive = 1 -- AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
union all
select distinct 0 as LoanSanctionHeaderID,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as PayrollType,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, 0 as OpeningBalanc, isnull(Sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction),0) as LoanRecieved , 0 as AmountRecoved, 0 as Amount
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusHeader ON HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 where HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.Status = 1 AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CurrentManulDate between @LoanNewDate and @FullDate AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
)tab group by tab.LoanSanctionHeaderID,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollType,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.PersonID, tab.OpeningBalanc,tab.Amount
)FinalTAb
group by FinalTAb.LoanSanctionHeaderID, FinalTAb.PayrollTypeID,FinalTAb.PayrollType,FinalTAb.EmployeeCode,FinalTAb.PayrollTypeCode, FinalTAb.FullName,FinalTAb.PersonID, FinalTAb.OpeningBalanc, FinalTAb.LoanRecieved , FinalTAb.AmountRecoved,FinalTAb.Amount
) tb
group by PayrollTypeID,PayrollType, EmployeeCode , PayrollTypeCode, FullName,PersonID

data.name: Query_DataHeaderForPrePost
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT SH.CompanyID,SH.PeriodID, SH.SalaryHeaderID,SH.SalaryDate, EMP.EmployeeCode,EMP.FullName as EmployeeName, 0 as GLAccountID, BPT.FK_CodeCombinationID as GLAccountCode, 'Debit' as GLImpact, (Round(SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(SH.DeductionAmount,0)) as GLAmount, SH.DaysWorking --Round(SH.NetAmount,0) as GLAmount
FROM [HRMS_SalaryHeader] SH
INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EMP on EMP.PersonID=SH.PersonID and EMP.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ARC on ARC.CustomerID = EMP.FK_CustomerID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes BPT on BPT.PeriodID = SH.PeriodID and BPT.TypeCode = 7 and BPT.BusinessPartnerID = ARC.CustomerID --and BPT.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID
WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND (SH.[IsApproved] = 0 OR SH.[IsApproved] is null) AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate AND ISNULL(SH.PostID,0) > 0 --AND (EMP.IsActive = 1) --and SH.NetAmount <> '0.0000' And (EMP.CompanyID = @CompanyID or @CompanyID is null) {0}

data.name: Query_DataHeaderDetailForPrePost2
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT SH.CompanyID,SH.PeriodID, SH.SalaryHeaderID,SH.SalaryDate, EMP.EmployeeCode,EMP.FullName as EmployeeName, 0 as GLAccountID, BPT.FK_CodeCombinationID as GLAccountCode, 'Debit' as GLImpact, (Round(SH.GrossAmount,0)-round(SH.DeductionAmount,0)) as GLAmount, SH.DaysWorking --Round(SH.NetAmount,0) as GLAmount
FROM [HRMS_SalaryHeader] SH
INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EMP on EMP.PersonID=SH.PersonID and EMP.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ARC on ARC.CustomerID = EMP.FK_CustomerID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes BPT on BPT.PeriodID = SH.PeriodID and BPT.TypeCode = 7 and BPT.BusinessPartnerID = ARC.CustomerID --and BPT.CompanyID = SH.CompanyID
WHERE SH.[Status] = 1 AND (SH.[IsApproved] = 0 OR SH.[IsApproved] is null) AND SH.[SalaryDate] = @SalaryDate AND ISNULL(SH.PostID,0) > 0 --AND (EMP.IsActive = 1) --and SH.NetAmount <> '0.0000' And (EMP.CompanyID = @CompanyID or @CompanyID is null) AND ( EMP.StatusID = Null OR Null IS NULL)

data.name: Query_GetDataByDate
data.value:
select Max(SalaryHeaderID) as SalaryHeaderID,Max(PostID) as PostID from HRMS_SalaryHeader
WHERE FromDate = @FromDate AND ToDate = @ToDate AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1 AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID IS NULL) {0}

data.name: Query_GetdataForAlreadySalaryGenerateDailyWages
data.value: select * from hrms_salaryHEader where FromDate = @FromDate and ToDate = @ToDate and Status = 1 and CompanyID = @CompanyID

data.name: Query_SelectAllDataWithTransDailyWages
data.value:
SELECT HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, (SELECT DATEDIFF(MONTH, HRMS_SET_TaxYear.FromDate, @FromDate) FROM HRMS_SET_TaxYear WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID AND @FromDate BETWEEN HRMS_SET_TaxYear.FromDate AND HRMS_SET_TaxYear.ToDate ) AS NumberOfMonths, ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmountTaxable), 0) AS GrossAmount, ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.TaxAmount), 0) AS TaxAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.IsApproved
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee LEFT JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.FromDate = @ToDate AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.ToDate = @FromDate
WHERE HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 AND HRMS_Set_Employee.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.IsApproved

data.name: Query_SelectAllDataWithTransStatusIDDailyWages
data.value:
SELECT HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, ISNULL(( SELECT ISNULL(DATEDIFF(MONTH, HRMS_SET_TaxYear.FromDate, @FromDate), 0) FROM HRMS_SET_TaxYear WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID AND @FromDate BETWEEN HRMS_SET_TaxYear.FromDate AND HRMS_SET_TaxYear.ToDate ), 0) AS NumberOfMonths,
ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmountTaxable), 0) AS GrossAmount, ISNULL(SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.TaxAmount), 0) AS TaxAmount, HRMS_SalaryHeader.IsApproved
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee LEFT JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.FromDate = @ToDate AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.ToDate = @FromDate
WHERE HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 AND HRMS_Set_Employee.IsActive = 1 AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status IS NULL OR HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status = 1) {0} GROUP BY HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_SalaryHeader.IsApproved

data.name: Query_SelectAllEmployeeinPayRollDailyWages
data.value: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ISNULL(MONTH(JobEndingDate), 0) AS MnthDigit, ISNULL(YEAR(JobEndingDate), 0) AS YearDigit, PeriodID, HRMS_Set_Employee.*,CONVERT(bit, 0) AS IsChecked FROM HRMS_Set_Employee INNER JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayRoll ON HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.Status = 1 ) tab WHERE tab.Status = 1 AND tab.IsActive = 1 AND (tab.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL) {0} {1} ORDER BY CAST(ISNULL(tab.EmployeeCode, 0) AS INT) ASC

data.name: Query_GetDataByPayrollTypeCodeHSNew
data.value:
Select EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,Gender,CNICNumber,DateOfBirth,EOBINo,JoiningDate,EOBIJoinDate,GrossAmount,NetAmount,sum(EmployerAmount) as EmployerAmount, sum(AmountofEOBI) as AmountofEOBI, DaysWorking,Years,Department from (
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount as EmployerAmount ,(Round(0 ,0)) as AmountofEOBI,--0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = 33 -- and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI%'
{0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,ManualAmount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
union All
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName,SUM(HRMS_Set_Employee.BasicSalary) as GrossAmount,SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue, 0 as EmployerAmount ,(Round(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount ,0)) as AmountofEOBI,--0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = 35 -- and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI Employee%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,ManualAmount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount
) as tab
group by tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.Gender,tab.CNICNumber,tab.DateOfBirth,tab.EOBINo,tab.JoiningDate,tab.EOBIJoinDate,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysWorking,tab.Years,tab.Department -- ,tab.EmployerAmount

data.name: Query_BonusEmployeeSanghar
data.value:
Select Days, PersonID, CompanyID,-1 as BonusHeaderID,-1 as BonusDetailID, CEILING(BasicSalary) BasicSalary --,Case when Days >= @totaldays then CEILING(BasicSalary) else CAst(Round((CEILING(BasicSalary)/@totaldays) * Days,0) AS NUmeric(36,0)) end Bonus ,0 as Bonus , EmployeeName, EmployeeCode, JoiningDate, Eligibility, GrossSalary, EmployeeID, DesignationID, DesignationName, BonusAbsent, Action, StatusID, EmployeeStatusName, IncomeTax --, NetBonusAmount --, Case when Days >= @totaldays then CEILING(BasicSalary) + ArrearOfBonus - DeductionOfBonus - AdvanceSalary -IncomeTax --else Cast(Round((CEILING(BasicSalary)/@totaldays) * Days,0) + ArrearOfBonus - DeductionOfBonus - AdvanceSalary -IncomeTax AS NUmeric(36,0) ) --end NetBonusAmount ,0 as NetBonusAmount , ArrearOfBonus, DeductionOfBonus, AdvanceSalary, IsChecked, DepartmentID , Formula1 ,Formula2 ,Formula3 ,DeductionOfBonus as LoanAmount, 0 as Balance, DeductionOfBonus as LoanDeduction , LoanType, LoanTypeCode, IsEligibleForBonus, 0 AS Rate, 0 AS PresentDays, 0 AS IsIncludeDeductionAmount, 0 AS DeductionOfBonusTemp from (
Select Distinct 0 as Days, HRMS_Emp.PersonID ,HRMS_Emp.CompanyID, case when HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount > 0 then HRMS_EmployeePayroll.ManualAmount else HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CalculatedAmount end as BasicSalary,
0.00 as Bonus, HRMS_Emp.FullName as EmployeeName, HRMS_Emp.EmployeeCode, HRMS_Emp.JoiningDate, 'True' as Eligibility, HRMS_Emp.basicSalary as GrossSalary ,HRMS_Emp.PersonID as EmployeeID ,HRMS_Emp.FK_JobDesignationID as DesignationID, SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationName As DesignationName ,0 as BonusAbsent, 'Add' as Action , HRMS_Emp.StatusID , HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployeeStatusName ,0 as IncomeTax,
0.00 as NetBonusAmount ,0 as ArrearOfBonus ,isnull((select SUM(DeductionAmount) from ( select PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LoanDescription, case when (sum(InstallmentAmount) * @NoofBonus) > sum(Balance) then sum(Balance) else (sum(InstallmentAmount) * @NoofBonus) end as DeductionAmount,LoanSanctionHeaderID,LoanDate ,sum(Balance) as ActualLoanBalance from ( select HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID,convert(date,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.loanStartDate) as LoanDate, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanDescription, HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.InstallmentAmount, (HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount) -
( (isnull((select sum(isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanDisburstAmount,0)) from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.Status = 1 where HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID ),0)) + isnull( ( select sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction) from HRMS_BonusLoanDetail inner join HRMS_BonusDetail on HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail .BonusHeaderID and HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusDetailID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail .BonusDetailID and HRMS_BonusDetail.status = 1 where HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1 and HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID ),0)
) as Balance ,HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID from HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader
inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.Status =1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.Status =1
where HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Emp.PersonID and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Emp.CompanyID AND [HRMS_PayrollType].[PayrollTypeCode] = 5 and isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DeductionfromBonus,0) = 1 and HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.Status =1 ) as tab where Balance > 0 group by PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LoanDescription,LoanSanctionHeaderID,LoanDate )AS Fintab),0) as DeductionOfBonus ,0 as AdvanceSalary, 0 as LoanAmount, 0 as Balance, 0 as LoanDeduction, '' as LoanType,'' as LoanTypeCode ,'false' as IsChecked ,HRMS_Emp.FK_DepartmentID as DepartmentID ,(case when @Formula = 'Bonus1' and isnull(HRMS_Emp.IsBonus1Assigned,0) = 1 then (select Formula from HRMS_PayrollType where PayrollTypeID = 17 and PayrollTypeCode = 1) else null end) as Formula1 ,(case when @Formula = 'Bonus2' and isnull(HRMS_Emp.IsBonus2Assigned,0) = 1 then (select Formula2 from HRMS_PayrollType where PayrollTypeID = 17 and PayrollTypeCode = 1) else null end) as Formula2 ,(case when @Formula = 'Bonus3' and isnull(HRMS_Emp.IsBonus3Assigned,0) = 1 then (select Formula3 from HRMS_PayrollType where PayrollTypeID = 17 and PayrollTypeCode = 1) else null end) as Formula3 ,AppointedOn ,HRMS_Emp.IsEligibleForBonus
from [HRMS_Set_Employee] HRMS_Emp
left Join HRMS_EmployeeAttendance On HRMS_Emp.PersonID= HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_Emp.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID And HRMS_Emp.Status=1 left Join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID= HRMS_Emp.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_Emp.CompanyID And (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID=2 --or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID=14 ) And HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status=1 left join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Emp.FK_JobDesignationID And SET_JobDesignation.Status=1 Left Join HRMS_Employement_Status on HRMS_Employement_Status.StatusID =HRMS_Emp.StatusID And HRMS_Employement_Status.Status=1 Left JOIN [SET_JobCategory] ON [SET_JobCategory].JobCategoryID=HRMS_Emp.FK_JobCategoryID AND [SET_JobCategory].Status=1 left join SET_EmployeeType on SET_EmployeeType.TypeID = HRMS_Emp.PersonTypeCode and SET_EmployeeType.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID=HRMS_Emp.FK_DepartmentID And SET_Department.Status=1 Where HRMS_Emp.Status=1 and HRMS_Emp.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_Emp.jobendingdate is null And (HRMS_Emp.StatusID = @StatusID or @StatusID is null) And HRMS_Emp.IsBonusAllow = 1 {0} {1} {2} --and (HRMS_Emp.Formula1 = @Formula OR HRMS_Emp.Formula2 = @Formula OR HRMS_Emp.Formula3 = @Formula) )FinalFintab Where CompanyID = @CompanyID --and FinalFintab.Days >= @PresentDays and (Formula1 is not null OR Formula2 is not null OR Formula3 is not null) --and DATEDIFF(month, AppointedOn , @CurrentDate) >= 12 and IsEligibleForBonus = 1
order by EmployeeCode

Select DATENAME(MONTH, tab.SalaryDate) AS SalaryMonth, DATENAME(YEAR, tab.SalaryDate) AS SalaryYear,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,Gender,CNICNumber,DateOfBirth,EOBINo,JoiningDate,EOBIJoinDate,GrossAmount,NetAmount,sum(EmployerAmount)EmployerAmount, SUM(AmountofEOBI ) as AmountofEOBI, DaysWorking,Years,Department from (
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName, --SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Amount,0))) from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr where --HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.PayrollTypeCode = 1),0) as GrossAmount, SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue,HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount as EmployerAmount ,(0) as AmountofEOBI,--0 as EmployerAmount,--0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
--inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on --HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and --HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode -- and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) -- and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID
LEFT JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI Company%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount , HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID
union All
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName, --SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Amount,0))) from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr where --HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.PayrollTypeCode = 1),0) as GrossAmount, SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue,HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount as EmployerAmount ,(0) as AmountofEOBI, --0 as EmployerAmount, --0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
--left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on --HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and --HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) -- and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (2)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount , HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID
union All
Select HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, Set_Grade.GradeName, --SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Amount,0))) from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr where --HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryDetailID = HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetailinenr.PayrollTypeCode = 1),0) as GrossAmount, SUM(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount) as NetAmount,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking, Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as DedType,SET_Department.DepartmentName AS Department ,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,isnull(HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue,0) as DefaultValue,0 as EmployerAmount, (Round(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0)) as AmountofEOBI, --0 as EmployerAmount, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo, [HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber, [HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth, DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE())/ 365 AS Years , (case [HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender when 0 then 'Male' else 'Female' end) as Gender from HRMS_SalaryHeader
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryDetail on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID = SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID --AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = SET_JobDesignation.CompanyID and and SET_JobDesignation.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_Department ON HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1
--left join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on --HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID and --HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode -- and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].PersonID) -- and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = [HRMS_SalaryHeader].CompanyID
LEFT JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PayrollType.Status = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode in (3)
left join Set_Designation on Set_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
and Set_Designation.status =1
left join Set_Grade on Set_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_GradeID
and Set_Grade.status =1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%EOBI%' {0} AND (HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID= @PersonID or @PersonID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_LocationID = @LocationID or @LocationID is null) And (HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonTypeCode = @EmployeeTypeID or @EmployeeTypeID is null) And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount > 0 --new and isnull(HRMS_Set_Employee.IsEOBIMember,0) = 1 group by HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID, HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, Set_Grade.GradeName,Set_Designation.DesignationName,HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_PayrollType.Code,HRMS_Set_Employee.SocialSecNo,HRMS_SalaryDetail.CreateDate,HRMS_PayrollType.DefaultValue ,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBINo,[HRMS_Set_Employee].JoiningDate,[HRMS_Set_Employee].CNICNumber,[HRMS_Set_Employee].EOBIJoinDate, [HRMS_Set_Employee].DateOfBirth,[HRMS_Set_Employee].Gender,HRMS_SalaryHeader.DaysWorking,DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_Set_Employee.DateOfBirth, GETDATE()) ,Amount,SET_Department.DepartmentName, HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount , HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID
) as tab
group BY tab.SalaryDate, DATENAME(MONTH, tab.SalaryDate), DATENAME(YEAR, tab.SalaryDate), tab.EmployeeCode,tab.FullName,tab.FatherName,tab.Gender,tab.CNICNumber,tab.DateOfBirth,tab.EOBINo,tab.JoiningDate,tab.EOBIJoinDate,tab.GrossAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysWorking,tab.Years,tab.Department
ORDER BY tab.SalaryDate

data.name: Query_EmployeeSalarySheet_ReportDptWiseDataSanghar
data.value:
---- Query 1 For Over All Report
--DECLARE @FromDate DATE = '2024-11-01', -- @ToDate DATE = '2024-11-30', -- @CompanyID INT = 1, -- @PeriodID INT = 1
Select tempEmpCount.NoOFEmployees,tempDepEmpCount.DeptWiseNoOFEmployees,* From ( select case when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 6 then (1+TAB.PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 2 then (210+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 3 then (350 + PayrollTypeId) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 5 then (259+PayrollTypeId) when TAB.DeductionType = 'Supply Days' and TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (202) when TAB.PayrollTypeCode = 1 then (150+ TAB.PayrollTypeId) end as SortCategory,Round(tab.GrossSalary,0) as GrossSalary,tab.MasterSalary,tab.PeriodID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PersonID, tab.EmployeeCode,tab.PayrollTypeID,tab.PayrollTypeCode, tab.FullName,tab.JobDesignationID,tab.JobDesignationName,tab.DepartmentID,tab.DepartmentName,tab.SectionID,tab.SectionName, tab.DeductionType as Description,Round(tab.Amount,0) as Amount,tab.SalaryHeaderID,tab.GrossAmount,tab.DeductionAmount,tab.NetAmount,tab.DaysTotal,tab.DaysWorking,DENSE_RANK() OVER( ORDER BY EmployeeCode) AS SeriaLNo from (
select DISTINCT HRMS_SH.MasterSalary,HRMS_SH.GrossAmount as GrossSalary,HRMS_SD.PeriodID,HRMS_SD.CompanyID,HRMS_SD.SalaryDetailID,CAST(HRMS_SE.EmployeeCode as varchar) as EmployeeCode,HRMS_SE.FullName, HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID,HRMS_JD.JobDesignationName,HRMS_DP.DepartmentID,HRMS_DP.DepartmentName,HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID as SectionID, SET_Section.SectionName,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID,HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PT.Description as DeductionType,Round(HRMS_SD.Amount,0) as Amount,HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID,HRMS_SH.PersonID,HRMS_SH.DaysTotal,HRMS_SH.DaysWorking, 0 as GrossAmount ,0 as NetAmount,0 as DeductionAmount from HRMS_SalaryDetail HRMS_SD
Inner join HRMS_SalaryHeader HRMS_SH on HRMS_SD.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SD.SalaryHeaderID=HRMS_SH.SalaryHeaderID And HRMS_SH.Status=1 Inner join HRMS_SET_Employee HRMS_SE ON HRMS_SE.PersonID=HRMS_SH.PersonID AND HRMS_SE.CompanyID=HRMS_SH.CompanyID AND HRMS_SE.Status=1 --AND HRMS_SE.IsActive=1
Left Join SET_JobDesignation HRMS_JD ON HRMS_JD.JobDesignationID=HRMS_SE.FK_JobDesignationID AND HRMS_JD.Status=1
Inner JOin SET_Department HRMS_DP ON HRMS_DP.DepartmentID=HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID AND HRMS_DP.Status=1
Left JOin SET_Section ON HRMS_SE.FK_DepartmentID= SET_Section.DepartmentID AND HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID = SET_Section.SectionID AND SET_Section.Status=1

left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_SE.FK_SectionID

INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType HRMS_PT on HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeID AND HRMS_SD.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode AND HRMS_PT.Status = 1 and HRMS_PT.PayrollTypeCode <> 4 AND HRMS_PT.IsVisiable=1
